description: The 17th Elbląg Piekarczyk Run is an annual running event held in Elbląg, attracting runners for distances of 5 km, 10 km, and a Mini Piekarczyk Run for children. The event is characterized by a unique atmosphere of sporting excitement and integration, and participants receive exclusive collectible medals. Organizers provide comfortable start conditions, including a race office with packet pickup, deposit, and sanitary facilities. The run is an excellent opportunity to spend active time and compete on scenic city routes.
course_highlights: Routes for 5 km and 10 km runs through the streets of Elbląg
Mini Piekarczyk Run for children in various age categories
Unique collectible medal combined with other city runs
additional: Start packages can be collected at the Ogrody Shopping Center (Saturday 12:00-18:00) and at the Helena MOSiR Ice Rink hall (Sunday 7:30-9:30 for the 5 km and 10 km runs, 7:30-13:30 for the Mini Run). Participants have access to deposit, changing rooms, and showers at the ice rink hall. The Mini Piekarczyk Run includes several age categories for children with different distances from 50 m to 600 m, starting at 12:35 on Sunday. Distances of 5 km and 10 km, team classification, registration discounts, limited spots, online registration.

name: Rozbiegane Suwałki
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Suwałkach
description: Rozbiegane Suwałki is an annual city running festival held in June in Suwałki. The event lasts three days and attracts hundreds of participants of various ages and skill levels. The program includes races for children, the Five-Kilometer Run (5 km), Suwalska Ćwiartka (10.5 km), and the Breakfast Run to the Island (about 3.5 km). The routes are flat and fast, conducive to personal bests, and the atmosphere is full of sports competition and community integration.
course_highlights: Flat, fast city routes
Evening main race of 10.5 km - Suwalska Ćwiartka
Various distances for children and adults
additional: The event lasts three days and includes races for children and youth, a 5 km run, the main evening race of 10.5 km, and a recreational run of about 3.5 km with breakfast at the finish line. The routes are flat and fast, ideal for setting personal bests. Organized by the Sports and Recreation Center in Suwałki, which also offers bike and water equipment rentals and sports facility rentals. Distances include: children's races, 5 km, 10.5 km, and approximately 3.5 km; routes are flat and fast; the event lasts three days; online registration; location in Suwałki.

name: Rapla Selveri suurjooks, virtuaaljooks
description: Rapla Selveri Suurjooks on traditsiooniline jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Raplas ja pakub mitmeid distantsivalikuid alates lastejooksudest kuni poolmaratonini. Võistluskeskus asub Rapla Selveri parklas ning rajad kulgevad linna tänavatel ja maanteedel, olles hästi tähistatud ja mõõdetud. Osalejatele on tagatud turvalisus ning jooksu korraldab Kehakultuur OÜ koostöös ajakirjaga Jooksja. Eelregistreerimine lõpeb 20. mail ning stardigrupid moodustatakse eeldatava lõpuaegade alusel, et tagada sujuv ja ohutu jooksupäev.
course_highlights: Rajad kulgevad Rapla linna tänavatel ja maanteedel
10 km distants on passistatud ja rajad on tähistatud
Kontrollajad distantsidel tagavad jooksu sujuvuse ja turvalisuse
additional: Võistluskeskus avatakse kell 9.00 Rapla Selveri parklas. Lastejooksud toimuvad Sadolin Spordihoone juures. Stardigrupid moodustatakse eeldatava lõpuaegade alusel, et tagada ohutus ja sujuvus. 5 km rahvajooksule on oodatud ka kepikõndijad ja jalutajad. Osalejad peavad järgima liikluskorraldajate juhiseid ja hoidma paremat rajapoolt, et kiiremad saaksid mööduda vasakult. Registreerimine lõpeb 20. maini, osalejatele on saadaval erinevad kategooriad ning noorte ja virtuaaljooksu võimalused.

name: Modine Söderköpings Stadslopp
organizer: Norrköpings Löparklubb i samarbete med Söderköpings OK

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Alla barn deltar som vanligt helt gratis i Ramunderstaden Lilla Brunnsparksloppet.

description: Modine Söderköpings Stadslopp is a fast and popular 5-kilometer race with start and finish in Brunnsparken in Söderköping. The seventh edition will be held on Tuesday, June 16, 2026, featuring a flat and easily runnable course suitable for both fast runners and recreational participants. The race is lined with music stations and large audience support, and after crossing the finish line, participants are offered a summer plate from ICA Supermarket. The event also includes the free children's race Ramunderstaden Lilla Brunnsparksloppet with several age categories.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 5 km course (measured by federation measurer Per Lindh)
Start and finish in Brunnsparken, Söderköping
Course lined with music stations and large audience support
additional: Number bib distribution: ICA Supermarket Söderköping Monday, June 15, 12:00 - 18:00; other bibs are distributed at the start/finish area no later than one hour before the start. The chip is attached as a tab at the top of the bib and should not be removed for timing. Water is available at the start/finish and at 2.8 km. World Class is responsible for warm-up (15 minutes before each start; children's races warm-up at 16:45). After the race, ICA Supermarket offers a summer plate; massage is available after the race. Late registration: via website and on-site; online registration until June 14 at 16:00 according to info, regular late registration (additional fee +50 SEK = total 375 SEK) is valid from June 8 until one hour before the start, and on-site/bib distribution late registration can also be done (the website's news page mentions on-site registration 345 SEK). The course is 5 km through Söderköping; start and finish area in Brunnsparken; chip timing with Racetimer; warm-up before start by World Class; water at start/finish and at 2.8 km; medal for all participants; bag/outerwear drop-off at start and finish; the children's race Lilla Brunnsparksloppet (1.1 km) for kids; registration via the website; bibs are picked up at ICA Söderköping.

name: Blodomloppet (Visby)
description: Welcome to the Blood Race in Visby - a community race to raise awareness for blood donation where you can walk, jog, or run 5 km or 10 km, as well as participate in the Little Blood Race. The courses pass through Visby's cultural sites and are open to both individual participants and teams. The event is organized locally by VIF Gute Friidrott in collaboration with the Visby Blood Center and often concludes with a picnic and activities for participants.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km run along Visby's city wall and through the city center
10 km includes the seaside promenade, Almedalen, and Visby harbor
Beautiful cultural and urban environment with historic views
additional: Team registration (laganmälan) is available and costs 1,750 SEK until May 26; there is an option to register many participants via an Excel template that can be imported into the registration; the race promotes blood donation and provides information about blood donor gifts; local organizers: VIF Gute Friidrott (contact: Annie Gardell, Tel 0733 909722, email visby@blodomloppet.se) and the Blood Center in Visby (Tel 0498-26 84 53, email blodcentralen@gotland.se). Three categories: 10 km, 5 km, and Little Blood Race; registration via blodomloppet.se; start times in Visby according to information on the website; included items: functional T-shirt, bib number, and medal; team registration for companies/groups is available as an option; live broadcast of the race on blodomloppet.se.

name: Rakvere lahtised MV
description: Rakvere lahtised MV on kergejõustiku meistrivõistlused, mis toimuvad Rakvere staadionil. Võistlus toob kokku kohaliku spordikogukonna ja pakub võimalust jälgida mitmekülgseid kergejõustiku alade võistlusi. Üritus on avatud kõigile huvilistele ning loob sportliku ja toetava atmosfääri.
course_highlights: Võistlused toimuvad Rakvere staadionil
Mitmekülgsed kergejõustiku alad
Kohalik spordikogukond ja toetav atmosfäär
additional: Võistlused on avatud kõigile osalejatele ning registreerimine toimub kohapeal, osavõtumaks on 5 eurot väljaspool Lääne-Virumaad elavaid osalejaid.

name: Midsommarjoggen 2026
description: Midsummer Run is a running festival in Rynningeviken Nature Reserve in Örebro, scheduled for June 17, 2026. The main race is 7.2 km, mostly on easy-to-run gravel paths along the water and through the forest, suitable for both runners who want to run fast and those who prefer to jog or walk at a summer pace. The course passes Rävgången and Naturens Hus and concludes with an after-run at Stora Hjortstorp Farm, where food, drinks, and camaraderie are offered. There is also a KidsRun (approximately 600 meters) for children born in 2016 and later.
course_highlights: 7.2 km mostly easy-to-run gravel path along the water in Rynningeviken
Passes Rävgången and Naturens Hus with evening sun and lake view
Two wooden bridges over Lillån and two longer climbs at Venastugan
additional: Start at 18:30 (warm-up at 18:15, mandatory race briefing at 18:25). KidsRun starts at 17:45 (gathering at 17:40). Bibs can be collected at the secretariat from 16:00, latest by 18:10. Timing is done with a transponder loaned out (lost transponder fee 800 SEK); no timing for KidsRun. Water stations/energy at 3 km and 5 km; toilets are available at the area and water stations. No changing rooms or showers on site. After run at Stora Hjortstorp Farm (BBQ 299 SEK including water and coffee, children under 12 half price). Youth (born 2008 or later) get 50% discount; group registration via info@epictrail.se. The course is detailed as 7.2 km in Rynningeviken Nature Reserve; transponders are loaned at the start and must be returned (800 SEK fee for loss); survival food/drinks along the course and after run at Stora Hjortstorp Farm (BBQ buffet 299 SEK including water and coffee); no changing rooms or showers; KidsRun without timing; registration fee includes entry, bib, timing, medal, sports drink, and energy.

name: Tallinna noorte MV
description: Tallinna noorte MV on individuaalne kergejõustiku võistlus noortele ja täiskasvanutele, mis toimub Tallinnas. Võistlus hõlmab mitmeid vanuseklasse alates U-14 kuni täiskasvanuteni ning erinevaid kergejõustiku alasid nagu jooksud, hüpped, tõuked ja heited. Võistluse eesmärk on austada Eerik Konisti mälestust ning populariseerida kergejõustikku noorte seas. Kõiki vanuseklasse autasustatakse medalitega ning parimad saavad eriauhinnad. Võistlus toimub staadionil ja algab hommikul kell 11.00, registreerimine algab kell 10.00.
course_highlights: Mitmekülgsed kergejõustiku alad: jooksud, hüpped, tõuked ja heited
Võistlus toimub Heino Lippu nimelisel staadionil
Võistlejatele on ette nähtud 4 katset hüpetes, tõugetes ja heitetes
additional: Registreerimine algab kell 10.00 ja tehniline ülesandmine tuleb esitada pool tundi enne võistluste algust. Kõigi alade kolme paremat igas vanuseklassis autasustatakse medalitega ning lisaks antakse eriauhinnad parimatele poistele ja tüdrukutele. Peakohtunik on Viktor Predbannikov ja peasekretär Lilia Schmidt (tel. 5069887). Võistlus hõlmab erinevaid spordialasid nagu sprint, kaugusjooks, kõrgushüpe, teivas, kuul, ketas ja odavise. Osalejad saavad kogeda konkurentsi ja sportimise rõõmu piirkondlikul tasandil.

name: Challenge Gdańsk 2026
description: Challenge Gdańsk 2026 is a prestigious triathlon held by the Baltic Sea, set against the picturesque scenery of Gdańsk and Brzeźno. Athletes compete in the half-distance event, which includes 1.9 km of swimming in the Gulf of Gdańsk, a fast 90 km cycling route through the Vistula Lagoon, and a 21.1 km run along the beach and Ronald Reagan Park, finishing at the Gdańsk pier. The event attracts both professionals and amateurs, offering a unique atmosphere and excellent conditions for sporting competition. It is an official qualifying race taking place from June 19 to June 21, 2026.
course_highlights: Swimming in the Gulf of Gdańsk over 1.9 km
Fast 90-kilometer cycling loop through the Vistula Lagoon
Running along the beach and Ronald Reagan Park with finish at the pier in Brzeźno
additional: Option to purchase a cancellation with full refund until June 1, 2026. Special discounts for teams of at least 10 athletes. Races are held over several days: sprint on Saturday, half-distance on Sunday. Race office and Expo zone open during the event days. Bicycle and wetsuit rental available. Routes may undergo minor adjustments due to coordination with road authorities. The time limit for the half-distance is until 4:45 PM on race day. Participants can opt for a full refund cancellation, with part of the fees donated to the Pomeranian Hospice for Children. The event is also known for high attendance and recognition in the triathlon community, including the title Race of the Year 2021.

name: Nocny Bieg Świętojański
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdynia, Gdynia, Poland
description: Night Saint John’s Run is an annual running event organized in Gdynia, part of the Grand Prix Gdyni 2026. The main race on a 10 km distance takes place in the picturesque scenery of the city, accompanied by children’s and youth races. The event attracts runners from various age groups, offering sporting competition and integration in a nocturnal atmosphere. Organizers provide professional service as well as photographic and video documentation of the event.
course_highlights: Main race on a 10 km distance
Picturesque route in the center of Gdynia
Night event as part of the Grand Prix Gdyni
additional: During the event, photos and video materials will be taken for the promotion of events organized by GCS and the Gdynia City Municipality. The race includes various age categories, including children’s races and Nordic Walking. Participants can expect an attractive atmosphere of a nighttime sporting event and rich promotional materials and online results.

name: Kuusalu valla kergej. MV
description: Kuusalu valla kergejõustiku meistrivõistlused on traditsiooniline kergejõustiku võistlus, mis toimub Kuusalus. Võistlusel osalevad erinevad vanusegrupid ja distantsid, pakkudes võimalust nii harrastajatele kui ka edasijõudnutele. Üritus on pühendatud Margus Keerma mälestusele ning korraldab seda spordiklubi Treeningpartner. Võistlus on hea võimalus näidata oma oskusi ja nautida sportlikku atmosfääri Kuusalu vallas.
course_highlights: Mitmekülgsed kergejõustiku alad
Võistlus erinevatele vanuseklassidele
Kogukonna sportlik üritus
additional: Võistlus toimub Kuusalu staadionil ning hõlmab erinevaid kergejõustiku alasid, registreerimine toimub enne võistluste algust.

name: Ümber Saadjärve jooks

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lastejooksudel osalemine on eelregistreerimisel kuni 18.06 TASUTA

description: 38. Ümber Saadjärve jooks toimub 20. juunil 2026 Kukulinnas, pakkudes osalejatele 17 km pikkust jooksu ja tervisekõndi ümber Saadjärve. Rajal on asfaltkattega tee ning kolm joogipunkti, mis tagavad hea varustuse jooksu ajal. Lisaks põhijooksule on kavas lastejooksud erinevates vanuseklassides ning tervisekõnd, mis sobib kõigile liikumishuvilistele. Iga lõpetaja saab meene medali ning parimad autasustatakse vanuseklasside kaupa. Üritus on traditsiooniline ja hästi korraldatud, pakkudes meeldivat spordielamust kogu perele.
course_highlights: 17 km pikkune jooks ümber Saadjärve asfaltkattega teel
Kolm joogipunkti 5., 9. ja 14. kilomeetril
Start ja finiš Jääaja Keskuse juurest
additional: Põhijooksu osalustasu sisaldab võistlusnumbrit, ajavõtuteenust, rajateenindust, jooki finišis, parimate autasustamist ja osalejamedalit. Tervisekõnnil on samuti ajavõtt ja medal. Võistluspäeval on võimalik tasuda ainult sularahas. Ümberregistreerimine on tasuta kuni 17.06.2026, võistluspäeval 5 eurot. Lastejooksudel ajavõtt puudub väiksematel distantsidel, ajavõtuga on 9-10 aastastel. Ajavõtuteenuse partner on OÜ Teamtime, tulemused avaldatakse teamtime.ee/results. Registreerimine toimub kuni 18. juunini 2026, osalejatele pakutakse medalit ning autasustamist erinevates vanuseklassides. Osavõtutasu on vahemikus 15-20 EUR ning lastejooksud on tasuta. Rada hõlmab asfalti ja maastikku ning on varustatud joogipunktidega.

name: 54 Memoriał Żylewicza - Bieg Amatorów
description: The 54th Józef Żylewicz Memorial is a prestigious athletics meet organized annually since 1973 by the LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club. The event commemorates the outstanding coach and sports activist Józef Żylewicz, one of the founders of KS LECHIA Gdańsk and a co-creator of the Polish national athletics team's successes. The Memorial takes place at the Athletics and Rugby Stadium in Gdańsk and combines sporting professionalism with openness to the local community, attracting athletes from Poland and abroad. As part of the Memorial, there is also the Amateur 3000m Race "Fast Arrow of the North," open to all running enthusiasts, with no age limits or sports requirements.
course_highlights: 3000m race on the professional athletics track at the Gdańsk stadium
Route at the Athletics and Rugby Stadium at al. Grunwaldzka 244
Event combines professional athletes with amateurs and the local community
additional: The Amateur 3000m Race "Fast Arrow of the North" is open to everyone without age limits or sports requirements. The event is symbolic and promotes accessibility of athletics for all. As part of the Memorial, there is also a festival "Athletics for Everyone" with attractions for families and Swedish relays for primary school students. The event includes various distances and age categories, with broad sponsorship and promotional support. Participants can expect medals, branded T-shirts, and attractive cash prizes.

name: Bieg Dwie Wieże

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: ok. 15 km - mieszkańcy Gminy Choczewo 40.00 PLN

tiers.label: tier_4
tiers.description: ok. 15 km - mieszkańcy Gminy Choczewo - pakiet z koszulką 60.00 PLN

description: The Two Towers Run is a race approximately 15 km long, held in Kopalina. The route goes along a dirt road, beach, and sidewalk, offering diverse terrain and scenic views. The time limit to complete the course is 2.5 hours, and the number of participants is limited to 250. The event is well-organized, with water stations along the route and a recovery meal at the finish line.
course_highlights: Approximately 15 km long route
Run on dirt road, beach, and sidewalk
Water stations at 4 km, 8 km, 12 km, and at the finish
additional: Participant limit: 250 people. Race office open on 19.06 from 13:00 to 19:00 and on 20.06 from 8:00 to 9:45 (verification closes at 9:45). Identity verification is mandatory (ID card/license). Chip timing is required, issued at the office and returned at the finish. Water and a recovery meal are available at the finish. Medical security is provided. Participants agree to the use of their image. It is recommended to have personal NNW insurance. Online registration, limit of 250 participants, medical security, photography and filming, rules of conduct on the route.

name: Challenge Poland
description: Challenge Gdańsk is a prestigious middle-distance triathlon held by the Baltic Sea in the beautiful scenery of Gdańsk. Participants start from the city beach, covering 1.9 km of swimming, 90 km of a fast and flat cycling route through the Vistula Delta, and 21.1 km of running along the beach and Ronald Reagan Park. The finish line is located on a unique city pier, making the finish unforgettable. The event is an official qualifier and is highly regarded among triathletes worldwide.
course_highlights: 1.9 km swimming in the Baltic Sea at Gdańsk city beach
90 km flat and fast cycling route through the Vistula Delta
21.1 km running along the beach and Ronald Reagan Park with the finish on a city pier
additional: Starts are scheduled over three days: June 19 for children and TREFL Aquathlon, June 20 for sprint and Challenge Women by Brooks, June 21 for the middle-distance race with wave starts for PRO men, PRO women, and Age Group categories. Registration can be canceled until June 1, 2026. Special discounts are available for teams of 10 or more. The cycling route passes by, among others, Polsat Plus Arena Stadium. The race office and expo zone are located at Brzeźno Beach in Gdańsk. The event also includes an expo, transition zones, technical briefings, various start categories, and is an official qualifier for major international triathlons.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 4. Pariisi Maastikujooks
description: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 ühendab tervisesportlasi ja harrastajaid kevadest sügiseni, pakkudes mitmekesiseid jooksu- ja kõnnivõimalusi. Sarja eesmärk on toetada tervislikke eluviise ning julgustada kohalikke osalema spordiüritustel. 4. Pariisi Maastikujooks toimub 21. juunil Pariisi puhkekülas ning on osa pika traditsiooniga jooksusarjast, mis hõlmab erinevaid vanusegruppe ja distantsivalikuid. Ajavõtt toimub kiibiga ning numbrid tuleb kinnitada kõhule või rinnale, rõhutades korraldajate hoolt osalejate mugavuse ja turvalisuse eest.
course_highlights: Maastikujooks Pariisi puhkekülas
Distantsid 5 km kuni 10 km põhidistantsidel
Mitmekesised vanusegrupid ja jooksuklassid
additional: Ajavõtt toimub kiibiga, mis on kleebitud numbri tagaküljele ja kaetud vahuplaadiga. Numbrid tuleb kinnitada kõhule või rinnale, mitte seljale. Eelregistreerimine lõpeb jooksule eelneval päeval kell 16:00. Võistluspaigas registreerimine toimub jooksu juhendis nimetatud kellaaegadel. Sarjas on ka kõndimise distantsid 1,8 km kuni 10 km. Võistlusel on erinevad distantsid, sealhulgas kuni 10 km, 5 km, 1.6 km ja lühikesed noorte- ning lastesõbralikud rajad. Osalejad saavad registreeruda veebis ning üritus toetab tervislikke eluviise ja kogukonna sportimist.

name: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Rummu
description: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Rummu on mitmekülgne takistuskross, mis toimub Rummu karjääris. Rajal tuleb ronida, roomata, tõsta ja tiritada läbi muda, vee, liiva ja mägede, pakkudes väljakutset kõigile osalejatele. Võistlus on osa Vägilase jooksu sarjast, mis on tuntud kui Eesti parim OCR üritus. Rada on tummisem ja pakub põnevaid takistusi ning elamusi looduses.
course_highlights: 4 km ja 8 km distantsid
Muda, vesi, liiv ja mäed
Mitmekülgsed takistused ja tehnilised katsumused
additional: Registreerides vähemalt kolmele Vägilase jooksu üritusele korraga, rakendub 15% hooaja soodustus. Noortele alla 20 a. ja seenioridele alates 60 a. on 30% soodustus automaatselt sünniaasta järgi. Grupisoodustus -20% kehtib vähemalt 4 inimese registreerimisel samale üritusele. Lastejooksud on tasuta veebis ette registreerides, kohapeal 3€. Lastejooksudel on jõukohased takistused ja medalid kõigile lõpetajatele. Stardid toimuvad lainetena, 8 inimest grupis iga 2 minuti tagant. Takistuste läbimiseks võib kasutada piiramatult katseid, takistuse mitteläbimisel kaotatakse käepael. Takistuskross, lastejooksud, registreerimine veebis ja Stebby kaudu, hooaja soodustused ning arved, võistlusklassid ja stardigrupid, ohutus ja alternatiivsed harjutused takistustel

name: Maraton igas linnas Keila
description: Maraton igas linnas Keila on unikaalne jooksuvõistlus, mis pakub osalejatele võimalust joosta maratoni distants erinevates linnades. Rajal on korraldatud toitlustuspunktid iga 400 meetri järel ning rajal on olemas ka WC-d, mis teeb jooksu mugavaks ja toetab sportlaste heaolu. Võistlus sobib nii kogenud maratonijooksjatele kui ka neile, kes soovivad proovida oma vastupidavust. Üritus on hästi organiseeritud ja pakub meeldivat kogemust kõigile osalejatele.
course_highlights: Maratonirada kulgeb linnatänavatel ja staadionil
Toitlustuspunktid iga 400 meetri järel
Rajalt eksimise oht on minimaalne tänu selgetele märgistustele
additional: Maraton toimub staadionil ja linnatänavatel, kus iga 400 meetri järel on toidupunkt ja WC. Rajalt eksimise oht on välistatud tänu heale märgistusele. Sündmus toimub Iisaku linnas, pakkudes võimalust nautida staadionil põhinevat rada ning osaleda erinevatel jooksudistantsidel.

name: Midsommartrail - Möt ljuset
description: Midsummer Trail - Meet the light is a personal trail run held on the longest day of the year with a focus on the experience. The race starts before dawn so you can run into the daylight along a 30 km course in beautiful forest terrain. The number of participants is limited (max 100) to create an intimate and caring atmosphere, and after finishing, the organizer offers a plentiful breakfast. Navigation is done with a pre-delivered GPS route and a map at the start, and there are two energy stations along the way.
course_highlights: 30 km trail run at dawn where you "meet the light" along the course
Two energy stations placed along the route
Navigation with GPS route and map (runner responsible for navigation)
additional: Start/finish at Attunda Orienteering Clubhouse, Ytterbyvägen 22, Sollentuna; easiest public transport: commuter train to Rotebro (1.5 km walk); parking at Sollentuna Golf Club (500 m walk) and parking on Ytterbyvägen is not allowed; maximum 100 participants; breakfast served after the race; registration open until one hour before start; age limit 18 years; recommended accommodation: Good Morning Hotel Sollentuna (discount code NIGHTTRAILRUN). Start time 02:00 on 2026-06-21. 30 km trail run; GPS route and map; two energy stations along the way; breakfast after finish; hotel discount at Good Morning Hotel Sollentuna with code NIGHTTRAILRUN.

name: Night Trail Run  Sommar 2025
description: Night Trail Run Summer Trail is a personal trail race in Sollentuna held on the longest day of the year. The race is 30 km long and starts at dawn to give participants the experience of meeting the summer light; the number of participants is limited to maintain an intimate atmosphere. Participants navigate using a GPS route (sent in advance) and also receive a map at the start. After finishing, a plentiful breakfast is offered so you can share the experience with other runners.
course_highlights: 30 km trail run starting before dawn and reaching daylight
Participants navigate themselves with GPS route + map at start
Two energy stations along the course and breakfast after finishing
additional: Max 100 runners. Start/finish at Attunda Orienteering Clubhouse, Ytterbyvägen 22 in Sollentuna. Nearest public transport: commuter train to Rotebro station and about 1.5 km walk to the venue. Parking is recommended at Sollentuna Golf Club (approximately 500 m); parking on Ytterbyvägen is not allowed. Participants are responsible for navigation; GPS route is sent in advance and a map is distributed at the start. Registration is open until one hour before the race starts. Age limit: 18 years. Recommended accommodation: Good Morning Hotel Sollentuna (discount code NIGHTTRAILRUN). Seasonal variants include Summer Trail as well as Autumn Trail and Dog Trail, where the experience and night adventure are emphasized as the core of Night Trail Run.

name: Pärnumaa Võidupüha maraton
description: Pärnumaa Võidupüha maraton toimub 22. juunil 2026 Tori vallas, kus võistluskeskus asub ajaloolise Tori Eesti Sõjameeste Mälestuskiriku juures. Maraton toob kaasa mitmeid uuendusi ning on korraldatud koostöös Pärnumaa Spordiliidu ja toetajatega. See on traditsiooniline ja legendaarne jooks, mis pakub sportlastele mitmekesist ja meeldejäävat kogemust.
course_highlights: Võistluskeskus legendaarse Tori Eesti Sõjameeste Mälestuskiriku juures
Mitmekesine ja ajalooline rada Pärnumaa maastikul
Korraldus koostöös Pärnumaa Spordiliidu ja Tori vallaga
additional: Kõikide distantside võistluskeskus asub legendaarse ja ajaloolise Tori Eesti Sõjameeste Mälestuskiriku juures. Korraldajaks on Tori vald koostöös Pärnumaa Spordiliidu ja toetajatega. Võistlusel on vabatahtlike kaasamine. Maratoni korraldamisel kasutatakse uut rada ning üritus on osa Võidupüha tähistamisest Pärnumaal.

name: 49. Jaanijooks ümber Karksi-Nuia paisjärve
location: Karksi ordulinnuse varemed, Karksi-Nuia, Põhja-Sakala vald, Estonia
description: 49. Jaanijooks ümber Karksi-Nuia paisjärve on traditsiooniline jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Karksi ordulinnuse varemete lähedal. Võistlus kulgeb ümber maalilise Karksi-Nuia paisjärve, pakkudes osalejatele kauneid vaateid ja meeldivat jooksukogemust. Üritus on mõeldud nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele ning loob võimaluse nautida sportlikku päeva kogukonnas.
course_highlights: Jooks ümber Karksi-Nuia paisjärve
Maalilised vaated järvele ja ordulinnuse varemetele
Maa- ja metsateed, sobilikud erinevatele jooksutüüpidele
additional: Sündmus on osa kohaliku kogukonna spordikalendrist ning toimub ajaloolise paiga läheduses, pakkudes osalejatele võimalust kogeda loodust ja ajalugu samal ajal.

name: Jooks suvesse
description: Pööripäevajooksud on aastane võistlussari, mis koosneb mitmest etapist, kus osalejad saavad koguda punkte ja võistelda vanusegruppides. Jooks suvesse on üks sarja etappidest, mis toimub Kuressaares Loode tammikus. Rajal on vaheldusrikas pinnas, sealhulgas kergliiklustee ja metsateed, mis võivad olla ilmastikuolude tõttu porised. Osalejatele on tagatud elektrooniline ajavõtt, korduvkasutatavad rinnanumbrid ja joogitopsid ning finišis magus amps ja jook.
course_highlights: Ring on 2346 meetrit pikk
Umbes 600 meetrit kulgeb kergliiklusteel
Kolmveerand rajast kulgeb metsa vahel mullasel/kruusasel teel
additional: Korduvkasutatavad rinnanumbrid koos ajavõtukiibiga, mis tuleb peale jooksu tagastada. Osavõtutasu makstakse kohapeal sularahas. Finišis on väike parkla ja parkimisvõimalus maantee ääres. Kõik võistlejad saavad finišis diplomi ja auhinna vanusegruppide kolme kiiremat. Osalemine vähemalt kolmel etapil annab õiguse aasta kokkuvõtte diplomi ja karika saamiseks. Sündmus hõlmab erinevaid jooksuüritusi ja pakub osalejatele võimalust nautida suvist Saaremaa atmosfääri.

name: Jaanijooks ümber Karksi-Nuia paisjärve
description: Jaanijooks ümber Karksi-Nuia paisjärve on traditsiooniline maanteejooks, mis toimub Karksi-Nuia piirkonnas. Võistlus pakub osalejatele võimalust nautida kaunist järve ümbrust ning sportlikku väljakutset. Üritust korraldab MTÜ Karksi Sport, kes on pühendunud kohaliku spordi edendamisele. Jaanijooks on hea võimalus nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele osaleda sõbralikus ja toetavas keskkonnas.
course_highlights: Jooks ümber Karksi-Nuia paisjärve
Kaunis järveäärne maastik
Maanteekate ja kergliiklusteed
additional: Võistlusel osalejad saavad registreeruda internetis või võistluspäeval, osalejatel on võimalus saada autasustamist ning kasutada rinnanumbrit ja kiipi. Võistluse raames toimub ka tervise- ja kindlustusvastutus osalejate jaoks.

name: 12. Rõuge maastikujooks-kõnd
description: 12. Rõuge maastikujooks-kõnd on Võru maakonnas, Rõuge Ööbikuorus toimuv maastikujooksu ja kepikõnni üritus, mis pakub osalejatele võimalust nautida loodust ja liikumist. Üritus sobib nii jooksjatele kui ka kepikõndijatele ning kõndijatele, kes soovivad aktiivselt aega veeta. Liikumisharrastuse kompetentsikeskus korraldab sündmust eesmärgiga edendada liikumist ja tervislikku eluviisi. Osalejad saavad kogeda kaunist maastikku ning liikumise rõõmu hea enesetunde nimel.
course_highlights: Rõuge Ööbikuoru kaunis maastik
Sobib jooksmiseks, kepikõnniks ja kõndimiseks
Võru maakonna looduslähedane rada
additional: Rada hõlmab metsaradu ja matkaradu; üritus edendab kehalist aktiivsust ja tervist; registreerimine ja täpsem info puuduvad.

name: Böda Beach Run
location: Böda Sand-stranden, Löttorp, Borgholm Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: Böda Beach Run is a race that stands out a bit extra at Böda Sand. It is a tough competition in sand and water suitable for both those who want to compete seriously and families who want to have fun, with courses ranging from 500 meters up to 10 km. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal. The event is held at Böda Sand Beach Resort on June 24.
course_highlights: Courses from 500 m up to 10 km
Tough competition in sand and water
Medal for all finishers
additional: Date: June 24. The event takes place at Böda Sand Beach Resort (Bödasandsallén 11, 387 73 Löttorp). Contact/phone for Böda Sand: (+46)485-22200. The event is marketed as family-friendly and is a recurring event in the resort's event calendar. Accommodation special offers are available at Böda Sand; registration and bib pickup are from Nordpoolen at 12:00 on race day.

name: Aastajooks
organizer: Spordiklubi Pärnu Kahe Silla Klubi MTÜ
description: Pärnu aastajooksud on traditsiooniline jooksusarja üritus, mis sai alguse 1985. aastal ja on inspireeritud idamaade kalendrist, pühendudes igal aastal vastava aasta sümbolloomale. 2026. aasta jooksusarja teema on tulihobuse aasta, mis koosneb üheksast etapist, mis toimuvad kolmes erinevas Pärnu piirkonnas: Vallikäär, Pärnu rand ja Reiu-Raeküla terviserada. Igas asukohas toimub kolm etappi, pakkudes osalejatele mitmekesist ja huvitavat jooksukogemust. Sarja eesmärk on pakkuda sportlikku väljakutset ja rõõmu nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele.
course_highlights: 9 etappi jaotatud 3 stardipaiga vahel: Pärnu Vallikäär, Pärnu rand ja Reiu-Raeküla terviserada
Igas stardipaigas toimub 3 etappi, kokku 9 jooksu hooaja jooksul
Jooksusarja teema on inspireeritud idamaade kalendrist ja pühendatud vastava aasta sümbolloomale
additional: Sarja jooksul toimub 9 etappi, mis on jaotatud kolme erineva stardipaiga vahel. Iga etapp algab õhtul kell 18:00. Osalejatele on võimalik soetada hooajapilet või registreeruda üksikutele etappidele. Korraldajad kutsuvad ka vabatahtlikke appi ning pakuvad kinkekaarte. Mitmed etapid ja erinevad distantsid, sealhulgas 1500 m Vallikäärus, 3000 m rannas ja 5000 m Reiu-Raekülas; üritus toimub 21. juulil 2026 Pärnus.

name: Aastajooks
organizer: Spordiklubi Pärnu Kahe Silla Klubi MTÜ
description: Pärnu aastajooksud on 1985. aastal alguse saanud jooksusarja traditsioon, mis on inspireeritud idamaade kalendrist ja pühendatud igal aastal vastava aasta sümbolloomale. 2026. aasta jooksusarjas on kavas tulihobuse aasta jooks, mis koosneb üheksast etapist, mis toimuvad kolmes erinevas asukohas Pärnus: Vallikäär, Pärnu rand ja Reiu-Raeküla terviserada. Igas asukohas toimub kolm etappi, pakkudes jooksjatele mitmekesist ja huvitavat kogemust. Sarja jooksul saavad osalejad nautida erinevaid maastikke ja Pärnu kauneid vaateid.
course_highlights: Üheksa etappi jaotatud kolme stardipaiga vahel: Pärnu Vallikäär, Pärnu rand ja Reiu-Raeküla terviserada
Mitmekesine maastik ja kaunid vaated Pärnu linnas ja rannaalal
Igas asukohas kolm jooksu, mis annavad võimaluse kogeda erinevaid jooksuelamusi
additional: Sarja kuulub üheksa etappi, mis toimuvad kolmes erinevas stardipaigas, kus igas toimub kolm jooksu. Stardid algavad tavaliselt kell 18:30. Osalejatele on võimalik soetada hooajapilet või registreeruda üksikutele etappidele. Korraldajaks on Pärnu Kahe Silla Klubi. Võistlus toimub suvehooajal Pärnus. Üritus toimub Pärnus ning hõlmab erinevaid etappe ja lapsesõbralikke tegevusi; registreerimine ja täpsem ajakava on kättesaadavad organisatsiooni veebilehel.

name: Trosa Stadslopp
description: Trosa City Run is a long-standing community festival held annually on the first Friday after Midsummer - in 2026, the race will take place on Friday, June 26. The course runs through the summer-blooming Trosa with lots of spectators and proximity to the water, contributing to a summery competitive and recreational atmosphere. The event features categories for elite runners, recreational runners, youth, and children, and offers both the main race of 8,900 meters and shorter recreational options.
course_highlights: Course route through the summer-blooming Trosa, near the water
Main race 8,900 m plus recreational runs Jogging/Nordic walking 4 km and children's race 700 m
Start and finish at Trosa square with enthusiastic spectators and stage activities
additional: Registration portal remains open until the start, and payment can be made via Swish or card; alternatively, use Trosa City Run's bank transfer number 488-8335 for payment. Folksam recreational run insurance is offered (e.g., 155 SEK for basic coverage, Startklar Plus 275 SEK). Bib number distribution opens at 10:00 at Team Sportia on race day. The main race of 8,900 m has time-based start groups (start group 1 at 21:00, followed by additional groups); there are also children's races (700 m) and prize ceremonies from the stage. The organizer distributes 50 cl Vitamin Well to runners in the 8,900 m and 4 km races. Distances also include 700 m and 900 m in the program; Jogging/Nordic walking 4 km; night bus information to Stockholm after the race.

name: Silverleden Ultra 100 Miles
description: Silverleden Ultra is a trail ultramarathon in Bergslagen held in Hällefors with start/finish at Hurtigtorpet during the weekend of June 26-27, 2026. The event offers courses of 33 km, 64 km, and 100 miles and is promoted with slogans such as "Running joy," "Both long & tough," and "Run. Survive. Show off" - a technical and hilly event for those seeking a challenging nature experience. For 2026, the 100 miles category is fully booked. The race is aimed at experienced ultrarunners and runners who want to challenge themselves in rocky, root-filled, and hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Technical trail with many hills; the longer climbs mostly occur on the second half of the course
Roots and rocky slabs that become very slippery in wet conditions - trail shoes with a coarse tread are recommended
Control at Silvergruvan (around 35 km) - possibility to have poles delivered to the control point
additional: Bus: transportation from Hurtigtorpet to the start for the 33 km race departs at 10:30, limited number of seats which must be pre-booked (book by 2026-06-20). Accommodation: several local options listed within 5 - 20 km from start/finish. Caravan/motorhome spots are available in limited numbers - contact via info@silverledenultra.se; electricity is limited and cannot be guaranteed. No charging options for electric cars at the start/finish in Hurtigtorpet. Minimum age for participants is 15 years (the year they turn 15); relay teams cannot be registered in 2026. For international participants, payment can be made via the provided IBAN; the order confirmation from the registration system serves as proof for health insurance benefits. Early Bird prices are mentioned in the information, but exact amounts are not specified.

name: GDYNIA ULTRA WAY
description: Gdynia Ultra Way is a mountain race by the sea scheduled for June 26-27, 2026, in Gdynia and the surrounding Kashubia region. Participants can choose from five distances, ranging from 14 km to 160 km, with varied elevation gains and scenic routes. The start and finish are in different locations, and the organizer provides transportation to the start of the longest distance. It is a unique opportunity to challenge oneself with a demanding course and enjoy the beauty of the seaside nature.
course_highlights: 160 km distance with +/- 2502 m elevation, start in Puck at 10:00
100 km distance with +/- 2267 m elevation, start in Gdynia at 21:00
Routes run through Kashubia and seaside areas with control points and time limits
additional: For the start of the longest distance (160 km), participants are transported by buses from the Gdynia Sports Center - National Rugby Stadium (transportation paid). The time limit for the 160 km distance is 31 hours. The route includes control points with time limits and drop bags. The event features both summer and winter editions, with routes passing through various towns in the region, providing unforgettable experiences for runners of all levels.

name: Sillamäe promenaadijooks

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lastejooks (450 m) / Tillujooks (150 m) - TASUTA; Noortejooks (3,5 km) ajavõtuta TASUTA; Noortejooks (3,5 km) ajavõtuga TASUTA

description: Sillamäe Promenaadijooks on tuntud linnajooks, mis toimub Sillamäe Kultuurikeskuse juures. Jooksu traditsioon sai alguse treppide jooksuna ning 2021. aastast kannab see nime Promenaadijooks. Võistlusel on erinevad distantsid alates mudilaste lühikestest jooksudest kuni täiskasvanute 7 km põhidistantsini, mis pakub väljakutset ka treenitud sportlastele. Üritus on kogukondlik ja kaasahaarav, kus lisaks jooksule on ka mitmeid muid tegevusi ning toetajate ja vabatahtlike panus on oluline.
course_highlights: 7 km põhidistants, mis sisaldab Sillamäe treppe - jooksu raskeim, kuid ilusaim tõus
Lühemad distantsid lastele ja noortele: 150 m, 450 m ja 3,5 km
Linnajooks Sillamäe promenaadil ja treppidel
additional: Registreerimine toimub internetis ja lõpeb tavaliselt kuu aega enne võistlust. Osalemistasu tuleb tasuda Sillamäe Koolispordi Liidu kontole. Võistlusel on ka vabatahtlikud, mitmed toetajad ning lisategevused nagu tants, laul, jalgrattasõit ja korvpallivisked. Võistluse korraldavad mitmed kohalikud spordiorganisatsioonid ja koolid. Sündmus hõlmab erinevaid distantsivõimalusi ja kultuuriüritusi ning on suunatud kogukonna kaasamisele. Osalejatel on võimalus nautida kaunist loodust ja vaateid merele.

name: EUTR - Estonia Ultra-Trail Race
description: Estonia Ultra-Trail Race (EUTR) 9th Edition will be held on 26-27 June 2026 in Narva, Ida-Virumaa region, Estonia. The race starts and finishes at the sport township Akkekula (Nut Hill). Organized by the noncommercial sports club SK ETR, the event features certified trails by the Trailrunning International Association, offering ITRA points for finishers. The race includes multiple distances catering to different levels of trail runners, including an ultra-trail and shorter trail options.
course_highlights: Ultra-Trail distance of 126 km with 4 ITRA qualification points
Trail distance of 63 km with 2 ITRA qualification points
Trail distance of 33 km with 1 ITRA qualification point
additional: Reregistration is possible with a fee of 15 EUR plus any difference if changing distance. The race offers locker rooms, storage points, and an EXPO area. The Breakout® race for athletes with disabilities in a wheelchair had registration closed. The organizer reserves the right to use photos and videos taken during the event indefinitely. Üritusel on erinevad distantsid, sealhulgas ultramaraton, trail ja ratastoolisõit; registreerimine ja ajakava info saadaval veebilehel

name: Kalmar Malkars 21 km
description: Kalmar Malkars 21 km is a fast, single-loop half marathon that passes through many of Kalmar's beautiful environments and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational participants. The start and finish are at Malkars Training Center on Torsåsgatan, and the course offers views of the Kalmar Sound, Kalmar Castle, and the Öland Bridge. In addition to the half marathon, Malkars Femman (5 km) is also offered, which is open to walking, wheelchair users, and strollers — with a focus on joy of movement. Medals are awarded to all who complete the races.
course_highlights: Single-loop course passing Kalmar Castle and Kalmar Sound
Views of the Öland Bridge along Ängöleden
Fast course where many set personal records
additional: Start and finish at Malkars Training Center, Torsåsgatan 1, Kalmar. Bib distribution: Friday, June 26 from 15:00 to 17:00 and Saturday, June 27 from 12:00 to 15:00; late registration until June 25, thereafter possible at bib distribution. Payment methods for late registration: cash, card, or Swish. Water stations on the half marathon after 5, 10, 15, 18 km and at the finish line (Umara sports drinks and water). All who register for the 21.1 km by June 20 will receive a shirt at bib distribution. Medals to all finishers; ICA MAXI offers drinks, fruit, and chocolate after the race. Information: Jonne Svensson 070-693 87 44, Calle Nilsson 070-444 31 02. The half marathon includes hydration stations after 5, 10, 15, 18 km and at the finish; bibs are collected at designated times; late registration is open until June 25; payment via card, cash, or Swish; a shirt is offered to those registering before June 20; medals to all finishers.

name: Jordgubbslunken
description: The Strawberry Slush is a popular countryside race in Rudskoga with the motto "walk, stroll, run". The race offers Little Slush (6 km) and Big Slush (10 km) as well as a Mini Slush for children (born -17 or later). Start and finish are at Grunnebacka School, and the courses follow winding village roads through a beautiful cultural landscape. At the finish line, all participants receive a liter of strawberries, and there is a generous prize table as well as a high-value prize raffled off with the start number.
course_highlights: 6 km loop on gravel surface
10 km loop alternating between gravel road and well-maintained grass
Start and finish at Grunnebacka School; courses follow winding village roads through cultural landscape
additional: Always on the first Saturday after Midsummer; Categories for men, women, and children; Mini Slush for children born -17 or later; All participants receive a liter of strawberries at the finish; Generous prize table and a high-value prize raffled with the start number; Information about this year's race is published under "På gång i Rudskoga" on the website. The 6 km course has a gravel surface, while the 10 km course alternates between gravel road and well-maintained grass. Start at 15:00. Registration on site by 14:30 at the latest (on-site registration against a higher fee). Payment via Bankgiro 505-1404 or Swish 1233296605; questions can be directed to the provided phone numbers listed in the details.

name: Silverleden Ultra
description: Silverleden Ultra is a trail race in Hällefors/Bergslagen with distances of 64 km, 33 km, and 100 miles. The race will be held from June 26 to June 27, 2026, and is marketed under the slogans running joy - technical, hilly nature with lots of trails and climbing awaiting participants. The 100 miles race is fully booked for 2026. The organizer's language and information emphasize natural, demanding courses where proper equipment is recommended.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain with many climbs - the larger climbs are mainly in the second half of the course
Technical trail with roots and rocky surfaces; trail shoes with a coarse pattern are recommended
The course passes the control at Silvergruvan (mentioned as a control point after approximately 35 km)
additional: Practical: Bus to the start for the 33 km race departs from Hurtigtorpet at 10:30 and must be booked in advance (booking available until 2026-06-20); payment outside of card can be made to IBAN SE09 9020 0000 0906 0545 6739 with reference number from registration; limited parking spaces for caravans/motorhomes - notify via info@silverledenultra.se (limited access to electricity); relay registration not possible in 2026; minimum age 15 years (the year they turn) to participate, 33 km can be completed under supervision of a guardian even if younger; confirmation from the registration system serves as proof for health insurance benefits; equipment recommendations: trail shoes are recommended and metal studs are not recommended; poles are used by few but can be recommended for the second half of the course and can be delivered to the control at Silvergruvan. GPX and Strava links are available; maximum time 12 hours; energy stations along the course; map and course descriptions are available on the website.

name: Kustmaran (Kristianopel)
distance_verbose: Marathon, Halvmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 0.9 km
description: Kustmaran and Kristianopel Runt is a running festival for the whole family in the picturesque Kristianopel on the east coast, with distances from 0.9 km up to a marathon (42.2 km). The event will be held on June 27, 2026, and offers both competitive races and recreational options, as well as dedicated support from Team Blekinge's officials. The day combines running in an idyllic summer landscape with opportunities for swimming, dining, and accommodation in the area. Everyone is welcome, from children’s races and walks/'Sommarlunken' without timing to half and full marathons for more experienced runners.
course_highlights: Running in an idyllic summer landscape around the picturesque Kristianopel on the east coast
Range of courses: marathon (42.2 km), half marathon (21.1 km), 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 0.9 km (children's race), and Sommarlunken 4 km
Children's race takes place at Kristianopel Camping; opportunities for swimming and services in the village
additional: Number bibs can be collected and late registration can be done on race day from 08:00. Payment for regular registration is by card or Swish; for bank transfer, contact register@teamblekinge.nu before registration. Electronic timing is provided by Racetimer. Half marathon and marathon require participants to be at least 17 years old during the year. Sommarlunken is without timing and no medal is awarded; there are prize draws. Start times vary by distance; electronic timing; registration and payment options include card and Swish for regular registration, bank transfer via contact if needed; late registration via Swish or cash; parking outside Kristianopel; water and changing facilities, toilets, and medical services at the finish area; rules according to the Swedish Athletics Federation.

name: Kommunfastigheters Mälarspel
description: Kommunfastigheters Mälarspel is an athletics competition held at Ekängens athletics arena in Eskilstuna. The event gathers athletes of various ages and offers a welcoming and engaging atmosphere. The organizer, IFK Strängnäs, is a club with a long tradition in athletics and handball, and the event is characterized by good organization and camaraderie. Participants can expect a competition day focused on both performance and enjoyment.
course_highlights: The competition is held at Ekängens athletics arena, a well-equipped facility for athletics
Varied disciplines for different age groups and levels
Organized by IFK Strängnäs with extensive experience in athletics
additional: IFK Strängnäs is a club with both handball and athletics sections. The athletics section has approximately 50 active children and youth aged 6-16 years. Training takes place at Vasavallen during summer and at Paulinska and Munktell Arena during winter. The club is affiliated with Fritidskortet, a government subsidy for children and youth between 7 and 16 years old. Participants can register until May 25, 2025. The event is part of the MälarSeries and aims to promote athletics in the region.

name: XXXVII Cross Świętojański
location: Pogórze, Puck County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 37th Świętojański Cross named after Jan Marek in Pogórze is a traditional race organized by LKS Pogórze, scheduled to take place on June 27, 2026, at 6:00 PM. The event is held in the picturesque town of Pogórze and attracts runners who appreciate competition on trail routes. The organizers provide professional RFID timing measurement and comprehensive technical support, ensuring a smooth event. We invite all running enthusiasts to participate in this special sporting event.
course_highlights: Trail route through the scenic terrain of Pogórze
Professional RFID timing measurement
Start at 6:00 PM, allowing for a pleasant evening run
additional: Registrations close on June 21, 2026, at 11:59 PM. The organizer provides electronic timing at the start and finish lines, an electronic LED clock at the finish, and real-time results on the website. The race office services and bib number distribution are handled by the organizer. Registration ends on June 21, 2026. The event is open to various age groups, and the route likely runs through outdoor terrains in Pogórze.

name: Muraste jooks
location: Muraste Kooli staadion, Muraste, Harku vald, Harju maakond, Estonia
description: Muraste jooks on osa Harku valla jooksusarjast, mis toimub 28. juunil 2026 Muraste Kooli staadionil. Võistlusrada kulgeb mööda Muraste tänavaid ja kergliiklusteid, olles tähistatud ja avatud teedel. Distantsid on mitmekesised, sobides nii lastele kui täiskasvanutele, ning lisaks on võimalus osaleda perevõistlusel. Autasustatakse parimaid vanuseklassides ning sarja lõpetajad saavad hooajamedali. Korraldajaks on MTÜ TreeningPluss, kes paneb rõhku liikumisrõõmule ja sportlike eluviiside edendamisele.
course_highlights: Rada kulgeb mööda Muraste tänavaid ja kergliiklusteid
Rada on tähistatud ja kulgeb avatud teedel
Mitmekesised distantsid lastele ja täiskasvanutele
additional: Võistluskeskus avatakse kell 10:00. Stardimaterjalid väljastatakse kuni 15 minutit enne starti. Autasustamine toimub kell 13:30, kus autasustatakse kolme paremat meest ja naist igas vanuseklassis. Perevõistlusel osalevad ema, isa ja lapsed, kes koguvad punkte vanuseklasside alusel. Osalemine toimub omal vastutusel, alaealiste puhul lapsevanema vastutusel. Võistlusel osalemine on tasuta või tasuline, täpne info puudub. Registreerimine toimub eel- ja kohapeal, ning rada kulgeb Muraste tänavatel ja kergliiklusteedel.

name: Märgatud laps jooksmas
description: Heategevuslik jooksusari "Märgatud Laps jooksmas" toimub Kose lauluväljakul ja pakub osalejatele võimalust nautida sportlikku kogemust toetades samal ajal head eesmärki. Jooksusarja eesmärk on ühendada kogukond ning pakkuda rõõmu liikumisest kõigile vanusegruppidele. Üritus on avatud kõigile jooksuhuvilistele ning loob sõbraliku ja toetava atmosfääri.
course_highlights: Toetav ja sõbralik jooksusarja atmosfäär
Heategevuslik eesmärk ja kogukonna kaasamine
Korraldatud Kose lauluväljakul
additional: Jooks on suunatud kogukonna kaasamisele ja tervislike eluviiside edendamisele, osalejad saavad toetada heategevuslikku eesmärki.

name: Böda Sandsloppet
location: Böda Sand SportCamp, Böda Sand, Öland, Sweden
description: Böda Sandsloppet is a family-friendly fun run organized at Böda Sand on Öland by Högby IF athletics. The race offers several distances for adults and youth - 6.5 km and 4 km for adults, and 1.8 km and 1 km for youth - starting and finishing at Böda Sand SportCamp. All finishers receive a medal, and the highlight of the meal class is sausage after crossing the finish line. Registration is available via olandrunning.se or on-site, with the last registration day on June 26, 2026 (with late registration until July 1).
course_highlights: Forest terrain along Böda Sand area on Öland
Distance options for adults: 6.5 km and 4 km; for youth: 1.8 km and 1 km
All finishers receive a medal and sausage is served after the finish
additional: Start and finish at Böda Sand SportCamp. Last registration date June 26, 2026; late registration until July 1. Registration via olandrunning.se or on-site. Payment by cash, card, or Swish.

name: Byrundan
location: Unos Park, Gamleby, Västervik Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: The city run is a race held within Gamleby with start and finish in Unos Park. The event offers races for all ages and is well suited for both recreational runners and families. Welcome July 3, 2026 - registration opens soon.
course_highlights: Runs within Gamleby (urban environment)
Start and finish in Unos Park
Race for all ages
additional: Registration opens soon; start and finish in Unos Park; races offered for all ages; organizer's mailing address: C/o Lena Persson, Lapserums Gård, 594 92 Gamleby. The race is held indoors in Unos Park; registration opens soon for July 3, 2026.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 22. Emumäe jooks
description: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 ühendab tervisesportlasi ja liikumisharrastajaid kevadest sügiseni, pakkudes võimalust proovile panna oma võimed erinevates vanuseklassides ja distantsidel. 22. Emumäe jooks on sarja viies etapp, mis toimub 4. juulil Emumäel. Sarja eesmärk on populariseerida jooksmist ja tervisekõndi ning toetada kohalikke harrastajaid. Võistlused toimuvad mitmetel distantsidel, alates lühikestest lastesõitudest kuni põhijooksudeni kuni 10 km. Ajavõtt toimub kiibiga ning numbrid tuleb kinnitada kõhule või rinnale.
course_highlights: Mitmed distantsid alates 100 m kuni 10 km, sobilikud erinevatele vanusegruppidele
Ajavõtt kiibiga, numbrid kinnitatakse kõhule või rinnale
Sarja etapid toimuvad Lääne-Virumaa erinevates paikades, Emumäe jooks on viies etapp
additional: Eelregistreerimine toimub jooksusarja kodulehel, registreerimine lõpeb jooksule eelneval päeval kell 16:00. Võistluspaigas registreerimine toimub jooksu juhendis nimetatud kellaaegadel. Punktiarvestust ei peeta kõige noorematel distantsidel (Tillujooks, Minijooks, Lastejooks). Kiibid on kleebitud numbri tagaküljele ja kaetud vahuplaadiga, neid ei tohi eemaldada. Jooksusarja raames toimuvad erinevad distantsid ja kategooriad, osalejate arv on mitmekesine ning üritus on suunatud tervisliku eluviisi edendamisele ning kogukonna ühendamisele.

name: Võhma terviseraja maraton
location: Võhma, Põhja-Sakala vald, Viljandi County, Estonia
description: Võhma terviseraja maraton on maastikumaraton, mis toimub Võhma linna terviserajal. Rada on 620 meetrit pikk ring, mida tuleb läbida 68 korda, kokku 42,2 km. Jooks toimub 4. juulil 2026 algusega kell 9:00 ning pakub osalejatele medalit, ajavõttu, rajateenindust, toitlustamist finišis ja pesemise võimalust. Lisaks maratonile on võimalus joosta ka lühemat distantsi tasuta ja ilma aja fikseerimiseta, mis sobib kõigile liikumishuvilistele.
course_highlights: 620 meetri pikkune ring terviserajal
68 ringi läbimine maratoni distantsil (42,2 km)
Maastikuline rajakate
additional: Stardimaterjalide väljastamine toimub võistluspäeval alates kella 8:00. Osalejate arv on piiratud. 9:00 - 13:00 lubatakse rajale jooksjaid, kes soovivad läbida lühemat distantsi kui 42 km, neile on jooks tasuta ja aega ei fikseerita. Kõik, kes läbivad vähemalt 17 ringi (10,5 km), saavad medali. Maratoni distantsil võivad osaleda 2010. aastal ja varem sündinud liikumishuvilised. Ajavõtt on käsitsi. Ajalimiit on 6 tundi 30 minutit. Osalemistasu sisaldab medalit, ajavõttu, rajateenindust, toitlustamist finišis ja pesemise võimalust. Osalustasu saab tasuda sularahas stardipäeval või eelnevalt pangakontole. Eelmiste maratoni võitjate osalemine on tasuta. maastik, registreerimine e-posti teel, osalejate arv piiratud, medali ja teenuste sisaldus osalustasust

name: J. Lossmanni mälestusjooks
description: Jüri Lossmanni mälestusjooks on traditsiooniline jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Viljandis. Võistlus toimub 4. juulil 2026 algusega kell 19.00. Jooks on pühendatud Jüri Lossmannile ning pakub osalejatele võimalust nautida mõnusat suveõhtut ja sportlikku väljakutset.
course_highlights: Toimumiskoht Viljandi linnas
Õhtune start kell 19.00
Traditsiooniline mälestusjooks
additional: Jooks toimub õhtul ning on osa Eesti jooksukogukonna traditsioonidest, pakkudes osalejatele võimalust mälestada ja tähistada.
