description: The Run to Wronka on the Trail of Saint James is an annual running event held in the picturesque town of Wronka near Giżycko. The competition includes various age categories, including a 500-meter race for children and main races over 5 km and 10 km on gravel roads. Organizers provide a start package with a bib number, a medal, and a voucher for a recovery meal. The event has a family and community character, with routes leading through charming areas around Wronka.
course_highlights: Main race route on gravel roads
Children's distances of 500 m without timing measurement
Picturesque areas around Wronka near Giżycko
additional: Race office open from 8:00 to 11:30. The start package includes a bib number, a finisher's medal, and a voucher for a recovery meal prepared by the Wronka Village Housewives' Circle. There will be no timing or classification for the children's distances. A timing chip is to be returned at the finish line. Award ceremony and prize draw at 13:15. The 5 km and 10 km routes are available via Google Maps links. Registration is open until July 29, 2026. Participants can expect various start packages and attractive prizes.

name: Vääna-Jõesuu jooks
location: Vääna-Jõesuu Kooli staadion, Vääna-Jõesuu, Harku vald, Harju maakond, Estonia
description: Vääna-Jõesuu jooks on osa Harku valla jooksusarjast, mis toimub 2. augustil 2026 Vääna-Jõesuu kooli staadionil. Võistlusel on mitmed distantsid alates laste jooksudest kuni 5 km põhijooksuni, mis kulgeb mööda Vääna-Jõesuu tänavaid ja metsateed vastupäeva. Sarja eesmärk on motiveerida inimesi tegelema spordiga ning pakkuda liikumisrõõmu ja sportlikke eluviise. Võistluse korraldavad kohalikud jooksu- ja triatloniklubid koostöös valla ja külaseltsidega.
course_highlights: 5 km rada mööda Vääna-Jõesuu tänavaid ja metsateed
Rada kulgeb vastupäeva
Lastejooksud staadioniringidel (220 m ja 660 m)
additional: Võistluskeskus avatakse kell 11:00, põhijooksu start kell 12:00, autasustamine kell 13:00 ja lastejooksude stardid kell 13:30. Kohapeal registreerimine ja ümberregistreerimine on võimalik kuni 15 minutit enne starti. Autasustatakse kolme paremat meest ja naist igas vanuseklassis ning kolme parimat pere perearvestuses. Perevõistlusel osalevad ema, isa ja lapsed, kes koguvad punkte vanuseklasside kohtade põhjal. Rohkem infot registreerimise kohta ning ürituse toetajate ja loosiauhindade kohta on kättesaadav veebilehel. Osalejad vastutavad oma tervise eest ning üritus on avatud kõigile vanuserühmadele.

name: XI Bieg Wśród Krasnych Pól
organizer: Gminne Centrum Czytelnictwa i Kultury w Krasnopolu
description: The Run Among the Red Fields is a forest race organized in the Krasnopol municipality, offering routes of approximately 10 km and 5 km, as well as Nordic Walking over 5 km. The course runs exclusively on forest gravel and grassy roads, providing contact with nature and pleasant running conditions. The race office is located at the Municipal Reading and Culture Center in Krasnopol, and the start takes place in the afternoon. The race is open to all and organized with outdoor activity enthusiasts in mind.
course_highlights: Route of approximately 10 km and 5 km
Forest gravel and grassy roads
Start and finish in Krasnopol municipality
additional: The race office is open from 13:00 to 15:00 at the organizer's headquarters at 1 Maja Street 1 in Krasnopol. Parking is available in designated areas within the town, marked on the map. The running and Nordic Walking routes are free of charge; the organizer requests responsible registration. Race packets are distributed from 11:00 to 13:30. The event includes a 5 km Nordic Walking category, starting at 15:00 from the stadium at the Primary School in Krasnopol. Participation is free, and participants can support charitable causes.

name: KK-joggen / Sparbanksjoggen, Katrineholm
description: Sparbanksjoggen in Katrineholm is one of Sweden's leading recreational races and Katrineholm's largest sporting event with approximately 1500 participants and up to 8000 spectators. The race offers categories for both elite and recreational runners, with distances from 1.1 km for children to 10 km for adults. It is a well-organized running festival with prizes, medals, and T-shirts for all participants, and a friendly atmosphere with lots of spectators and officials. The race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association and follows their competition rules for children and youth.
course_highlights: Courses from 1.1 km for children to 10 km for adults
Measured 10 km course according to Swedish Athletics Association rules
Start and finish in Katrineholm city center with audience support
additional: Number bib and T-shirt are collected at the race office in Magasinet next to the Travel Center, Fabriksgatan 1, Katrineholm. The race office is open on August 4th from 12:00 to 18:00 and on August 5th from 11:00 to 21:00. After the finish, medals, chocolate bars, and bananas are handed out to all who complete the race. Prize money is awarded in the 10 km race to the top eight men and women as training grants to their athletics clubs. Sibling discounts and group registration with discounts are available. The race follows the Swedish Athletics Association's rules and is sanctioned. The race takes place on August 11, 2026, with registration at Magasinet near the Travel Center in Katrineholm. The event is a celebration for the entire municipality and attracts thousands of spectators and participants.

name: Filter Temposari (5. etapp)
description: Filter Temposari on Eesti vanim ja mainekaim temposari, mis pakub võimalust proovile panna end rattasõidus, jooksus või rulluisutamises. Sarja etapid toimuvad Tallinna ja selle ümbruse erinevates paikades, pakkudes eraldistardiga kiirusvõistlusi. Võistlused on lühikesed ja intensiivsed, sobides nii harrastajatele kui ka edasijõudnutele. Sarja raames on ka auhinnaprogramm Kullapada, mis premeerib stabiilset osalemist kõigil etappidel samal distantsil.
course_highlights: Eraldistardiga kiired rajad Tallinna ümbruses
Lühikesed 3 - 5 km jooksud ja 7 - 17 km rattarajad
Uus linnasprint Tallinna südames, 1,3 km rada tõusuga Toompeale
additional: Kümnendsekundi täpsusega ajavõtt. Võistluskeskuses tasuta soojenduspukid. Kuum Grupp: etapi viimased 10 minutit on reserveeritud parimatele ratturitele. Rajad ei ole autodele suletud, võistlejad peavad liiklusseadust järgima ja sõidutee parempoolses servas liikuma. Argument "mul ei ole temporatast" ei kehti - võib kasutada tavalist maanteeratast. Sündmus toimub mitmel erineval asukohal Tallinnas ning hõlmab ajasõite, sprindivõistlusi ja erisündmusi nagu linnasprint ning sarja auhinnad.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 20. Tapa linnajooks
description: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari on traditsiooniline jooksu- ja kõnnisari, mis pakub mitmekesiseid jooksuvõimalusi erinevatele vanuseklassidele ja tasemetele. Sarja etapid toimuvad erinevates Lääne-Virumaa paikades, pakkudes jooksjatele nii linnajooksu kui ka maastikujooksu elamusi. 20. Tapa linnajooks toimub 8. augustil 2026 Tapa Gümnaasiumi juures ning on osa sarja pikaajalisest traditsioonist, mis ühendab tervisesportlasi ja jooksuhuvilisi. Sarja eesmärk on motiveerida inimesi aktiivselt liikuma ning pakkuda meeldivaid jooksukogemusi.
course_highlights: Mitmekesine rada linnakeskkonnas
Sobib erinevatele vanuseklassidele ja tasemetele
Osa pika traditsiooniga jooksusarjast Lääne-Virumaal
additional: Sarjas on erinevad distantsid ja vanuseklassid, sh noortejooksud ja lastejooksud. Sarja etapid toimuvad erinevates paikades Lääne-Virumaal, kus on nii linnajooksud kui ka maastikujooksud. Registreerumine toimub tavaliselt veebivormide kaudu, kuid otsest registreerimislinki 20. Tapa linnajooksule ei leitud. Sarja kontaktisikud on Vahur Leemets ja Ainar Sepnik. Sündmus toimub Tapa Gümnaasiumil ning pakub registreerimisvõimalusi veebis. Osalejad saavad osaleda erinevatel distantsidel ning kõikidel etappidel toimub autasustamine.

name: Paldiski liigub
description: Paldiski liigub on Lääne-Harju Liikumissarja kolmas etapp, mis toimub Paldiski Spordikeskuses. Rada kulgeb mööda Paldiski tähtsamaid vaatamisväärsusi, tänavaid ja kergliiklusteid, pakkudes osalejatele kauneid loodusvaateid ja ajaloolist atmosfääri. Pere väiksematele on korraldatud tasuta lastejooksud, kus rõhutatakse liikumisrõõmu ja elukestvat liikumisteadlikkust. Sündmus toimub Paldiski linna päeva raames, kus autasustatakse sarja parimaid ning õhtu lõpetab kontsert.
course_highlights: Rada möödub Paldiski tähtsamatest vaatamisväärsustest
Kulgeb mööda tänavaid ja kergliiklusteid
Kaunid loodusvaated ja ajalooline atmosfäär
additional: Kiibiga ajavõtt on kasutusel, välja arvatud ajavõtuta distantsil. Lastejooksud on tasuta ja mõeldud 0-12 aastastele lastele, kus ei selgitata parimaid, vaid iga lõpetaja saab diplomi. Sündmus toimub koostöös Paldiski linna päevaga, kus on tegevusi kogu perele ning sarja esikolmikud autasustatakse suurel laval. Õhtu lõpetab kontsert. Lastejooksud on tasuta, rada möödub vaatamisväärsustest ning kasutusel on kiibiga ajavõtt (v.a ajavõtuta distants).

name: Ölands Marathon
description: Öland Marathon is an open marathon race starting and finishing at the square in Löttorp. The course is very flat and easy to run, completely paved, offering views towards Blå Jungfrun. The race consists of an inner loop of 2.1 km and an outer loop of 11.2 km, which are repeated three times to reach 42.195 km. The event is organized by Högby IF and is aimed at recreational runners and veteran classes according to specified categories.
course_highlights: Very flat and easy-to-run marathon course
100% asphalt, measured by federation course measurer Carl-Gustaf Nilsson
Start and finish at the square in Löttorp; 2.1 km inner loop + 11.2 km outer loop repeated 3 times, view towards Blå Jungfrun
additional: Number bibs can be collected from 12:00. Three water stations per lap (approximately 13.3 km) offering sports drink (Umara), Coca-Cola, and water; personal energy supplements must be submitted at least one hour before start. All finishers receive a medal/fossil in Öland limestone; ÖM medals for the top two in each category. Winners in the women's and men's categories will receive a dinner for two at Kalk in Löttorp. Accommodation is available in 4-bed cabins at Högby IP. Water stations: three per lap. The course consists of a 2.1 km stretch in Löttorp followed by an 11.2 km stretch Löttorp - Alvedsjö - Kalmarsund - Gudesjö - Löttorp, repeated three times for a total of 42.195 km. Start and finish at the square in Löttorp; accommodation information available via links on the organizer's website.

name: Svartåloppet
description: Svartåloppet is a recurring recreational race held on the second Saturday of August, attracting runners over several distances. The race offers 14 km and 5.5 km courses on hilly forest roads and trails, as well as a flat 2.5 km loop on roads. The start and finish are at Svartå Folketshus, and timing is managed by Racetimer, providing modern and reliable results. The event is aimed at both recreational runners and competitive participants, highlighting local nature and the network of climbs.
course_highlights: 14 km and 5.5 km: hilly forest trail on forest roads and trails
2.5 km: flatter loop on roads
Start and finish at Svartå Folketshus
additional: Timing for Svartåloppet is handled by Racetimer, and results from previous years are published via Racetimer. The event is held annually on the second Saturday of August. Contact with the event organizers is provided by Svartå Utvecklingsgrupp, phone number 076 3073096. Three distances; medals and goodie bags for children; registration on site during designated times (09:00 - 10:30) as per event materials.

name: Ångaloppet Trail
description: Ångaloppet is a welcoming swimrun event at Ånga gård with the goal "swimrun for everyone". The 2026 races will be held on August 8 and include several distances and events for different levels, including 22 km, 11 km, Trail, 5 km, and Family. The courses offer varied nature with forest trails, gravel roads, and hilly technical terrain; the swimrun races also include multiple swimming sections in both lake and sea. Organizers emphasize an inviting atmosphere for participants of all ages and experience levels.
course_highlights: Varied forest, trails, and gravel roads
Hilly and technical terrain suitable for trail running
Location between Lake Ången and the Baltic Sea - a combination of running and swimming (for swimrun distances)
additional: The event in 2026 consists of five races on the same day (August 8): 22 km, 11 km, Trail, 5 km, and Family. For the 22 km race: loop course (11 km per lap), approximately 20 swimming sections (the longest about 190 m, the shortest about 30 m), six water stations along the course, and a cut-off time at the turn of 2.5 hours. Team changes are possible for a fee of 400 SEK - email info@angaloppet.se. The courses are marked and the start group 1 (earliest start) is scheduled for 10:00 AM. Ångaloppet Trail is a new distance in the 2026 program. Team changes possible for a fee of 400 SEK. More information about equipment, safety, accommodation, and parking can be found on the race website.

name: Stora Stöten Run
description: Stora Stöten Run is a trail race in the World Heritage Site Falu Gruva offering a historic and varied running experience. The course passes medieval smelting sites, miners' farms, dams, and dam houses, following old waterway systems called Vattnets Väg to the Mine. The race has three distances (21.6 km, 13.6 km, and 5.6 km) and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners, with options for timing or running untimed. The organizer is the orienteering club OK Kåre, welcoming participants to the start and finish at Falu Gruva.
course_highlights: Three courses: 21.6 km, 13.6 km, and 5.6 km with start/finish at Falu Gruva
The course passes medieval smelting sites, miners' farms, dams, and dam houses along Vattnets Väg
Varied terrain: gravel, grass, trail, natural path, and short asphalt sections; initial ascent and clear downhill sections
additional: Start and finish at Falu Gruva; warm-up begins at 12:10 on the red-painted asphalt field at Falu Rödfärg (approximately 7 minutes) led by Friskis & Svettis; all courses start simultaneously and runners are divided into two voluntary groups based on finish pace (group 1: women ≤6 min/km, men ≤5 min/km). Optional to run with or without timing; prizes for the top three in each course and raffle prizes for other participants; possibility to register a team (3 persons) and transfer registration free of charge via the registration system; energy stations/water points, parking, race office, showers/change facilities, and course markings are mentioned in the race information. Three courses with start and finish at Falu Gruva; results from previous years are available.

name: Häv och Gräv Vikbovändan 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: vuxen 470 kr (fram till den 30/6, sedan kostar loppet 520 kr)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: duoklass: 940 kr per par (fram till den 30/6, sedan kostar duolopp 1040 kr)

description: Häv & Gräv Vikbovändan is a summer race on Vikbolandet in Östergötland where participants can choose to run or cycle. The main route is approximately 45 km long and largely runs on country roads and gravel (about 50/50), with several energy stations and tastings from local farms along the way. There are categories for runners, cyclists, duos, and children, and the event has a clear focus on local producers and a genuine farm environment. Registered participants receive a foldable cup (reusable mug) to bring during the race to avoid disposable cups.
course_highlights: Main route approximately 45 km, about 50/50 gravel and asphalt
Energy stations at several local farms with delicacies and opportunities for farm visits
Opportunities for meetings and tastings at farms with animals (ostriches, alpacas, llamas)
additional: Limited number of participants in the main race (300). Online registration is open until August 4; late registration can be done from 09:00 at the start area until 30 minutes before each start signal (if spots are available). Registered participants receive a foldable cup that must be used during the race. The children's race (approximately 700 m or 1,400 m) does not require prior registration and is free of charge thanks to ICA's sponsorship (children receive a medal and ice cream). Toilets and showers are available at APPTEK's premises (open approximately 09:30 - 18:30). The running category has timing and prizes for the top three in both women’s and men’s categories; cycling and duo categories have specific rules (helmet mandatory, e-bike not allowed, duo pairs can exchange unlimited times but must keep a maximum distance of 100 m). Group warm-up before start. Energy stations with water and sports drinks; registered participants receive a foldable cup; medals for all; not sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association; helmet mandatory when cycling; start/finish in a trail environment with lighting; medical staff present; rules regarding image rights. Register at vikbovandan.se/472-2/ or via the registration page on the main website.

name: Träslottsloppet 2025
description: Träslottsloppet is a running race held in Arbrå as a collaboration between Rehns BK and Vallsta SK. The race takes place on Saturday, August 8, 2026, with the first start at 10:00 AM. There are several categories and running distances, and registration is done via an external registration page. Results are published after the race on the same platform.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the area around Träslottet in Arbrå
Collaborative event between Rehns BK and Vallsta SK
Start time at 10:00 AM on race day
additional: Registered participants and results are published at https://ext.nytatime.se/race/?race=sTPSHKT3XSrw4SDZ5. The race has several categories and running distances according to the invitation. The event is a collaboration between Rehns BK and Vallsta SK. The race takes place in Arbrå, with information about categories and distances in the invitation. Registration can be done via the link or on site. Prices include dinner and lunches.

name: Blodomloppet (Jönköping)
description: Welcome to the Blood Race in Jönköping - a recreational race to raise awareness of the need for blood donation where you can walk, jog, or run. In Jönköping, timed races are offered at 5 km and 10 km, as well as a 5 km walk without timing. For children, there is the Little Blood Race (approximately 700 meters) which has a common start and medal. The race gathers participants in teams and traditionally ends with a picnic.
course_highlights: Selectable distances: 5 km and 10 km (with timing) as well as a 5 km walk (without timing)
Little Blood Race: approximately 700 meters for children up to 12 years, common start and medal; start from Knektaparken
Event area at Knektaparken with a traditional common picnic after the finish line
additional: Team registration consists of 3 - 5 participants; registered blood donors receive a 40 SEK discount if indicated at registration. Changes (e.g., from 10 km to 5 km) cost 50 SEK upon modification and presenting the order ID during pickup; on the day of the race (August 11), only Swish or cash payment are accepted. Payment terms are otherwise 30 days with multiple options (Swish, card via Swedbank Pay, postal giro, invoice). Team registration and individual registrations have different prices; discounts for blood donors and a fee for invoice. Bib numbers are collected at Hovslätts IK's clubhouse or at the start, and the award ceremony takes place at 19:30.

name: 14. ETAPP / Järve terviserada
description: 14. ETAPP / Järve terviserada on 10-etapiline teatejooks ümber Viljandi järve, mis toimub vahelduval maastikul ja erineva pinnakattega terviserajal. Võistkonnad koosnevad 10 liikmest, kus on võrdselt naisi ja mehi, kes vaheldumisi jooksavad erinevaid etappe. Start ja finiš on Viljandi linnastaadionil ning etappidele viivad jooksjaid korraldajate bussid. Võistlus on osa Suurjooksu ümber Viljandi järve traditsioonist ja pakub sportlikku kogemust nii koolidele, ettevõtetele kui spordiklubidele.
course_highlights: 10-etapiline teatejooks ümber Viljandi järve terviserajal
Vahelduv maastik ja erinevad pinnakattega rajad
Etappide pikkused vahemikus 500 m kuni 1950 m
additional: Võistkonnad koosnevad 10 liikmest (5 naist ja 5 meest), kus paaritute numbritega etappidel jooksevad naised ja paaris numbritega etappidel mehed. Asutuste ja ettevõtete võistkondades võib meeste etappidel erandkorras kasutada naisvõistlejat. Stardimaks asutustele/ettevõtetele ja spordiklubidele on 50€, koolide võistkondadel stardimaks puudub. Võistkondade registreerimine toimub e-posti teel kuni 12. aprillini ning jooksjate nimeline registreerimine 14. aprillil staadionil. Autasustamine toimub kell 13:30 staadionil, kus autasustatakse kolme paremat võistkonda karikate ja diplomitega ning iga võistlejat medaliga. Vastavalt rajaoludele võib võistlustrass muutuda, et vältida poriseid või lumiseid lõike. 10-etapiline teatejooks Viljandi järve ümbruses, vahelduv maastik, registreerimine e-posti teel, start ja finiš Viljandi linnastaadionil

name: ÜLEMISTE Ööjooks - Tallinn 2026
description: ÜLEMISTE Ööjooks - Tallinn 2026 on jooksu- ja kõnnisündmus, mis toimub Ülemiste piirkonnas Tallinnas. See üritus pakub võimalust liikumiseks ja hea enesetunde ning tervise toetamiseks. Sündmus on osa laiemast liikumisharrastuse edendamise algatusest Eestis, mida korraldab Liikumisharrastuse Kompetentsikeskus. Osalejad saavad nautida aktiivset liikumist linnakeskkonnas ning toetada oma vaimset ja füüsilist tervist.
course_highlights: Jooks ja kõnd Ülemiste piirkonnas Tallinnas
Hea võimalus liikumiseks ja tervise toetamiseks
Korraldatud Liikumisharrastuse Kompetentsikeskuse poolt
additional: Osalemine hõlmab jooksmist ja käimist, registreerimine on avatud

name: Vetlanda Citylopp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dam-, herr- och motionsklassen (10 km och 5 km) 180 kr

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kids F8/P8 - F12/P12 (1 km till 1,7 km) 100 kr

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Föreningar (max 15st per anmälan) 900 kr (Föreningar kan anmäla i F/P8-F/P12 samt Junior 5km)

description: Vetlanda Citylopp is an open and spectator-friendly city race scheduled for August 14, 2026, with start and finish on Storgatan in Vetlanda. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km on an easy-to-run loop course, and there are several children and youth categories as well as a Funktionsklass (disability class). Number bibs can be collected and late registration is available at Stortorget from 12:00 on race day, and the event is combined with activities and light food service at the square. We photograph and film during the race, and images may be used in future marketing.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Storgatan in the center of Vetlanda
Easy-to-run, spectator-friendly loop course (5 km or 10 km)
Children and youth distances from 400 m up to 1.7 km as well as a 1 km Funktionsklass
additional: Number bibs can be collected and late registration is available at Stortorget from 12:00 on race day. Late registration can be done no later than 30 minutes before the respective start time, with on-site payment possible via Swish (additional fee applies for late registration). Timing is done with a chip in the bib by Racetimer, and results are published live on Racetimer's website as well as on OK Njudung's website. The event includes activities and light food service at the square; the organizer photographs and films during the race. Participants can walk/jog/run at their own pace; late registration on site for a fee; photography/filming during the race that may be used in marketing.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 27. Viru-Nigula Rahvajooks
location: Viru-Nigula jooksurada ja kaugushüppekast, Viru-Nigula, Lääne-Virumaa, Estonia
description: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 pakub mitmekesist jooksu- ja kõnnisarja, mis ühendab tervisesportlasi ja harrastajaid kevadest sügiseni. 27. Viru-Nigula Rahvajooks toimub Viru-Nigula jooksurajal ja kaugushüppekastis ning on osa pika traditsiooniga sarjast, mis julgustab osalema erinevates vanuseklassides ja distantsidel. Sarja eesmärk on toetada tervislikke eluviise ning pakkuda võimalust oma võimete proovile panekuks. Jooksusarja etapid on hästi korraldatud, ajavõtt toimub kiibiga ning osalejatele on tagatud meeldiv ja motiveeriv jooksukogemus.
course_highlights: Mitmekülgsed distantsid alates 100 m kuni 10 km
Jooksurajad Viru-Nigula jooksurajal ja kaugushüppekastis
Traditsiooniline jooksusarja etapp, kus vahetub jooksu suund
additional: Ajavõtt toimub kiibiga, mis on kleebitud numbri tagaküljele ja kaetud vahuplaadiga. Numbrid tuleb kinnitada kõhule või rinnale, mitte seljale. Võistlusklassid on vanusepõhised ja punktiarvestus toimub eraldi vanuseklassides. Registreerumine toimub jooksusarja kodulehel ja lõpeb jooksule eelneval päeval kell 16:00. Võistluspaigas on võimalik registreeruda jooksu juhendis nimetatud kellaaegadel. Võistlusel on erinevad distantsid alates 500 m kuni 27 km ning autasustamine kõigi vanuseklasside esikolmikutele.

name: Midnattsloppet Stockholm
description: Midnattsloppet Stockholm is a festive evening race on Södermalm held on August 15, 2026, offering 21 km, 10 km, and 5 km distances, as well as several children’s and disability-friendly races. The race is characterized by late start times, music, spectators, and activities along the course, creating a unique and lively atmosphere. The 21 km class runs two laps of the Midnattsloppet 10 km course around Södermalm, which is described as relatively hilly. The organizer emphasizes community, running joy, and that the event suits both competitive runners and recreational athletes.
course_highlights: 21 km = two laps of the Midnattsloppet 10 km course around Södermalm
Relatively hilly course - inclines and the character of the district
Music, samba rhythms, and spectators along the course create a festival atmosphere
additional: Start/ warm-up location: Ringvägen 26. Finish line: Hornsgatan 57. The registration fee includes a t-shirt from Björn Borg (this year's color/print), precise timing, sports drinks and water along the course, as well as a cold Vitamin Well, fruit, and energy bar at the finish; medals can be purchased during registration and a digital diploma is offered. There is an option to use wellness providers (Benifex, Epassi, Benefits) and instructions for redemption codes are available; group registration grants a 50 SEK discount per person. Information about start groups, shirts, race kits, and dedicated pages for companies can be found on the organizer’s website. The digital Midnattsloppet runs from September 12 to September 20.

name: 6 sjöar
location: Fjällnora friluftsgård, Uppsala Municipality, Uppsala County, Sweden
description: Six Lakes is a volunteer-organized running event held on August 15, 2026, starting and finishing at Fjällnora Outdoor Recreation Area outside Uppsala. You can choose between a marathon (42 km around six lakes), half marathon (21 km around four lakes), 10.3 km, or a shorter 5.5 km course around Ramsen – all routes are well marked and feature varied forest trails and gravel roads. The race is environmentally friendly (few disposable cups, option to get a reusable cup or Hydrapouch) and offers free direct buses from Uppsala Central Station; the organizers work voluntarily. It is a nature-oriented race where swimming along the course may be possible in warm weather, and the start times are scheduled so that different distances can be run simultaneously by families and friends.
course_highlights: Marathon around six lakes; half marathon around four lakes – scenic views by several waters
Easy-to-run courses mostly on small gravel roads and shorter trails, with some technical sections (5 km has tricky trails and bridges)
Opportunity to take a dip along the course in warm weather and water stations on the routes
additional: Start and finish at Fjällnora Outdoor Recreation Area. Start times: Marathon 10:00, Half Marathon 10:30, 10 km 11:00, 5 km 11:30. Bibs can be collected at Uppsala Central Station Thursday – Friday before the race from 11:00 to 19:00 or on site no later than 30 minutes before the start. Free direct buses from Uppsala Central Station (fossil fuel-free) and information/timetable are published by the organizer. The race avoids disposable cups – bring your own bottle or get a free reusable cup/Hydrapouch; no free T-shirts but the option to purchase one after finishing. The event is organized voluntarily; questions can be directed to info@6sjoar.se, and contact details for registration are provided on the contact page. The race offers detailed maps and GPX files via the 'Choose Race' page; fewer disposable cups and a reminder to bring your own bottle or use Hydrapouch. Registration is online, and bibs are collected at Uppsala Central Station or before the start.

name: XXI Bieg Lesoków
description: The 21st Lesoków Run is an annual race organized in Szemud, part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The event offers two routes of 5 km and 10 km, which lead through picturesque areas of Kashubia, encouraging active outdoor recreation. The event attracts runners of various age groups and skill levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and local running culture.
course_highlights: Routes lead through charming areas of Kashubia
Available distances: 5 km and 10 km
The race takes place in the scenic surroundings of Szemud
additional: The event will take place on August 16, 2026, with online registration available from December 2025. The run is part of the regional Kaszuby Biegają series, promoting physical activity in Kashubia.

name: 15. ETAPP / Vabaõhumuuseum
description: Tervisejooks ja -kõnd on mitmeetapiline jooksu- ja kõnnivõistlus, mis toimub erinevates Tallinna piirkondades, sealhulgas Vabaõhumuuseumis. Iga etapp pakub võimalust nautida kauneid loodusradu ja tervisespordi rõõmu. Vabaõhumuuseumi etapp on 4,2 km pikk ning sobib hästi nii jooksjatele kui ka kõndijatele, kes soovivad aktiivselt aega veeta värskes õhus. Üritus on traditsiooniline ja avatud kõigile tervisespordi huvilistele.
course_highlights: 4,2 km pikkune rada Vabaõhumuuseumi territooriumil
Mõnus looduslik ja rahulik keskkond
Sobib nii jooksjatele kui ka kõndijatele
additional: Etapid toimuvad erinevatel nädalatel, iga etapi registreerimisperiood kestab tavaliselt ühe nädala. Võistlus toimub virtuaalselt, võimaldades osaleda sobival ajal registreerimisperioodi jooksul. Sündmus on osa tervisesarja, mille eesmärk on edendada tervislikke eluviise ning pakkuda osalejatele meeldivaid ja tervist toetavaid kogemusi ajaloolises keskkonnas.

name: Convinistafetten
location: Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Welcome to the Convinistafetten in Stockholm - a festive and team-building relay race at Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården. The event takes place over two late summer evenings (August 19-20, 2026), and each team consists of five people, with each participant running 5 km. There is also a walk category for those who prefer to walk together. As an extra highlight, title sponsor Convini offers all teams a picnic after crossing the finish line.
course_highlights: Five legs of 5 km each - each team member runs 5 km
Start and finish area at the exchange zone in Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården
Picnic on the grass after crossing the finish line (Convini provides all teams)
additional: Registration is per team (5 persons). The walk team starts separately, and everyone in the walk team walks 5 km together. The team leader registers the team and receives information as well as all five bib numbers by mail; the runner of the last leg picks up the picnic box at the picnic tent. The picnic is included in the registration (details announced in May), and extra picnic boxes can be booked for 495 SEK each. Tents (Basic or Premium) can be booked as optional add-ons; orders are confirmed and tent placement communicated before the event. The age limit for running 5 km is 13 years. A walk category is available; start times are according to bib number (e.g., first team at 17:30, later at 17:33, 17:36); chip timing on the bib; changing rooms at Frescati Sports Center for 40 SEK; RSIF offers a subsidized member price with a deadline of August 16 at 18:00 for discount code; parking and public transport information is available.

name: BAUHAUS-galan Youth & Masters
location: Stockholms stadion, Stockholm, Stockholm Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: BAUHAUS-galan Youth & Masters is a prestigious athletics competition held at Stockholm Stadium, one of the world's most iconic athletics venues. The event welcomes youth aged 12 to 19 as well as veterans aged 35 and older, including para-athletics. With an atmosphere characterized by a gala feel and camaraderie, the event offers excellent competition conditions on Sweden's fastest running tracks. Participants have the chance to compete in an environment where world elite athletes also meet during the BAUHAUS-galan Diamond League.
course_highlights: Competition at Stockholm Stadium, the world's oldest active Olympic arena
High-tech VMAX running tracks from Conica for a fast and even surface
Competition disciplines for youth, veterans, and para-athletics
additional: The spectator area opens preliminarily at 14:00 with preliminary competitions from 16:30 and main events from 17:00. The event includes a family festival with activities and food service. It is recommended to reach the stadium by public transport, walking, or cycling. Safety measures are well planned with staff and medical teams on site. Includes live results, live streaming, and social events such as After Track.

name: IRONKIDS Tallinn 2026
location: Rocca Al Mare Kaubanduskeskus, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: IRONKIDS Tallinn 2026 on laste jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Rocca Al Mare Kaubanduskeskuse ja Unibet Arena ümbruses. Võistlus on mõeldud erinevatele vanuseklassidele, pakkudes kolme distantsi: 350 m, 830 m ja 1500 m jooksu. Stardid toimuvad mass- ja jooksva stardina, eraldi poistele ja tüdrukutele, ning osalejad peavad kandma korraldaja poolt antud särki. Võistlusel on professionaalne korraldus, ajavõtt pikematel distantsidel ning auhinnad ja diplomid finišeerijatele.
course_highlights: Jooksurajad kulgevad Rocca al Mare keskuse ja Unibet Arena ümbruses asuvatel teedel
400m distantsil mass-start, 830m ja 1500m jooksva start intervalliga
Eraldi arvestus poistele ja tüdrukutele vanuseklasside kaupa
additional: Kohapeal registreerimine ja materjalide väljastamine toimub 19. augustil kell 14.00-19.00 ja 20. augustil kell 10.00-18.30 Rocca al Mare keskuses. Osalejad peavad kandma korraldaja poolt antud särki ning võistlusnumber peab olema rinnale kinnitatud. Stardigrupid on tähistatud värvilise täpiga rinnanumbril. Osavõtumaks sisaldab professionaalset korraldust, ajavõttu 830m ja 1500m distantsidel, finišeerija auhinda ning elektroonilist diplomit. Osalemine on avatud lastele sündinud alates 2019. aastast, registreerimine lõpeb 18. augustil 2026, osalejate maksimumarv on 1800.

name: 10. Üts Ummamuudu liina üüjuusk-kõnd
description: 10. Üts Ummamuudu liina üüjuusk-kõnd on liikumisharrastuse sündmus Võru linnas, mis hõlmab jooksmist, kepikõndi ja kõndimist. Üritus on osa Liikumisharrastuse Kompetentsikeskuse tegevustest, mille eesmärk on edendada aktiivset eluviisi ja tervist. Sündmus kutsub osalema kõiki, kes soovivad parandada oma heaolu ja nautida liikumist erinevates eluetappides. Võru maakonna kaunis loodus loob meeldiva tausta liikumiseks.
course_highlights: Võru linna ja maakonna maastikud
Sobib jooksmiseks, kepikõndimiseks ja kõndimiseks
Liikumine hea enesetunde ja tervise nimel
additional: Võru linn, Võrumaa; osavõtutasud: tasuta lastele, teistele 2 eurot; registreerimine Stebby kaudu; kiibiajavõtt ja osavõtutingimused on olemas

name: Sunset Run 2026
description: Sunset Run on 5 km pikkune jooksu- ja kepikõnniüritus, mis toimub Stroomi ranna kergliiklusteedel ja Unibet Arena lähedal Tallinnas. Võistlus toimub Eesti Kergejõustikuliidu võistlusmääruste järgi ning osaleda võivad kõik piisavalt treenitud huvilised. Distantsi võib läbida joostes, käies või kepikõndi tehes, kus käijad ja kepikõndijad stardivad osalejate rivi lõpus. Võistlusel on eraldi arvestus erinevates vanuseklassides nii meestele kui naistele. Korraldajateks on MTÜ Sportlik Eesti ja MTÜ Triatloniakadeemia, kes tagavad professionaalse korralduse ja osalejate mugavuse.
course_highlights: 5 km distants Stroomi ranna kergliiklusteedel
Võimalus läbida joostes, käies või kepikõndi tehes
Võistlus toimub õhtusel ajal kell 20:30
additional: Registreerimine toimub internetis kuni 18. augustini 2026 kell 23:59. Kohapeal registreerimine ja stardimaterjalide väljastamine toimub 19. augustil kell 14:00-19:00 ja võistluspäeval 20. augustil kell 10:00-17:00 Rocca al Mare keskuses ning 20. augustil kell 18:30-20:15 Stroomi rannahoone juures. Ümberregistreerimine on võimalik lisatasu eest (10 €) kuni 18.08.2026. Osavõtumaksu tasumine toimub pangalingi kaudu registreerimisankeedi täitmise järgselt. Võistlusel on vanuseklasside arvestus ning osalemine toimub omal vastutusel. Race includes options for running, walking, and Nordic walking; registration online and on-site; start at 20:30; terrain on coastal paths and promenade.

name: Hagbloms Nattloppet
description: Hagbloms Night Run in Kalmar is a night race of 5.0 km that offers a atmospheric running experience along the streets of Kalmar with music, lighting, and surprises along the course. Start and finish are at Stortorget, and the race is open to walkers, joggers, and competitive runners. Everyone who completes the race receives the Night Run medal, and those who register by August 16th also receive the race's unique shirt. The organizer is Högby IF (athletics).
course_highlights: Start, lap, and finish at Stortorget in Kalmar
5.0 km in city environment along Kalmar's streets with music, lighting, and surprises
Walking class 5 km without timing offered
additional: Number bib and late registration can be collected at the Högby tent on Stortorget Thursday, August 20th from 15:00 to 17:00 and Friday, August 21st from 18:00; on-site late registration is accepted until 1 hour before the start. All participants receive a medal, drink, fruit, and a chocolate bar from ICA MAXI. Payment can be made by card, cash, or Swish. Contact information: Högby IF / friidrott@hogbyif.se, Jonne Svensson 070-693 87 44, Calle Nilsson 070-444 31 02. Walking class 5 km without timing; number bib and late registration at the Högby tent on Stortorget August 20th from 15:00 to 17:00 and August 21st from 18:00; a unique night race shirt for pre-registrants until August 16th; drinks, fruit, and chocolate for all participants.

name: Karlskronaspelen
description: Karlskronaspelen is a popular athletics competition held in Karlskrona. The event welcomes both members and non-members and offers a fun and action-packed weekend with athletics training, play, and competition. The event is characterized by volunteer engagement where participants and parents are expected to contribute as officials. It is a great opportunity for youth to develop in athletics and participate in a well-organized competition weekend.
course_highlights: Held in Karlskrona, a beautiful coastal city
Includes various competition categories for runners and athletes
The event takes place on August 21, 2026
additional: The competition takes place in a volunteer-driven club environment where all active participants and parents are expected to help as officials. In 2026, a new format will be tested where different groups are responsible for different disciplines. There is also an official schedule for the competition days. Scandic Karlskrona offers discounted accommodation during the competition weekend. The event is open to participants of various ages and levels, and provides an inspiring competitive environment in a scenic setting.

name: Lüganuse rahvajooks
location: Kiviõli keskväljak, Kiviõli, Lüganuse vald, Ida-Viru maakond, Estonia
description: Lüganuse Rahvajooks on osa Ida-Viru jooksusarjast, mis toimub Kiviõli keskväljakul. Võistlusel on mitmed distantsid alates lastejooksust kuni 9 km jooksuni, sobides erinevatele vanuseklassidele ja oskustasemetele. Osalejad saavad nautida sõbralikku ja kogukondlikku atmosfääri ning võimalust võistelda sõpruskondade arvestuses. Registreerimine on lihtne ja osalustasu taskukohane, mis teeb sellest suurepärase sündmuse nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele.
course_highlights: Mitmed distantsid: 300m lastejooksust kuni 9 km jooksuni
Võistlus toimub Kiviõli keskväljakul
Sõpruskondade arvestus ja kogukondlik võistlusmoment
additional: Osalejatele on avatud Bronto lastejooks 300m, 2 km, 5 km ja 9 km distantsid. Võistluskeskus avatud sekretariaat 10:30-11:55. Autasustamine toimub 15 minutit pärast viimase võistleja finišit kõigile vanuseklassidele koos. Võistlejad osalevad omal riisikol. Osalustasu saab tasuda kohapeal sularahas või Stebbys. Võistlus toimub Kiviõli keskväljakul, registreerimine on avatud nii online kui ka kohapeal, ning osalejad saavad valida erinevate distantside vahel.

name: Stockholm Trail
location: Hammarbyhöjdens IP, Stockholm Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Do you dream of winding trails, sunlit rocky outcrops, and lovely slopes? Stockholm Trail offers several well-marked trail runs in the beautiful Nacka Nature Reserve with start and finish at Hammarbyhöjden's sports field, near Stockholm city. The course is suitable for both experienced trail runners and recreational runners who want to try trail running. Welcome to a challenging, sweaty, and memorable trail event with encouraging staff and good service.
course_highlights: Technical forest trails and beautiful rocky outcrops with fantastic views in Nacka Nature Reserve
Start and finish at Hammarbyhöjden's sports field, about a 5-minute walk from Hammarbyhöjden subway station
Multiple hydration stations (Umara sports drink) and bib with your name
additional: Start and finish at Hammarbyhöjden's sports field; bibs can be collected on Friday 21/8 at Best Western Park City Hammarby Sjöstad from 16:00 to 19:00 or at the venue from 09:00 on race day. Wooden medal from Raw Cut Studio for finishers. Bag drop (supervised, free); possibility to shower and change indoors. Name change and course transfer free of charge until August 8 (contact sekretariat@stockholmtrail.se). Age limit 18 years for the 21K; maximum times: 4 hours for 21K and 3 hours for 10K. Hydration stations with water and Umara sports drink: 21K passes 5 stations, 10K 3 stations, 5K 1 station. Premium package with T-shirt and training sessions available; T-shirt can be purchased separately (349 SEK). Results published online immediately after finish; announcer, music, and refreshments at the venue. Distances include 21K, 10K, 5K, 5K Fun Run, and 2.5K Minitrail; start/finish at Hammarbyhöjden's sports field; hydration and energy stations along the course; baggage drop and bib pickup; finish area offers drinks, coffee, refreshments, as well as indoor shower and changing facilities; no T-shirt sales at the venue this year (purchase in Bagheeras shop).

name: Hjorthagen Ultra Trail 100
description: Hjorthagen Ultra Trail 100 is an ultramarathon in Lill‑Jansskogen in Stockholm with selectable distances of 50 or 100 miles. The race emphasizes endurance, nature experiences, and community, and is organized by Nisse and Anna Larsson through the association Hjorthagen Ultra SC. The start and finish are located at Stora Skuggans väg 22, with ample parking and proximity to subway and buses. The start times are 09:00 for 100 miles and 14:00 for 50 miles.
course_highlights: Magical forest sections in Lill‑Jansskogen
Steep hills and many elevation meters
Start/finish at Stora Skuggans väg 22 with good access to parking and public transport
additional: Maximum times are 32 hours for 100 miles and 16 hours for 50 miles. Max 100 participants. Start times: 100 miles at 09:00 and 50 miles at 14:00. Surplus proceeds to Suicide Zero.

name: Sandviken Halvmaraton
description: The first edition of Sandviken Half Marathon, be part of making history! 21.1 km around Sandviken, along meadows, lakes, and beautiful residential areas. The course has an elevation change of only 74 meters, with start and finish in Stadsparken Sandviken where there will be activities for the whole family.
course_highlights: 21.1 km around Sandviken
Runs along meadows, lakes, and residential areas
Elevation change of only 74 meters
Start and finish in Stadsparken Sandviken
Activities for the whole family
additional: The first edition of Sandviken Half Marathon, be part of making history! 21.1 km around Sandviken, along meadows, lakes, and beautiful residential areas. The course has an elevation change of only 74 meters, with start and finish in Stadsparken Sandviken where there will be activities for the whole family.

images.alt_text: Sandviken Halvmaraton logotyp med texten "GÄSTRIKELAND 2026 SANDVIKEN HALV-MARATHON"

name: Kvarnsvedenspelen
description: Kvarnsvedenspelen is an athletics competition held at Kvarnsvedens IP in Borlänge. The event is part of Mittsvenska's series and primarily targets youth aged 7-11 and 13-17 years. The event offers a welcoming and community-focused atmosphere where both participants and officials gather to promote athletics and joy in sports. Registration is done via EasyRecord, and the competition has a long tradition with results and records documented since 2016.
course_highlights: The competition is held at Kvarnsvedens IP, an established athletics venue in Borlänge
Part of Mittsvenska's series for youth aged 7-11 and 13-17
Focus on youth athletics development and community
additional: Registration is via EasyRecord. The event is part of a series for youth and is organized with the help of officials who register through the Favvos platform. Results and records from previous years are available. The event emphasizes the importance of community and official engagement. Invitations and registration are through EasyRecord, and the competition is part of Mittsvenska's series for youth.

name: Maraton Wigry
location: Stary Folwark, Wigierski Park Narodowy, Podlaskie Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Wigry Marathon is a unique marathon held within the Wigierski National Park, around the picturesque Lake Wigry. The route, approximately 42.2 km long, mainly runs through forest and dirt paths, with a small portion of asphalt, offering runners pristine air and beautiful views of Suwałki Region and Sejny Region. This is not a marathon for personal bests, but for those who want to enjoy exceptional nature and atmosphere. The event takes place on August 22, 2026, starting from the Monastery in Wigry and ending at the Community Square in Stary Folwark.
course_highlights: Route entirely within Wigierski National Park
82% forest and dirt roads, paths, 18% asphalt and sidewalks
Views over Lake Wigry and clean air of Poland's Green Lungs
additional: Participant transfer to the start location. Technical briefing optional. Possibility to transfer registration to another person until the end of July 2026. Bonfire for participants and supporters after the race. Route map available in GPX format. The event is planned for August 22, 2026, with online registration and various distance options.

name: IV Maraton Wigry
location: Jezioro Wigry, Suwałki, Podlaskie Voivodeship, Poland
description: The IV Wigry Marathon is a unique marathon held in the picturesque Wigry National Park around Lake Wigry. The route mostly runs through forest and dirt paths, with a small section of asphalt, offering runners pristine air and beautiful views of Suwałki Region and Sejny Region. This is not a marathon for setting personal bests, but for enjoying the exceptional nature and atmosphere. The start and finish are located at historic sites, and after the race, organizers invite participants and spectators to a bonfire.
course_highlights: Route entirely within Wigry National Park
82% forest, dirt, and trail paths, 18% asphalt and sidewalks
Views of Lake Wigry and surrounding nature
additional: The marathon starts at 09:30 from the Monastery in Wigry, with the finish at 16:30 at the Community Square in Stary Folwark. The race office and registration are open until 08:30. Technical briefing is optional. Participants can be transferred to the start location. After the race, there will be an award ceremony for winners and a bonfire for participants and spectators. The route map is available in GPX format. The participant limit is 600 for both distances, prior registration and an entry fee are required. The event also includes a shorter 13 km distance.

name: Viking Line Spelen
description: Viking Line Race is organized by Huddinge AIS Athletics and is held at Källbrinks IP in Huddinge. The event is part of the club's broad activities that include youth from 6 years old up to veteran level. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere for athletes of various ages and levels, focusing on development and community. Huddinge AIS is an engaged club that also invests in para-athletics and veteran athletics.
course_highlights: The race is held at Källbrinks IP, a well-equipped athletics arena in Huddinge
The event includes multiple age groups from children to veterans
The club has a strong tradition in athletics and also focuses on para-athletics
additional: The event takes place at Källbrinks IP with access to clubhouse and gym facilities. The club also offers training and try-out activities for children and youth with intellectual disabilities. Policies for officials and other participation policies apply. The contact person for the race is Per Öhrland. The event will be held on August 24, 2026, and is part of Huddinge AIS's annual athletics program.

name: Blodomloppet Västerås
description: Welcome to the Blood Race in Västerås at Rocklunda IP on August 26, 2026 - a recreational race for everyone where you can walk, jog, or run 5 km or 10 km. The Little Blood Race offers two children's races (approximately 1400 m and approximately 500 m) with warm-up and finish under the finish arch. The race is organized to raise awareness of the need for blood donation and traditionally ends with a picnic for teams and participants. Registration can be done individually or in teams (3 - 5 people) and information as well as the race pack are available on the race website.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Rocklunda area (football fields north of the riding hall)
The routes for 5 km and 10 km are marked and have flag marshals placed along the course
Little Blood Race: two children's distances (~1400 m start at 17:15 and ~500 m start at 17:25), finish under the finish arch
additional: Registration can be done individually or in teams (a team of 3 - 5 participants, the cost always covers 5 participants and a picnic for 5 is included). Teams can be filled up to a maximum of 5 people until Monday 24/8 and the last day to register a team is indicated as 19/8; for larger companies, there is an option for customer side/rabatt code. Children in the Little Blood Race receive a medal and a goody bag from ICA Maxi Hälla; warm-up in front of the stage around 17:00 and children choose their distance on site. Registration is binding, no cancellations are accepted, and registration is possible until 26/8 at 17:30. Course and map materials are available on the race website (link to map). Registration via the website or on-site at Rocklunda IP from 15:00 on August 25 according to the information page; includes a functional T-shirt, bib number, and medal; team registration is allowed for 3 - 5 participants with the last regular registration date on August 20; course layout and start times will be announced by the organizer.

name: Norrköpings Stadslopp (Nkpg City)
description: The NKPG City Norrköping City Run is organized by Tjalve Friidrott Norrköping and takes place with start and finish at Olai Kyrkogata in the heart of Norrköping. The race offers distances of 5 km and 10 km (10 km is 2 x 5 km) as well as the free children's race Lilla Lundbergsloppet. The course runs through classic Norrköping environments with well-filled spectator areas, several music stations, and a mix of elite runners and recreational runners. The event provides medals and sponsored products at the finish line, as well as options for team registration and timing or untimed participation.
course_highlights: City course through classic Norrköping environments with well-filled spectator areas
More than ten music stations along the route for extra encouragement
10 km = 2 x 5 km; start and finish at Olai Kyrkogata
additional: Start and finish at Olai Kyrkogata near Hötorget. Start times: Lilla Lundbergsloppet from 17:00 (four starts with 15-minute intervals), 10 km start at 18:30, 5 km start at 19:30. Optional timing or untimed participation for 5 km and 10 km. Lilla Lundbergsloppet (approximately 1,000 m) is free and limited to a maximum of 1,100 children; all children receive a medal and goodie bag. Bib distribution: XXL Ingelsta Tuesday, August 26 from 11:00 to 18:00 and at the partner village near the start and finish area on Wednesday, August 27 from 15:00 (late registration for 5 km and 10 km possible at bib distribution). Start lists and information about your start number will be published from the afternoon of Monday, August 25. Distance options: 5 km and 10 km; Lilla Lundbergsloppet is 1 km free for children; start and finish at Olai Kyrkogata; the course passes Lindens shopping center and includes music stations along the way; Lilla Lundbergsloppet has a maximum of 1,100 children; medals for all participants and a goodie bag; official results page available online.

name: Finnkampsloppet
location: Stockholms Stadion, Stockholm, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Finnkampen Run is a recreational race held in connection with Finnkampen at Stockholm Stadium. The race offers a 5-kilometer course for recreational runners, where participants have the chance to run in the yellow Sweden jersey and finish at the historic arena. There is also a children and youth race of 2 kilometers for age groups 10 - 12 years and 13 - 16 years. After the race, an After Run is organized at the Stadium where participants and spectators can enjoy the competitions and the atmosphere. The race is part of Finnkampshelgen and provides a unique opportunity to experience the athletics atmosphere up close.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stockholm Stadium
5 km recreational race with laps inside the arena
Children and youth race of 2 km for ages 10 - 16
additional: After the recreational race, an After Run is organized at the Stadium simultaneously with the first events of Finnkampen. The elite runners start at the Stadium and run a 2-kilometer course with laps inside the arena, providing the audience several opportunities to see them pass. The finish line is inside Stockholm Stadium. The event includes a 5 km recreational race, youth races, an elite race of 10 km, and is held at Stockholm Stadium during Finnkampshelgen. The event is open to all levels and offers a festive atmosphere for participants and spectators.

name: 22. Ülemiste metsajooks
description: 22. Ülemiste metsajooks on loodussõbralik 3 km pikkune trail jooks, mis toimub Tallinna Veepuhastusjaama ümbruses. Võistluskeskus ning start ja finiš asuvad aadressil Järvevana tee 3. Jooks toimub laupäeval, 29. augustil 2026, algusega kell 11.50. Osalejatele on tagatud tähistatud rada, spordijook ja vesi finišis ning meditsiiniline abi kogu raja ulatuses. Üritus on avatud kõigile jooksuhuvilistele ning pakub meeldivat ja sportlikku kogemust.
course_highlights: 3 km pikkune metsarada Tallinna Veepuhastusjaama ümbruses
Tähistatud rada ja spordijook ning vesi finišis
Meditsiiniline abi kogu raja ulatuses
additional: Stardimaterjalide väljastamine ja kohapealne registreerimine algab kell 9.30, võimalik tasuda sularahas. Ajavõtt toimub kiibiga, mis on kinnitatud rinnanumbri tagaküljele. Osalejatele on tagatud medal, rinnanumber, ajavõtt, tulemus lõpuprotokollis, teenindus, spordijook ning vesi finišis. Võistluskeskus asub Tallinna Veepuhastusjaama territooriumil, parkimine ja ligipääs juhendatud. Lastejooksud kuni 12-aastastele on tasuta ja toimuvad enne põhivõistlust. Sündmus hõlmab matkarada, registreerimine toimub kohapeal ning osalejatele pakutakse ka pereüritusi ja soojendusharjutusi.

name: Sillamäe ultra 2026: Eesti meistrivõistlused 100 km jooksus
location: Sillamäe terviserada ja jõulinnakud, Sillamäe, Ida-Viru County, Estonia
price_range: 35.00 EUR kuni 31/07/2026, 50.00 EUR alates 01/08/2026 kuni võistluse päevani
description: Sillamäe Ultra 2026 on Eesti meistrivõistlused 100 km jooksus, mis toimub Sillamäe terviserajal ja jõulinnakutes 29. augustil 2026. See on traditsiooniline ultrajooks, kus osalejad läbivad maanteejooksu distantsi, võisteldes Eesti meistritiitli nimel. Võistlus pakub väljakutset nii kohalikele kui ka rahvusvahelistele ultrajooksjatele, kes hindavad raja mitmekülgsust ja võistluse korraldust. Sillamäe Ultra on tuntud oma korralduse ja tugeva osalejate kogukonna poolest.
course_highlights: 100 km maanteejooks Sillamäe terviserajal ja jõulinnakutes
Eesti meistrivõistlused ultrajooksus
Mitmekülgne ja hästi korraldatud rada
additional: Võistlusel on võimalus osaleda ka 50 km, 6h ja 12h jooksudes; rajal on võimalus vahetada riideid ja pesta; osalejatele antakse auhinnad Eesti parimatele jooksjatele ning võistlus on osa Eesti ultrajooksu meistrivõistlustest.

name: Tallinna Vee 54. jooks ümber Ülemiste järve
location: Järvevana tee 3, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia

price_tiers.distance: Tallinna Vee 54. jooks ümber Ülemiste järve

description: Tallinna Vee 54. jooks ümber Ülemiste järve on traditsiooniline jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub 29. augustil 2026. Jooks ümber Ülemiste järve on osa Maru Järvejooksude sarjast ning selle aasta võistlus on sarja viimane, neljas osavõistlus. Rajal on tähistatud 13,7 km pikkune distants, mis algab ja lõpeb Tallinna Veepuhastusjaamas aadressil Järvevana tee 3. Võistluskeskus avatakse varahommikul ning stardimaterjalide väljastamine toimub kohapeal. Osalejatele on tagatud ajavõtt kiibiga, mis kinnitatakse rinnanumbri tagaküljele.
course_highlights: 13,7 km pikkune rada ümber Ülemiste järve
Rada on tähistatud ja turvatud rajajulgestusmeeskonnaga
Rajal on kaks joogipunkti
additional: Stardigruppide moodustamisel arvestatakse varasemaid tulemusi. Kõik kepikõndijad peavad startima viimasest grupist. Osalejatele antakse medal ning ajavõtt toimub kiibiga, mis on kinnitatud rinnanumbri tagaküljele. Lastejooksud kuni 12-aastastele on tasuta ja distantsiks on 250 m. Stardimaterjalide väljastamine toimub võistluskeskuses alates kella 9.30-st kuni 11.30-ni. Võistluskeskus ja start-finiš asuvad Tallinna Veepuhastusjaamas, Järvevana tee 3. Distants on 13,7 km ning start ja finiš asuvad Järvevana tee 3. Üritusel toimub ka lastejooks ja metsajooks, pakkudes mitmekülgset kogemust kõigile osalejatele.

name: Stockholm Halvmarathon
location: Kungliga slottet, Stockholm, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: adidas Stockholm Half Marathon is a half marathon of 21,098 meters that in 2026 will run for the 25th time through Stockholm's city center. The course is unique with both start and finish in the area between the Royal Palace, the Parliament House, and the Opera House, offering easily runnable streets through Norrmalm, Vasastan, Kungsholmen, Gamla Stan, and Södermalm. The first start is at 15:30, and the event includes an Expo and bib number distribution in Kungsträdgården from August 27 to 29, as well as an after run in Kungsträdgården. The race is open from the year you turn 17, and registration is binding.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the area near the Royal Palace/Norrbro (city center)
Easily runnable course through Norrmalm, Vasastan, Kungsholmen, Gamla Stan, and Södermalm
Passes, among others, Hornsbergstrand, Rålambshovsparken, and Söder Mälarstrand; detailed km‑passage available on the course
additional: Bib number distribution and Expo in Kungsträdgården from August 27 to 29; after run in Kungsträdgården at the finish line; registration is binding and the fee is non-refundable without a valid race insurance via Folksam; payment methods: internet banking, Visa, MasterCard, Swish, or invoice via Klarna; last day to report results for seeding: August 2, 2026; late registration (subject to availability) from August 24 to 29 until 1 hour before the first start. 21,098 km course; start at 15:30; expo in Kungsträdgården August 27-29; start/finish at the Royal Palace; after run in Kungsträdgården.

name: Jönköping Marathon & Half Marathon
description: Jönköping Marathon & Half Marathon is a welcoming city race taking place in 2026 on August 29th, offering beautiful views along Lake Vättern, through Jönköping and Huskvarna. The course has been redesigned for fewer elevation changes but maintains a varied profile with natural sections, crowd support, and several power zones; the marathon segment concludes with an impressive finish on the Munksjö Bridge. The event attracts international participants and also features shorter races, a MINI children's race, as well as offers for companies and tent packages at the start/finish area.
course_highlights: Impressive finish on the Munksjö Bridge
Beautiful views along Lake Vättern, Jönköping, and Huskvarna with a redesigned course and fewer elevation changes
Marathon: 42,195 m with 12 hydration stations along the course + 1 at Start/Finish, an interactive map, and power zones
additional: Practical information from the website: registration can be done for up to five runners simultaneously; start certificates are not sent out; the marathon course has an interactive map and a downloadable PDF, power zones, and over 12 hydration stations; the organizer offers tent packages for companies at the start/finish and the possibility to use wellness vouchers. Distances: 21K (21,097.5 m) and 42K (42,195 m); includes relay race and MINI Jönköping Marathon for children. Energy and hydration stations along the course, chip timing, group registration for up to 5 runners, and a corporate village with tents at the start/finish.

name: Rynningeviken Längre 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 24 augusti - 29 augusti (10.00/13.00) 625 SEK. Begränsat antal platser.

description: Rynningeviken Longer is a timed race in the Rynningeviken nature reserve outside Örebro where participants run as far as they can in either three or six hours. The course follows scenic trails along Lake Hjälmaren and the Svartån river, is relatively technical but fast, and is just a stone's throw from the city center. The event is open to all running styles and levels - from walking to ultramarathon - and offers a community-filled day with support and energy stations. A separate KidsRun for the youngest is also included in the event.
course_highlights: Lap course 2412.5 meters, mostly gravel paths
Two bridges providing the few elevation meters; start/finish on cobblestones
Final 508-meter loop for finish measurement (reduces waiting time at the finish)
additional: Start times and mandatory briefings: 6-hour start at 11:00 (briefing at 10:45), 3-hour start at 14:00 (briefing at 13:45), KidsRun start at 11:30 (briefing at 11:15); Location: Old Oil Harbor below Nature House, parking along Oljevägen; Measurement is done with a transponder loaned at bib pickup (lost transponder charged at 800 SEK) and final measurement verified with a measuring wheel; No individual timing - results are distance covered at the time limit; Drinks/sports drinks from Umara and a well-stocked energy table (bars, fruit, chips, pickles, Tosca cake, etc.); No changing/shower facilities, public toilets at the start and about 1 km away; Registration only via partner AnmälMigNu (group and corporate registration via info@epictrail.se); Youth (born 2008 or later) receive 50% discount; KidsRun participants receive medal, Fanta, and ice cream. Course laps approx. 2412.5 meters with two bridges and a final 508-meter loop; energy/drinks provided (Umara); no changing/shower facilities; toilets near the start and after about 1 km. Registration window August 24-29; youth discount 50% for those born 2008 or later; includes place, bib, timing, unique medal, sports drink, and energy along the course; registration via AnmälMigNu; group/corporate registration via info@epictrail.se; cancellation and insurance options at own risk.

description: The 16th Baltic Sea Coast Marathon is an annual running event held in the picturesque towns of Jastarnia and Władysławowo. Participants can choose between the marathon and half-marathon distances, which run along the coast, offering stunning views and a unique atmosphere. The event attracts runners of various age groups, including the K60+ and M65+ categories. The participant limit is 250 people, ensuring a intimate and friendly environment.
course_highlights: The route runs along the Baltic Sea coast
Scenic views of the sea and seaside towns Jastarnia and Władysławowo
Available distances: marathon (42 km) and half-marathon (21 km)
additional: The participant limit is 250 people. The K60+ and M65+ age categories have reduced entry fees. Registration is open from March 16 to August 26, 2026. The fee on the event day is higher. Start and finish in the seaside towns of Jastarnia and Władysławowo. The participant limit is 250 people, registration is open from March 16, 2026, with information on dates and fees.

name: 9. Kristiine Rahvajooks
description: 9. Kristiine Rahvajooks toimub 30. augustil 2026 Löwenruh pargi mänguväljakul Tallinnas. See on kogupereüritus, kus lisaks 5 km põhidistantsile toimuvad ka lastejooksud kuni 10-aastastele. Võistluskeskus ning start ja finiš asuvad Löwenruh pargi kõrval, pakkudes meeldivat ja turvalist keskkonda jooksuhuvilistele. Ürituse eesmärk on propageerida jooksuharrastust kui kättesaadavat liikumisviisi ning pakkuda sportlikku elamust erinevatele vanuseklassidele.
course_highlights: 5 km distants (2 x 2,5 km) Kristiine tänavatel ja Löwenruh pargis
Lastejooksud kuni 10-aastastele, 300 m ajavõtuta
Võistluskeskus, start ja finiš Löwenruh pargi mänguväljaku kõrval
additional: Lastejooksude registreerimine toimub jooksupäeval alates 10.00. Võistluskeskus avatakse kell 10.00, stardimaterjalide väljastamine algab samal ajal. Autasustamine toimub orienteeruvalt kell 12.45 või peale viimase võistleja lõpetamist. Võistlusklass avatakse ka ühe võistleja korral. Lõpetajatele antakse medalid, võitjat autasustatakse karika ja esikolmikut esemeliste auhindadega. Üritus toimub 30. augustil 2026 ning sisaldab ka lastejookse ja erinevaid tegevusi, mis algavad kell 10:00 ning lõppevad kell 12:45.

name: Vikingatrailen
location: Årsunda IP, Årsunda, Sandviken Municipality, Gävleborg County, Sweden
description: Årsunda IF invites you to the Vikingatrailen on Sunday, August 30, 2026 - a trail run starting at Årsunda IP and finishing at Vikingabyn (Årsjö gård). The courses include 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, and a mini race of 1 km, with information, invitation, and course materials published on the event's page. Participant information, event briefings, and start lists are updated on the website before the race, and results and photos from previous years are also available. GPX files and maps (including elevation profiles via Garmin Connect) are provided for all courses.
course_highlights: Start at Årsunda IP, finish at Vikingabyn (Årsjö gård).
Courses of various lengths: 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, and a 1 km mini race (mini race starts 1 km from the finish with bus transport to the start).
Maps, GPX files, and elevation profiles are published; courses are uploaded as public routes in Garmin Connect.
additional: Event brief (version 2) updated with information about, among other things, football matches at IP, bib numbers for the 1 km race, award ceremony, and results. Registered participants and preliminary start lists are published continuously, approximately one month before the event. GPX files, maps, and elevation profiles are available for download; courses are also uploaded as public routes in Garmin Connect. GPX files and maps are accessible; elevation profiles are planned; start lists, results, and photos are updated regularly; bus transportation to the start for the 1 km race is available.

name: 17. ETAPP / Paljassaare poolsaar
description: 17. ETAPP / Paljassaare poolsaar on osa Stamina Tervisejooksu sarjast, mis toimub 2. septembril 2026 Paljassaare ranna parklas Tallinnas. Jooksu distants on 6,5 km ning rada kulgeb Paljassaare poolsaarte maalilisel maastikul, pakkudes osalejatele mõnusa väljakutse ja võimaluse nautida loodust. Üritus on sobilik nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele, kes soovivad osa saada tervisespordi üritusest. Korraldajaks on Stamina, kes tagab sujuva ja meeldiva võistluskogemuse.
course_highlights: 6,5 km pikkune rada Paljassaare poolsaarel
Maaliline loodus ja rannaäärne maastik
Sobib nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele
additional: Kontaktisik Urmo Raiend, telefon +3725019572. Registreerunute nimekiri uuendatakse kord ööpäevas. Toimumiskoht on Paljassaare ranna parkla. Mitmed etapid toimuvad erinevates Tallinna paikades ning registreerimine ja täpsemad info võivad olla saadaval veebilehtedel.

name: Blodomloppet

description: Join us in highlighting the vital blood donation at the Blood Race Växjö on September 2, 2026. The race offers 5 km and 10 km (10 km = two laps of a certified 5 km course) as well as the Little Blood Race for the youngest participants. Start and finish are in Linné Park, and the course is described as flat and fast with plenty of crowd support along the way. The event welcomes both individual participants and teams, and traditionally concludes with a picnic and activities in the event area.
course_highlights: Start and finish in beautiful Linné Park in front of the main stage
Flat, fast, and certified 5 km course (10 km = two laps)
Separate walking route for the 5 km walk and a dedicated loop for the Little Blood Race (~600 m)
additional: Registration can be done individually or in teams (maximum 5 participants per team). Team members within the same team can participate in different distances. The last date to register a team is August 26, 2026. There is an Excel template for mass registrations, and the organizer can assist with customer pages/discount codes for companies registering more than 20 participants. Name changes and class/distance changes cost 50 SEK. Registration is open until the day of the event, and late registration on site in Linné Park is possible (the tent for late registration and bib distribution). The Little Blood Race runs on a separate loop in Linné Park with the same start/finish. Course details: start and finish in Linné Park; the 5 km course is used for the 10 km race; on-site registration and team registration available; includes T-shirt, bib, medal, and goodie bag; water stations and storage are mentioned.

name: Blodomloppet (Östersund)
description: Blood Donation Run in Västerås is a fitness race that highlights the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes participants to walk, jog, or run 5 km or 10 km. The race also offers the Little Blood Donation Run for children in two different distances. Start and finish are at Rocklundaområdet with clearly marked courses and flag marshals. After the race, participants gather for a communal picnic, strengthening the social community around an important cause.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Rocklundaområdet, the football fields north of the riding hall
Marked courses with flag marshals at strategic locations
Little Blood Donation Run for children with two distances of approximately 1400 m and 500 m around Rocklunda IP
additional: The race can be entered individually or in teams of 3-5 people, where the team fee includes a picnic for the entire team. The Little Blood Donation Run has two start times for children aged 1-12, 17:15 for approximately 1400 m and 17:25 for approximately 500 m. Warm-up takes place in front of the stage around 17:00. All participants receive a medal and a goody bag from ICA Maxi Hälla. The courses are marked and flag marshals are positioned. Registration is binding and no cancellations are accepted. The event includes blood donor activities, the possibility to participate with a dog, as well as information about parking and storage. Participants can register individually or in teams, and there is an option to rent tents and flags for the event.

name: Mägede järve jooks 8. etapp , Järvamaa Järvede jooksud sarjas
description: Mägede järve jooks on Järvamaa Järvede jooksud sarja 8. etapp, mis toimub Mägede spordirajoonis. See on piirkonna traditsiooniline jooksuvõistlus, mis pakub osalejatele võimalust nautida kaunist loodust ja sportlikku väljakutset. Rajad kulgevad järvede ja metsade vahel, sobides nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele. Üritus on osa Järvamaa spordielu aktiivsest kalendrist ja kutsub kõiki jooksuhuvilisi osalema.
course_highlights: Rajad kulgevad kaunite järvede ja metsade vahel
Sobib nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele
Toimumispaik on Mägede spordirajoon Järvamaal
additional: Võistlusel autasustatakse parimaid meeste ja naiste kategooriates ning osalejad saavad nautida järveringi kaunist loodust.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 28. Aseri Savijooks
description: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari on traditsiooniline jooksu- ja kõnnisari, mis pakub erinevatele vanuseklassidele ja tasemetele sobivaid distantsi. Sarja etapid toimuvad Lääne-Virumaa erinevates paikades, pakkudes jooksjatele mitmekesiseid ja huvitavaid radu. Sarja jooksul on võimalik nautida nii võistlusmomenti kui ka sportlikku seltskonda ning loodust. Aseri Savijooks on üks sarja osavõistlustest, mis toimub Aseri Vabaajakeskuses.
course_highlights: Mitmekesised rajad Lääne-Virumaa piirkonnas
Erinevad distantsid lastele ja täiskasvanutele
Pika traditsiooniga jooksusarja etapid
additional: Sarjas on erinevad distantsid alates laste jooksudest kuni põhijooksudeni. Osalejate seas on nii noored kui ka eakamad jooksusõbrad. Sarja etapid toimuvad erinevates paikades Lääne-Virumaal, kus jooksusuund võib aastati muutuda. Võistlusel osalejad saavad valida erinevate distantside vahel ning registreerimine toimub veebis. Tulemused ja info avaldatakse sarja kodulehel.

name: Falu Sommarspel
description: Falu Summer Games is an athletics competition held at Lugnets athletics arena in Falun. The event gathers athletes to compete in various disciplines and is part of Falu IK Athletics' activities. The event has a long tradition and is an important competition in the region. Please note that the 2025 Falu Summer Games were canceled, but the competition is planned to be held again in 2026.
course_highlights: The competition is held at Lugnets athletics arena
Athletics competition with multiple disciplines
Organized by Falu IK Athletics
additional: The event is part of Falu IK Athletics' activities and is open to participants of different ages. It is a popular opportunity to measure one's performance and participate in a community around athletics.
