description: Jüri Jaansoni Kahe Silla jooks on traditsiooniline Pärnu jooksusündmus, mis toimub septembri esimesel nädalavahetusel. See toob kokku tuhandeid spordisõpru, pakkudes nii 10 km jooksu kui ka kepikõndi ja õhtujooksu. Võistlus toimub kauni Pärnu linna ja silla piirkonnas, pakkudes sportlikku elamust igas vanuses osalejatele. Ürituse korraldab Pärnu Kahe Silla Klubi, kes kutsub kõiki aktiivseid inimesi osalema ja nautima liikumist.
course_highlights: 10 km jooks ja kepikõnd Pärnu kaunites sildade piirkondades
Pärnu õhtujooks 3 km distantsil
Lastejooksud ja ratastoolisõit perepäeval
additional: Võistlusel on ajavõtuga ja ajavõtuta distantsid, lisaks toimub perepäev koos lastejooksude ja ratastoolisõiduga. Võistluskeskus asub Endla Teatri juures. Registreerimine toimub mitmes voorus, võimaldades soodsamaid hindu varajastele registreerujatele. Tegemist on perepäevaga, kus on võimalik osaleda erinevatel jooksu- ja käimisüritustel ning nautida kohalikke spordiklubi ja huvialakoolide tegevusi. Registreerimine ja täpsem info on kättesaadav organisatsiooni veebilehel.

name: 15. Kütioru maastikujooks-kõnd
description: Kütioru maastikujooks-kõnd on osa Võrumaa jooksu- ja kõnnisarjast, mis pakub mitmekesiseid distantsivalikuid nii jooksjatele kui ka kõndijatele. Võistlus toimub Kütioru Mäesuusakeskuses ning rada on maastikuline, pakkudes vaheldusrikast jooksukogemust. Sarjas on erinevad distantsid alates mudilaste jooksudest kuni põhidistantsideni, mis sobivad igale tasemele. Võistlus on traditsiooniline ja avatud kõigile spordihuvilistele, kes soovivad nautida Võrumaa kaunist loodust ja sportlikku seltskonda.
course_highlights: Maastikuline rada Kütioru Mäesuusakeskuse ümbruses
Mitmekesine distantsivalik alates mudilastest kuni põhidistantsideni
Võimalus nautida Võrumaa kaunist loodust ja vaheldusrikast maastikku
additional: Sarjas on jooksu- ja kõndimisvõimalused erinevatele vanusegruppidele ja tasemetele. Rada võib sisaldada nii asfalt- kui kruusateid ning pehmemat maapinda. Mudilaste jooksud toimuvad eraldi aladel. Võistluskeskus ja transpordikorraldus on tavaliselt ette nähtud, kuid täpsem info tuleb hooaja juhendist. Võistlusel osalejad saavad nautida kaunist loodust ja mitmekesist maastikku, ning sündmus on osa Võrumaa jooksu- ja kõnnisarjast, mis hõlmab erinevaid distantsse ja vanusegruppe.

name: Pärnu Õhtujooks ja Kahe Silla jooksu ratastoolisõit ja lastejooksud

price_tiers.distance: Jüri Jaansoni Kahe Silla jooks 10 km

description: Jüri Jaansoni Kahe Silla jooks on traditsiooniline Pärnu spordisündmus, mis toob septembri esimesel nädalavahetusel kokku tuhanded jooksusõbrad. Võistlus toimub Vaasa pargis ning hõlmab erinevaid distantsi- ja osavõtuvõimalusi, sealhulgas õhtujooks, ratastoolisõit ja lastejooksud. Kahe Silla jooks on tuntud oma kauni linna- ja sillaäärse raja poolest, mis pakub sportlikku väljakutset ja mõnusat atmosfääri kõigile osalejatele. Üritus on avatud nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele ning rõhutab liikumise rõõmu ja kogukonna ühtsust.
course_highlights: 10 km jooks ja kõnd Vaasa pargi kaunil rajal
Õhtujooks ja perepäev koos lastejooksudega
Ratastoolisõit kaasava spordielamuse pakkumiseks
additional: Perepäeval on lisaks lastejooksud ja ratastoolisõit. Võistlused toimuvad Vaasa pargis. Võistluse raames on ka kõndimise võimalus. Registreerimine toimub veebilehel, kus on ka juhendid ja stardimaksud. Võistlusel on ajavõtt. Üritus hõlmab mitmeid jooksu- ja liikumisvõimalusi, sealhulgas lastejooksud, ratastoolisõit ning peamine 10 km jooks, mis kulgeb mööda Pärnu jõe ja linna kauneid vaateid.

name: Tjejmilen
description: Tjejmilen is an iconic 10 km race for women that will take place in 2026 in Södra Djurgården and through Stockholm city on September 5th. The race suits all levels - from walking to fast running - and is divided into start groups for smooth race flow. It offers a spectator-friendly course with both scenic natural sections and urban environments, as well as optional timing and prize money for the top 3.
course_highlights: 10 km course through Södra Djurgården and Stockholm city’s beautiful environments
Strong spectator support along the course and an energetic atmosphere
Option to shorten the race to approximately 6 km (start group 12) for those who wish
additional: Timing is included but can be opted out; registration is binding. Late registration is possible (subject to availability) digitally up to 1 hour before the first start. Payment options: internet banking, Visa/MasterCard, Swish, or invoice via Klarna. Age limit for Tjejmilen Stockholm: from the year you turn 15 (13 years with adult accompaniment). The start is divided into 12 start groups and prize money is awarded to the top 3. Two 10 km races for women (Sälen-trail and Stockholm City race); start groups; age 15+; late registration possible; dogs are not allowed; planning information is available on the official website.

name: Skördeloppet Hedemora
description: The Harvest Race in Hedemora is a festive and family-friendly running event held in conjunction with the Late Summer Day, a late summer festival with many activities in the town. The race includes, among other things, the Little Harvest Race for children with various distances without timing and medal distribution immediately at the finish line. The event offers a wonderful atmosphere with warm-up, mingling performance, and the possibility of late registration and bib pickup on site. It is a nice tradition that ends the summer with joy and community in Hedemora.
course_highlights: Little Harvest Race with child-friendly distances at Vasaliden
Medal distribution immediately at the finish line for children
Festive atmosphere with mingling performance and warm-up
additional: On-site late registration and bib pickup open. No timing for the children's race. Warm-up for Knattar & Kids before start. Medal distribution occurs immediately at the finish line. The Little Harvest Race starts at 10:00 AM at Vasaliden. Association day and volunteer opportunities take place on August 31, 2026, at Vasaliden in Hedemora; no specific terrain details for the race are available.

name: 60. Festiwal Chodu
location: Portowy region Gdańska, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
description: The 60th Race Walking Festival is a prestigious international sporting event organized in the port region of Gdańsk, scheduled for September 5, 2026. The event gathers competitors across various age categories and skill levels, offering race walking competitions over distances of 10 km (women and men, including Open, U20, U18 categories), 5 km, and 3 km for younger participants, as well as the Polish Masters Championships over 5 km. The festival also features the Polish U23 Championships over 10 km and accompanying events such as the Prologue "Walking with the Postman" and the Memorial Run for the Polish Post Defenders - Energa Cup. The organizer, the LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club, promotes physical activity among people with disabilities by organizing wheelchair races and FrameRunning competitions.
course_highlights: Race walking over distances of 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km tailored to different age categories
Polish Masters Championships 5 km and Polish U23 Championships 10 km
Accompanying events including the Prologue "Walking with the Postman" and the Memorial Run for the Polish Post Defenders
additional: The festival promotes activity among people with disabilities through wheelchair races and FrameRunning competitions. The organizer is the LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club, and the event is supported by the Ministry of Sport and Tourism. The competitions include various distances such as 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km, with online registration available. The event encourages sports activity among different age groups and people with disabilities, with support from the Ministry of Sport and Tourism.

name: 64 Bieg Westerplatte
description: The 64th Westerplatte Run is the oldest continuously organized street race in Poland, covering a distance of 10 kilometers, held in Gdańsk. The race starts at a historic site where World War II began, giving the event a unique character and an atmosphere of reflection on sacrifice and peace. The route is certified and marked every kilometer, and the finish line is at the Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, which adds an extra attraction for participants. The event attracts up to 5,000 runners and is both a sporting challenge and a tribute to the Coast Defenders of 1939.
course_highlights: Certified route marked every 1 km
Opportunity to run through the Tunnel under the Dead Vistula, closed to pedestrian traffic on regular days
Finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk - a modern football facility
additional: Number pickup at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk on September 6-7, 2026. Water refreshment point approximately at 6 km on the route. Participant limit is 5000 people. Free buses transport competitors to the start on race day. Deposit for belongings with a start number sticker. No showers available. Award ceremony around 11:45 at the finish line. Cash prizes and trophies for winners in the OPEN classification and age categories. Registration from March 2, 2026, to August 20, 2026, with a limit of 4900 participants, and the option to purchase official T-shirts at the Expo. The event includes package pickup, expo, transportation, start, and awards at Westerplatte.

name: Blodomloppet Eskilstuna
description: The Blood Run in Eskilstuna takes place on September 7, 2026, and is organized by Eskilstuna Athletics. The race offers men's and women's classes for 5 km and 10 km, as well as the Little Blood Run and the Special Race, with courses described as fast and flat. The event is held in the City Park and combines a recreational run with the purpose of raising awareness about blood donation, including a blood donor gift and picnic tradition. Information and event details are published on the event page, and registration can be done individually or in teams.
course_highlights: A fast, flat course with very little elevation change
5 km and 10 km courses are measured
Start and event area in the City Park
additional: Registration is done individually or in teams (up to 5 people per team); team members can participate in different distances within the same team. For larger registrations, an Excel template is available for download from the registration page, and the organizer can assist with customer side/rabatt code for companies with more than 20 participants. A blood donor gift is handed out at the Unilabs blood donation center tent at the event area. Storage/collection of bags is offered (drop-off/pick-up times are 17:00 - 20:00). Course routes: 5 km and 10 km. The Little Blood Run is 800 meters. The event area includes a bag drop and picnic basket; participation can be individual or in teams (up to 5 persons per team).

name: Skärblackaloppet 2026
location: Folkets Hus i Skärblacka, Skärblacka, Östergötland, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Early Bird, 250 kr, fram till och med 30 april 23:59.

description: Skärblackaloppet is an annual recreational race in Skärblacka that offers a folk festival for runners and spectators. The main race is 6 km through the town with start and finish at the Folkets Hus, and there is also a 4 km walk class as well as a Little Children's Race of 900 meters. The race is open to all levels and features a generous prize table, lotteries, and goodie bags for participants. Organizers Frida Södermark and Stefan Fransson warmly welcome you to the starting line on September 9, 2026.
course_highlights: 6 km through Skärblacka with start and finish at Folkets Hus
The course runs on asphalt, bike paths, gravel, and partly on trails
Walk class 4 km (shortened) and Little Children's Race 900 m near Parkskolan
additional: Start and finish at Folkets Hus in Skärblacka. Bib numbers can be picked up at ICA Supermarket in Skärblacka on Tuesday, September 8 from 11:00 to 18:00; remaining bibs will be handed out at Folkets Hus no later than one hour before the start. Late registration can be done in connection with the bib number distribution. All participants receive a goodie bag; prize table, sprint prizes, and lotteries will be held (including tire prizes, course record bonuses). The walk class was introduced in 2024; bib numbers are picked up at ICA Supermarket in Skärblacka; registration is via RaceID; late registration is available on race day from 15:30; payment only by Swish or cash; chip records the time on the bib; medical services, food, and drinks are available on site.

name: Blodomloppet (Växjö)
price_range: 350 kr till 400 kr för vuxna, 50 kr för Lilla Blodomloppet
description: Blood Race in Växjö is a fun run that highlights the vital importance of blood donation. The race offers distances of 5 km and 10 km running, as well as a 5 km walking class, all starting and finishing in the beautiful Linné Park. The courses are flat and fast with lots of crowd support, making it a perfect race for both competitive runners and recreational participants who want to enjoy an energetic atmosphere. There is also a Little Blood Race for children, which runs in a loop in the park. Registration can be done individually or in teams, and late registration is available on-site on the same day.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Linné Park, Växjö
Flat and fast 5 km course, officially measured
The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course
additional: Registration can be done individually or in teams (up to 5 participants per team). Team members can participate in different distances. Late registration is possible on-site in Linné Park on race day. There is a special dog class (ICA Pälskling). Changing rooms and toilets are available at the event area. Bibs and T-shirts are distributed on-site. There are water stations along the course and medical services on-site. The race concludes with a large picnic for participants. The event promotes blood donation and health, with registration available until the day of the event and on-site in Linné Park.

name: Rava järve jooks, Liikumissari 8.Järvamaa Järvede jooksud 9.etapp
description: Rava järve jooks on osa Liikumissari 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksud sarjast ning toimub Rava järve ääres Järvamaal. Võistlusel osalevad erinevates vanuseklassides jooksjad alates mudilastest kuni vanemaealisteni. Jooksu eripäraks on ühe järveringi läbimine, kus autasustatakse kiireimaid mehi ja naisi. See on traditsiooniline ja kogukonda kaasav jooksuvõistlus, mis pakub sportlikku väljakutset ja looduse nautimist.
course_highlights: Ühe järveringi läbimine
Sobib erinevatele vanuseklassidele alates mudilastest kuni vanemaealisteni
Toimub Rava järve ääres, pakkudes kaunist loodust
additional: Järvamaa Järvede jooksude arvestust peetakse mitmetes vanuseklassides: mudilased (2020 ja hiljem sündinud), 2016-2019, 2013-2015, 2010-2012, 1992-2009, 1972-1991, 1971 ja varem sündinud. Võistlusel autasustatakse kiireimaid mehi ja naisi, kes läbivad ühe järveringi kõige kiirema ajaga. Osalemine on avatud erinevatele vanuseklassidele ning rada sobib nii jooksjatele kui ka kõndijatele. Hooaja jooksul toimub ka loosiauhindu ning aasta lõpus jagatakse auhindu parimatele osalejatele.

name: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run
location: Gripholms Slott, Mariefred, Strängnäs Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden
distance_verbose: 100 miles, 100 km, 50 km, Halvmarathon, 8 km, 8 km, 2 km
description: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run is a multi-day race (September 11-13, 2026) through the scenic and biologically rich landscapes of Sörmland, with distances ranging from approximately 8 km up to 100 miles. The races take place on technical singletracks, coastal paths, and faster sections, suitable for both experienced ultrarunners and recreational runners depending on the chosen distance. The event focuses on the trail experience with local food offerings, lectures, and a friendly, inclusive atmosphere. Organizers provide GPS tracking, GPX files, and support at water stations for a memorable weekend in Sörmland.
course_highlights: Trail with forest paths and coastal cliffs along Sörmlandsleden
Approximately 300 meters of elevation gain (22 km) and technical singletrack
Surface: about 85% trail, 10% gravel, 5% asphalt
additional: GPX files are available for download; live GPS tracking and intermediate/final results are offered. The event is cupless – bring your own cup. Longer distances include a buff, live tracking, GPX, window decal, and a handcrafted wooden finisher's medal/belt buckle depending on the distance. Detailed mandatory kit lists are provided (including 1 liter of fluids, mobile phone, navigation tools, first aid kit, map, GPS tracker, emergency blanket, rain jacket, headlamp) for 100 km and 100 miles. Early cut-offs and water station locations are published; the organizer plans shuttle buses from Nävekvarn Camping to Nyköping (fee approx. 100 SEK, paid via Swish on-site). Night Trail and 2 km children’s race are included; start/finish locations include Gripholms Slott in Mariefred and Nävekvarns Folkets Park; bus transfers and GPX tracks are included in the information for different distances.

name: Rosvallaspelen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Early-Bird pris fram tills 31 mars 2026: 200 kronor

description: Rosvallaloppet is a recreational race organized with start and finish at Rosvalla Arena in Nyköping. The race offers distances of five and ten kilometers that run on trails at Brandholmen, with start and lap inside the arena. It is a day filled with activity, socializing, and exercise, with medals for all participants and prize giving for the top finishers in the women's and men's categories. During the race, there are water stations with sports drinks and a simple kiosk on site. Changing rooms and toilets are available at the arena.
course_highlights: Start and finish inside Rosvalla Arena
5 km and 10 km on trails at Brandholmen
The 10 km race consists of two laps on the same course
additional: Number bibs are to be collected on race day no later than 60 minutes before start. Late registration is possible from April 30 to May 7 via the website and on race day with Swish payment. Timing is done with a transponder loaned out at the bib distribution and must be returned after the race. Lost transponders will be charged at 800 SEK. Prizes are awarded to the top three in the women's and men's categories, as well as raffle prizes from sponsors. Sports drinks are available at the start/finish and on the 10 km lap. A simple kiosk is available on site. Changing rooms and toilets are available at the arena. The race requires pre-registration via anmalmig.nu; the event also includes family activities and is open to all levels.

name: Tallinna Sügisjooks 10 km
location: Vabaduse väljak, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Tallinna Sügisjooks 10 km on sügisene jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Tallinna kesklinnas Vabaduse väljakul. Start antakse 12. septembril 2026 kell 14.00. Võistlus sobib nii jooksjatele kui ka kõndijatele, pakkudes ajavõtuga ja ajavõtuta osalemisvõimalusi. Osalejatele on tagatud sõbralik atmosfäär ning võimalus nautida linna sügisest ilu.
course_highlights: 10 km pikkune rada Tallinna kesklinnas
Võimalus osaleda jooksu või käimisega, ajavõtuga või ilma
Start ja finiš Vabaduse väljakul
additional: Hinnasoodustused: 20% soodustus seenioridele alates 60. eluaastast ja noortele alla 20. eluaasta. 10% soodustus gruppidele, kui registreerub vähemalt 10 inimest korraga. Sündmus pakub soodustusi eakatele, noortele ja gruppidele ning on osa Tallinna Maratonist, mis toimub 11.-13. septembril 2026.

name: Nike Noortejooks
description: Nike Noortejooks on noortele suunatud jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Tallinna südalinnas Vabaduse väljakul. See on osa Swedbanki Tallinna Maratoni üritustesarjast ja pakub noortele võimalust osaleda lõbusal ja sportlikul sündmusel. Jooksu start on õhtul, mis loob meeldiva atmosfääri ning toetab noorte aktiivset eluviisi. Registreerumine on lihtne ja soodushinnad kehtivad varajastele osalejatele.
course_highlights: Toimub Tallinna kesklinnas Vabaduse väljakul
Õhtune start kell 18:30
Noortele sobiv ja turvaline jooksukeskkond
additional: Registreerudes varakult on võimalik saada soodsamaid osavõtutasusid. Noortele ja seenioridele on Tallinna Maratoni sarjas ka erisoodustused. Osalejatele on tagatud turvaline jooksukeskkond ja korraldus. Võistlus toimub Tallinna vanalinnas ja Vabaduse väljakul, osalejatel on võimalus osa saada noorte sportlaste kogukonnast ning võistlusel on autasustamine parimate seas.

name: 84. laste Paala järve jooks
description: 84. laste Paala järve jooks on traditsiooniline laste jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Paala järve rannas Viljandi lähedal. Võistlusel on erinevad distantsid vastavalt laste vanusele, alates 300 meetrist kuni kahe ringi jooksuni ümber järve. Jooksu korraldab tervisespordiklubi JOOSU ning see pakub lastele võimalust aktiivselt sportida ja nautida loodust. Võistlus algab 12. septembril 2026 kell 10:00 ning osalejatele on ette nähtud auhinnad ja meenemed.
course_highlights: Start ja finiš Paala järve rannas
Jooks ümber Paala järve, üks ring 1200 m
Distantsid alates 300 m kuni 2 ringi (2400 m)
additional: Võistlejate registreerimine algab kell 10:00 samal päeval. Distantsid on jaotatud vanusegruppide järgi: tillujooks 300 m (5-a ja nooremad), põhijooks 1 ring ümber järve (6 - 10-a poisid ja tüdrukud ning 11 - 12-a tüdrukud) ja põhijooks 2 ringi ümber järve (11 - 12-a poisid). Palju auhindu ja meeneid. Jooksu korraldab tervisespordiklubi JOOSU. Võistlus algab kell 10:00, registreerimine toimub kohapeal; üritus keskendub tervisele ja liikumisele ning on suunatud lastele ja noortele.

name: Bysjöloppet
description: Bysjöloppet is a popular race at Bysjön in Åtvidaberg, organized by Åtvidabergs IF since 1983. The courses are varied with asphalt, gravel roads, and forest trails, starting and finishing at Edbergavallen, and offer distances for both children and adults. The race is traditionally held on the second Saturday in September and welcomes both recreational and competitive runners and teams.
course_highlights: Mixed terrain: asphalt, gravel roads, and forest trails along Bysjön
Start and finish at Edbergavallen
10 km includes hilly terrain trail (Humpa illuminated trail) and is more challenging
additional: Registration is done via the link to the registration system; payment by Swish or bank transfer (discount codes available online). Bibs can be collected from 10:00 on race day at Edbergavallen; late registration on site from 10:00 (Swish or cash). Distance info: 700 m (children, no timing), 1.3 km (children, with timing), 5 km (measured 5.0 km, mixed asphalt/gravel), and 10 km (measured 10.0 km, mixed asphalt/trail/gravel, hilly). All finishers receive a medal; a special commemorative medal is awarded upon completing the 10th or 20th race (adult categories). Team registration (4 - 6 participants) includes a picnic basket for 5 people; team registration may close on September 7 if baskets are sold out. A kiosk is available at the race area. Award ceremony around 12:00 for the 1.3 km and around 14:00 for the 5 km and 10 km. Distances: 1.3 km, 5 km, and 10 km; all finishers receive a medal; additional commemorative medal available at the 10th or 20th race for adults; team registration for 4 - 6 participants; bib pickup at Edbergavallen; ICA picnic basket after finish; kiosks at the race area; prize distribution according to the prize table. Preparatory activities include a running workshop and open group interval training before the race.

name: Norasjön Runt
description: Norasjön Runt is a scenic half marathon around Lake Norasjön in Nora, organized by IFK Nora since 1929. The race is held annually in early September and has historically been an important race in the Southern Svealand district, with DM/VDM status according to the invitation for the district. The route passes through varied nature around the lake, with open fields, forests, and streams, offering a course that caters to both competitive runners and recreational athletes. The race has a long tradition and is a valued part of the region's running events.
course_highlights: Norasjön Runt - half marathon around the lake
Varied nature along the course with open fields, forests, and streams
DM/VDM status in the Southern Svealand district and part of Södra Svealands Löparie
additional: 71st edition (2025) and 96 years since the start; the distance is a half marathon and the event is associated with the DM/VDM district of Southern Svealand.

name: Gränna StadsTrail
description: Gränna City Trail is a welcoming trail run offered at 5, 10, and 21 km, starting and finishing at Gränna Square. The courses combine fast asphalt sections with winding trails through beech and pine forests, offering magnificent views over Lake Vättern and Grännaberget. The race is designed for both the experience and performance, suitable for both recreational runners and more experienced athletes. All participants receive timing and a unique medal at the finish line.
course_highlights: 5 km: mostly asphalt, ending with a downhill run from Grännaberget on winding trail
10 km: a mix of asphalt and trail with views along Lake Vättern and Grännaberget
21 km: winding trail through beech forest, gravel roads, and challenging hills with magnificent views
additional: Joint start from the square through Gränna to the harbor where timing begins; timing on all distances; unique medal for all participants; arena and finish area in the center of Gränna with proximity to cafes, eateries, and accommodations; the courses may be changed depending on conditions and permits. Timing on all distances. Start and finish at Gränna Square. Distances of 5, 10, and 21 km. The courses may be altered depending on conditions and permits.

name: USWE Paradiset STHLM
description: USWE Paradiset STHLM is a 26 km trail run in the Paradiset Nature Reserve south of Stockholm. The race offers technical, winding trails over rocky outcrops, boardwalks over marshes, and through open pine forests - a demanding but scenic trail event. The distance is part of the Outnorth Trailtour and the race emphasizes community, personal challenge, and a festive atmosphere after the finish. The organizer is Trailrunning Sweden AB and the event is aimed at trail runners who want to experience the wilderness south of Stockholm.
course_highlights: Technical singletrack trails with ascents and descents over rocky outcrops
Boardwalks over marshes and small ponds, as well as open pine forest sections
26 km through Paradiset Nature Reserve - part of the Outnorth Trailtour
additional: Date of the race is set for September 12, 2026. The event highlights after-party/finish line atmosphere and that the race is part of the Outnorth Trailtour. The organizer is listed as Trailrunning Sweden AB (Hästtorget 6, 312 30 Laholm). The terrain is described as challenging with winding trails, rocky outcrops, boardwalks, and marshes. The courses are marked with ribbons and start groups are organized by distance; start times and aid stations are listed; dogs are not allowed; there will be a hydration station and afterparty at Oasen.

name: Nybro Backyard 12h
organizer: Nybro Skidklubb & Topp och Dröm HB
description: Topp & Dröm organizes the Nybro Backyard 12h as part of their annual competition program in Nybro. The race is a 12-hour Backyard format welcoming runners seeking an ultra challenge in a social and inclusive event. The organizer emphasizes movement, community, and joy in nature and also offers rental and personal training in Nybro. For questions, contact details for Topp & Dröm are available on their website.
course_highlights: 12-hour Backyard format
Organized in Nybro by Topp & Dröm
Organizer's focus: movement, community, and joy in nature
additional: Organizer: Topp och Dröm HB, Sommargatan 17, 382 38 Nybro. Organization number: 969796-6407. Contact email: info@toppochdrom.se. Swish for payment is 123 698 89 01. Topp & Dröm also offers ski rental (roller and cross-country ski packages) and personal training in Nybro. The race offers a 6,706 m lap, starts every full hour, and changing rooms/showers are available nearby; parking at the stadium and camping/parking space via Nybro Camping. Registration is via Mittlopp and bibs are collected from 06:30 to 07:45 on race day.

name: Duvnäsloppet
description: Duvnäsloppet is a family-friendly race and recreational run in Saltsjö-Duvnäs that winds through a beautiful and hilly villa community. The event is organized by Saltsjö-Duvnäs Sports Club and features races for children and adults with start and finish at Ringparken. Everyone can participate, whether you are a recreational runner or more competitive, and the event emphasizes community and enjoyment. Registration opens June 1, 2026, and the race takes place on September 12, 2026.
course_highlights: Hilly residential area with several steep climbs (including Fogdevägen, Vargungevägen)
5 km and 10 km have the same route; 10 km is run as two laps
Shorter race (1.7 km) and kids' race with start/finish at Ringparken
additional: Registration opens June 1, 2026. The final regular pre-registration usually closes around September 11; registrations after that are accepted until race day with a higher fee. Bibs can be collected at Ringparksstugan on Friday evening from 18:00 to 20:00 or on race day from 10:00 (no later than one hour before start). The timing chip is attached to the bib; the 10 km races use two bibs (front and back). Registration is binding. Registration opens June 1, 2026; distances are 5 km and 10 km (10 km as two laps); children's race at 11:00 and adult race around 12:30; bibs can be collected at Ringparksstugan on race day or the evening before; pre-registration until September 11; the race is seeking volunteers.

name: Närkespelen
description: Närkespelen in Hallsberg is a traditional athletics competition organized by Åsbro GoIF. The event is held annually and brings together athletes for a day of various disciplines and competition elements. The event is well-organized with a clear schedule and has a long history with result lists from many years back. It is a welcome opportunity for both active participants and spectators to experience athletics in a pleasant environment.
course_highlights: Includes several athletics disciplines
Organized by local sports club Åsbro GOIF
District championships in pole vault for youth and adults
additional: The event takes place in Hallsberg and is part of the regional athletics calendar. It is an occasion for both competitive athletes and recreational participants to engage in a friendly and inspiring environment.

name: HIK-Kampen
description: HIK-Kampen is an athletics competition organized by the Hovslätts IK Athletics Section in Jönköping. The event gathers athletes of various ages and levels to compete in a welcoming and engaging environment. The event is part of the club's tradition to promote athletics and community in the region. Participants can follow the club's website for updates and information.
course_highlights: Different distances for various age groups
Held in Jönköping
Includes sprints and longer runs
additional: Results from previous years include categories such as P15 80m, women 800m, and P13 600m, demonstrating a wide range of participants.

name: Mälarömilen
description: After more than ten years of hiatus, Mälarömilen is back on Ekerö – a welcoming race for runners of all levels. The event includes four races in one day: Mälarö Knattelopp, Lilla Mälarömilen, Mälaröfemman, and the classic main race Mälarömilen (10 km). Start and finish are at Träkvista sports field, and the event emphasizes community, joy of movement, and fast courses for those who want to compete. There is also an option to register entire teams or companies through a convenient group registration.
course_highlights: Asphalted walkways and park trails
Signage at each kilometer mark
Start and finish at Träkvista sports field; looping on the walkway north of the sports field
additional: Online registration closes 7 days before the race; late registration is possible on race day with an increased fee. The number of starting places is limited, and registration is valid only after payment is completed. Timing and bibs are used in all categories (exceptions: Mälarö Knattelopp without timing; Lilla Mälarömilen girls/boys 9 - 11 years timing without placement). The event area is located at Träkvista sports field with medical services, a water station just after the start/loop, as well as toilets, showers, and changing rooms in the KOM building. Recommended public transport options: buses 177 and 301 - 311 (stop Träkvista Idrottsplats). A total cap of 1,000 runners, and all surplus funds go back to Mälarö SOK's sports activities. The race offers corporate and team registration and support for teams.

description: The North Running Festival is a unique running event taking place on September 13, 2026, on the Hel Peninsula, combining the tradition of the North Marathon and Marathon Relays under one banner. The race route runs through picturesque locations of Hel, Jastarnia, and Rozewie, along the Puck Bay, with views of the sea and four lighthouses, which give the race a distinctive character. The event offers a variety of distances for runners of all levels, from marathons and relays, through half marathons, 10 km, and 5 km, to a children's run - Little Lighthouse Runner. It is not only a sport event but also a journey through beautiful coastal corners and contact with nature.
course_highlights: The route runs along Puck Bay with a view of the sea
There are four lighthouses on the route: in Hel, Jastarnia, and two in Rozewie
The route leads through the most beautiful corners of the Hel Peninsula and the coast
additional: The race route is available in .GPX, .KML, and .TCX formats for download. Registration is open from January 1, 2026, to August 24, 2026, until 3:00 PM. Co-organizers and partners include local sports and cultural centers and a holiday resort. Honorary patronage by the Marshal of the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The Little Lighthouse Runner is dedicated to children and youth up to 14 years old. The route is available for download in .GPX, .KML, .TCX formats; marine and seaside terrain; the event includes various distances and competitions for adults and children.

name: Mjärdevistafetten
price_range: 700-1000 kr/lag (student/under 18 100 kr/lag; priser varierar efter anmälningsdatum)
description: Mjärdevistafetten is a lively and popular relay race in Collegiumparken in Linköping Science Park. The competition is a team event for teams of four people, where each runner runs a distance of approximately 3 km. The starting shot is at 17:00, and there are activities, food sales, and an award ceremony with a raffle after the finish. The event welcomes everything from elite teams to recreational groups and encourages colorful and imaginative elements along the course.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Collegiumparken, Linköping Science Park
Team event: 4 people per team, each segment approximately 3 km
Prize ceremony around 18:15 and raffle on race numbers
additional: Number bibs are distributed at Mjärdevi Center / DoSpace on Wednesday, September 11 from 11:00 to 13:30 and Thursday, September 12 from 11:00 to 13:30 (then at the start and finish area). Food sales are available on site and a Post-Run package is offered for the entire team (price 140 SEK). The event encourages companies to create activities along the course (hydration stations, performances, etc.) and features attractive prize sponsors and raffles. Teams pick up bibs at Mjärdevi Center/DoSpace before the event (usually between 11:00 and 13:30 on the days prior) and there is a Post-Run package for the team (e.g., 140 SEK according to the 2024 version). The event follows COVID-19 safety guidelines according to authorities and promotes sustainability with thematic elements.

name: Jõhvi rahvajooks
location: Heino Lipu staadion, Jõhvi, Jõhvi vald, Ida-Viru maakond, Estonia
organizer: Jõhvi kultuuri- ja spordinõunik Avo Sambla
description: Jõhvi rahvajooks on traditsiooniline jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub 39. korda Heino Lipu staadionil Jõhvis. Sel aastal on rada uuendatud ning lisaks linnatänavatele kulgeb see ka pargis ja läbi Pargi keskuse poodide. Võistlus pakub põnevat ja mitmekesist jooksukogemust nii 5 km kui 10 km distantsidel. Osalejaid ootab sõbralik atmosfäär ja hea sportlik väljakutse.
course_highlights: Uuendatud rada kulgeb linnatänavatel, pargis ja läbi kaubanduskeskuse
Distantsid 5 km ja 10 km
Start ja finiš Heino Lipu staadionil
additional: Jooks toimub 19. septembril 2026 Heino Lipu staadionil Jõhvis. Rada on uuendatud, sisaldades linnatänavaid, parki ja kaubanduskeskust. Põhidistantsid on 5 km ja 10 km. Üritus on kogukondlik ja traditsiooniline, pakkudes sportlikku väljakutset erineva tasemega jooksjatele. Võistlus toimub Heino Lipu staadionil ning on osa Ida-Viru jooksusarjast, kus osalejate arv ulatub 600-700 ning osalejad saavad valida erinevate distantside vahel. Osavõtutasud algavad 10 eurost ning registreerimine toimub eelkõige enne sündmust. Võistlus on suunatud kõigile vanusegruppidele ning rõhutab osalemise rõõmu ja kogukonna ühendamist.

name: ASTRI KESKUS Narva Sügisjooks 2026
location: Astri Keskus, Narva, Ida-Viru maakond, Estonia
description: Astri Keskus Narva Sügisjooks 2026 on Ida-Viru maakonnas toimuv jooksu-, käimise- ja kõndimisüritus, mis kutsub kõiki liikumishuvilisi osalema. Üritus on osa Liikumisharrastuse kompetentsikeskuse tegevustest, mille eesmärk on edendada tervislikku ja aktiivset eluviisi. Sügisjooks pakub võimalust nautida liikumist ning toetada oma vaimset ja füüsilist tervist. Osalejad saavad valida endale sobiva liikumisviisi ning kogeda liikumisrõõmu koos teistega.
course_highlights: Toimub Astri Keskuse ümbruses Ida-Viru maakonnas
Sobib jooksmiseks, käimiseks ja kõndimiseks
Osalejate liikumisaktiivsust toetav ja tervist edendav üritus
additional: Sündmus hõlmab jooksu, kõndimist ja käimist ning toimub 19. septembril 2026. Registreerimine on avatud ning üritus on suunatud kõigile vanuse- ja tasemekategooriatele.

name: 13. Saarepeedi mägede jooks
location: Saarepeedi Rahvamaja, Saarepeedi, Põhja-Sakala vald, Viljandi County, Estonia
description: 13. Saarepeedi mägede jooks on traditsiooniline jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Saarepeedi Rahvamaja juures. Võistlus pakub osalejatele võimalust nautida kaunist maastikku ja mägiseid radu. See on sobiv nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele, kes soovivad proovile panna oma vastupidavust ja osavust. Ürituse korraldajad ootavad kõiki jooksusõpru osalema ja nautima sportlikku päeva.
course_highlights: Mägine maastik Saarepeedi ümbruses
Kaunid loodusvaated
Mitmekesine ja vaheldusrikas rada
additional: Sündmus on osa Seeriajooks sarjast ning hõlmab tõenäoliselt erinevaid distantsivõimalusi ja tulemusi, pakkudes sportlastele võimalust nautida sporti ja loodust.

description: Uppsala Running Club welcomes elite runners, recreational runners, and children of all ages to the King Bear Race - Uppsala's cross-country race with the family at the center. The race is organized at OK Linné's club house and offers several distances (10 km, 6 km, trail run, and children's race). The event now has fixed times, bib number distribution with electronic chips, and prize giving, with the 20th anniversary of the race in 2026.
course_highlights: Mostly gravel roads and forest trails, with sections of asphalt
Three distances: approximately 10 km, just over 6 km, and trail run about 5 km; courses have kilometer markers
Water stations: two at 10 km, one at 6 km; water also available at the finish
additional: Bib numbers with electronic chips can be collected at Löplabbet, Dragarbrunns Torg 6 on Friday, September 19 from 12:00 to 18:30 or on race day from 09:00 until one hour before each start (30 minutes before children's races). Those who pick up on Friday receive a 20% discount on regular prices in Löplabbet's store (excluding electronics). Parking is available for a fee; the organizer recommends public transport (bus line 7) or cycling. There are changing rooms and showers with limited space, a kiosk on site, prize giving around 13:30, and a prize draw. Start groups: 10 km has start group 1 (under 50 minutes) and group 2; 6 km starts in a combined group. Members who have contributed at least one work shift can register free of charge via kb.loppet@gmail.com. Water stations, bib number pickup at Löplabbet (Dragarbrunns Torg 6), Swish payment, start times: 11:00 (10 km), 12:00 (6 km), 12:15 (trail); prize giving around 13:30; medals for all finishers; parking for a fee; public transport or cycling recommended; no timing in children's races.

name: Kistaloppet
description: Kistaloppet is a family-friendly city-based running event organized by Löparakademin with races for all ages: Kistaloppet 5 km, Lilla Kistaloppet/Fun Run 1.6 km, and Kistaloppet MINI for the youngest participants. The courses offer a varied running experience through the high-rise buildings of the Million Programme, the green areas of Järvafältet, and Kista's IT cluster, with start and finish at Jan Stenbecks torg near Kista Galleria. The event emphasizes accessibility and community (including the #RUN4ZERO initiative) and is designed for both recreational runners and those who want to compete on the controlled 5 km course. The event is usually complemented by music, entertainment, and a festival atmosphere along the route.
course_highlights: Controlled 5 km course through Kista: high-rise buildings, Järvafältet green areas, and the IT cluster
Start and finish centrally at Färögatan near Jan Stenbecks torg, adjacent to Kista Galleria
Music stations/DJs and entertainment along the route for a festival atmosphere
additional: Registration is free and includes a medal; registration is open until September 17 (subject to availability). Bib distribution at the competition center in Kista Galleria (opposite McDonald's): Friday, September 19, 12:00 - 18:00 and Saturday, September 20, 09:15 - 13:00 (bib must be picked up at least 30 minutes before start). Water stations are available at the finish line; medical personnel are on site. Only the adult class (Kistaloppet 5K) has official timing; other races, including Fun Run, are non-timed. Volunteers are expected to be available approximately 09:00 - 15:30. Races for the whole family: 5K, LILLA Kistaloppet, Kistaloppet MINI, and Fun Run; registration is free; Lilla Kistaloppet is approximately 1.6 km and MINI 500 m; medals are awarded to all finishers of Lilla Kistaloppet; start times and bib pickup at Kista Galleria.

name: Coop Eskilstunarunt
description: A flat course without hills, offering a chance for good times along the river in central Eskilstuna. Start and finish in the city park.

images.alt_text: Starten av Coop Eskilstunarunt, ett terränglopp i centrala Eskilstuna.
Coop Eskilstunarunt startportal med löpare i parken.
Barn och vuxna startar Coop Eskilstunarunt i stadsparken.
Coop Eskilstunarunt startbåge med löpare.
Löpare vid startlinjen under Coop Östras banderoll för Coop Eskilstunarunt.
Deltagare i Coop Eskilstunarunt som springer under startbågen i stadsparken.

name: Black River Run, 100 miles
location: Västerås SOKs klubbstuga Orientalen, Västerås, Sweden
description: Black River Run is an urban ultramarathon in Västerås offered at several distances: 100 miles (161 km), 50 miles (80.5 km), Intro Ultra (48 km), 20 miles (32.2 km), and 10 miles. The start, turnaround, and finish are at Västerås SOK's clubhouse Orientalen, which has changing rooms, showers, and a sauna. The course consists of a varied loop of 10 miles (16.1 km) with technical trails, jogging tracks, gravel roads, hiking trails, and sections of asphalt. The race is organized by Västerås Running Club and offers rewards such as a medal for completing the race and a belt buckle for 100 miles under 24 hours.
course_highlights: One lap = 10 miles (16.1 km); the race is run in repeated laps
Very varied terrain: technical trails, jogging tracks, gravel roads, hiking trails, and some asphalt
City-close course with start/turnaround/finish at Västerås SOK's clubhouse Orientalen
additional: Distances: 100 miles, 50 miles, Intro Ultra (48 km), 20 miles, and 10 miles. Start/turnaround/finish at Västerås SOK's clubhouse Orientalen with changing rooms, showers, and a sauna. 100-mile runners who complete the course within 24 hours receive BRR's belt buckle; others who finish receive a medal. Participants can opt out of the medal, in which case the organizer will donate 20 SEK to Doctors Without Borders. The distances include 100 miles, 50 miles, Intro Ultra 48 km, 20 miles, and 10 miles; the course is permanently marked with red posts; start and finish at Orientalen; 24-hour time limit for 100 miles; sauna and showers in the clubhouse.

name: Run in Sopot IV - Opera Leśna
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 5 km - mieszkańcy Sopotu posiadający Kartę Sopocką

description: Run in Sopot Opera Leśna is a 5 km race that will take place on September 19, 2026, in Sopot. The start and finish are located at the parking lot near Opera Leśna, and the route runs through scenic areas around this location. The race is part of a series of four events held at different dates and locations in Sopot, offering participants a unique atmosphere and the opportunity to compete over a short distance. The participant limit is 250 people, ensuring an intimate and well-organized event.
course_highlights: Route of 5 km around Opera Leśna in Sopot
Start and finish at the parking lot near Opera Leśna
Race takes place in a picturesque park and green areas
additional: Limit of 250 participants. Only runners with start numbers and organizational staff are allowed on the route. Participants line up at the start in a designated zone. The finish line is located at the same place as the start. The event includes several editions, with the main race on September 19, 2026; discounts available for Sopot residents with the Sopot Card; routes include beach and park areas; participants receive medals and drinks.

name: Rakvere 43. Rahvajooks
description: Rakvere 43. Rahvajooks on traditsiooniline rahvaspordiüritus, mis kutsub osalema kõiki jooksuhuvilisi. Võistlus toimub Rakvere linnastaadionil ning pakub mitmekesiseid distantsivalikuid nii lastele kui täiskasvanutele. Rajad on hoolikalt valitud, et pakkuda nauditavat jooksukogemust ning toetada tervislikku eluviisi. Üritus on avatud kõigile, kes on piisavalt treenitud valitud distantsi läbimiseks.
course_highlights: 13,6 km jooksurada
Rajale ei ole lubatud kepikõndi teha
Eraldi rahvakõnni distants kõndijatele
additional: Stardimaterjalide väljastamine ja kohapeal registreerimine toimub 26. septembril kell 14.30-19.30 ja võistluspäeval 27. septembril kell 12.00-13.30 Paide Masinatehase Spordihallis. Ümberregistreerimine distantsi või osaleja vahetuseks on võimalik kuni 23.09.2026. Osalejad jagunevad vanuseklassidesse ning võistlus viiakse läbi Eesti Kergejõustikuliidu võistlusmääruste järgi. Event keskendub ka liikluskorraldusele ja parkimisvõimalustele Rakvere linnastaadioni ümbruses, tagades osalejatele mugava ja turvalise kogemuse.

name: Hökensås Trail
description: Hökensås Trail is a trail race scheduled for September 20, 2026, in the area around First Camp Hökensås outside Tidaholm. The race offers three distances: 19 km, 11.5 km, and 5.5 km, with start and finish at First Camp Hökensås between 10:00 and 14:00. The organizer CKU6 (Cykelklubben U6) offers the race as part of Motionsloppet, in collaboration with Grebbestad Multisport according to the information. The terrain combines forest roads and trails with roots and stones, providing natural challenges in the Hökensås area.
course_highlights: Distanser: 19 km, 11,5 km och 5,5 km
Start och mål vid First Camp Hökensås i Tidaholm
Starttider mellan 10:00 och 14:00
additional: Distanserna: 19 km, 11,5 km och 5,5 km; Start/utgår från First Camp Hökensås; Starttider 10:00 - 14:00; Sportdryckleverantör Umara; Arrangör CKU6 inom Motionsloppet; Kontakt: hokensastrail@motionsloppet.se

name: Coop Linköping Runt
price_range: Gratis för LGIF-medlemmar; övriga deltagare pris ej angivet
description: COOP Linköping Runt is a city race in Linköping with start and finish at Trädgårdsföreningen. The race is organized by Linköpings GIF (LGIF) in collaboration with COOP Linköping, and registration is done via cooplinkopingrunt.se. For LGIF members, the race is free with the campaign code LGIF2024; other participants pay the price listed on the website. The event also seeks volunteers and offers a clear city tour experience in central Linköping.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Trädgårdsföreningen, centrally in Linköping
City run focusing on Linköping's city center
LGIF2024 campaign makes the race free for LGIF members
additional: The website contains sections about Time & Place, Registration Fee, Registration, Timing, Prizes, Max Time, Bib Numbers, Start Certificate, Transfer of Start Place, Class Change, Absence/Insurance, Changing & Shower, Clothing Drop, Toilet, Warm-up, Food & Drink, Energy, Medical Services, Results, and Terms. Registration is via cooplinkopingrunt.se; the campaign code LGIF2024 makes the race free for LGIF members; volunteers are sought.

name: XV Półmaraton Augustowski
location: Amfiteatr Miejski, Augustów, Podlaskie Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 15th Augustów Half Marathon will take place on September 20, 2026, in Augustów, starting at 1:00 PM at the Municipal Amphitheater. Participants will cover the half marathon distance, which is 21.0975 km, running along a route that is half the length of a full marathon. The event is organized by the Augustów Swimming Society and is an important running event in the region.
course_highlights: Distance of 21.0975 km - classic half marathon
Start and finish at the Municipal Amphitheater in Augustów
The route runs through scenic areas of Augustów
additional: The event also includes other races and activities, and registration details and the start list are available on the official website.

name: Enhörna Challenge
location: Södertälje IP, Södertälje, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Enhörna Challenge is a 5000-meter track race organized by Enhörna IF at Södertälje IP. The competition is open to both men and women and is divided into heats based on runners' ability. The first heat starts at 18:30, with the faster heats following later in the evening. It is a well-organized event with check-ins up to 45 minutes before each heat. Welcome to participate in this challenging and exciting running festival!
course_highlights: 5000 meters on track
Heat division based on runners' ability
Organized at Södertälje IP
additional: Check-in occurs up to 45 minutes before each heat. There are several heats with start times around 18:30, 19:15, and 19:45 depending on the number of participants and runners' levels. The event has a strong tradition and attracts runners from the region, including elite performances such as Johanna Anvell who has run under 37 minutes in the 10,000 meters. It is an opportunity for runners to challenge themselves and participate in a well-organized competition.

name: Brommaspelen
description: The Bromma Games is an athletics competition organized by Bromma IF that promotes athletics and sports development in the Bromma area. The competition welcomes children, youth, and adults and offers a wide range of events and classes. The event is an important part of the club's activities and contributes to both elite and recreational development in athletics. Officials are encouraged to register to help with the execution of the competition.
course_highlights: Wide range of athletics events including sprints, jumps, and throws
Held at Stockholm Stadium, an iconic athletics venue
Open to participants from age 9 and up, with opportunities to compete in different age groups
additional: Officials are encouraged to register to help with the competition. The office is located at Stora Mossen IP with entrance from Västerled, but visits require an appointment. Registration for the competition is via Sportadmin and includes various events for different age groups. The event is part of Bromma IF's broad activities in athletics and offers opportunities for both competitors and officials.

name: 20. ETAPP
description: 20. ETAPP on osa Stamina Spordiklubi korraldatud jooksusarjast, mis toimub Tallinnas Järve terviserajal. See etapp pakub osalejatele võimalust nautida linnalähedast terviserada, mis sobib hästi nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele. Üritus on traditsiooniline ja hästi korraldatud, pakkudes meeldivat spordielamust ning kogukonnatunnet. Osalejad saavad nautida kaunist loodust ja tervislikku liikumist värskes õhus.
course_highlights: Järve terviserada Tallinnas
Linnalähedane ja hästi hooldatud terviserada
Sobib nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele
additional: Võistlused hõlmavad disc golfi, motokrossi ja jooksu, osalejate ja pealtvaatajate jaoks on saadaval erinevad tegevused ning võistluste tulemused ja info on kättesaadavad veebilehel.

name: 15. Tartu Linnamaratoni Lastejooksud
description: Tartu Linnamaratoni lastejooksud on kõigile lastele avatud jooksuvõistlus, kus osalemisrõõm on peamine eesmärk. Distantside ja vanusegruppide osas on soovituslikud juhised, kuid iga laps on rajal oodatud ja võrdne. Stardinumbrid väljastatakse tund enne starti ning võistlust ei korraldata paremusjärjestuse alusel. Üritus toimub Tartu Raekoja platsil ning pakub võimalust osaleda nii eelregistreerunult kui ka kohapeal.
course_highlights: Lastejooksud toimuvad Tartu Raekoja platsil
Osalemine on avatud kõigile lastele sõltumata vanusest ja varasemast kogemusest
Stardinumbrid on kõigil lastel ühesugused (number 1) ja stardikorraldus lihtne
additional: Eelregistreerunutele saadetakse unikaalne QR-kood stardinumbri kättesaamiseks. Stardinumbrite väljastamine algab 1 tund enne starti Tartu turuhoone juures. Kõik lapsed stardivad stardinumbriga 1. Võimalus alla laadida ja värvida personaalne diplom. Osalejate nimed avaldatakse pärast üritust kodulehel. Kõigi eelregistreerunute vahel loositakse auhindu. Mitmed koostööpartnerid pakuvad osalejatele soodustusi. Nohtavad medaleid ja diplomeid kõigile osalejatele, registreerimine toimub nii online kui ka kohapeal, osavõtutasu on 4 eurot.

name: TCS Lidingöloppet (Lidingöloppshelgen)
distance_verbose: 30 km, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 1.7 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 200 kr till och med 6/9 2026 (Gruppanmälan öppen tom 6/9)

description: TCS Lidingöloppet is the world's largest cross-country race, held on the last weekend of September on Lidingö. The weekend offers events for all levels - from toddler races of 1.7 km to the classic 30 km race - and attracts over 30,000 runners to its scenic, hilly courses. The event is both a competitive challenge and a running festival with a Sports Fair where you can pick up your bib and meet exhibitors. The natural surroundings and soft trails are the hallmark of the race.
course_highlights: Hilly, soft trails through forests and open areas: alternating between flat meadows, gravel roads, sloping paths, and steep inclines
TCS Lidingöloppet 30 km: approximately 522 meters of elevation gain
TCS Lidingöloppet 15 km: approximately 250 meters of elevation gain; start at Koltorp and finish at Grönsta Gärde
additional: All finishers receive the TCS Lidingöloppet bronze medal with a unique Carl Milles motif each year; a silver medal is available if you meet the silver time and started in start group 2 or lower. A diploma is provided as a PDF in the results email (a paper diploma can be ordered for 50 SEK including shipping). Enervit offers fueling service along the course (product stations for a fee). Minimum age: 30 km = 17 years, 15 km = 15 years (several other age limits apply for different races). The Sports Fair is used for bib distribution and exhibitors. Lidingöloppet is a non-profit organization run by a club (contact: Vasavägen 82, 181 41 Lidingö; phone 08-7652615; email info@lidingoloppet.se). Early Bird discount (20%) is already deducted from prices marked with *. Plan your experience: bib, partners, and exhibitors are on site. Environmentally friendly travel options include free buses from Ropsten to Lidingövallen, running buses from several locations in central Sweden, bike parking, and carpooling. Limited access and few parking options during the race. Seeding race before the weekend: Vårmilen can be purchased as a seeding race (price 100 - 200 SEK).

name: ELKE Tallinn Run - Noblessner 2026
description: ELKE Tallinn Run toimub Noblessneris, pakkudes liikumisrõõmu ja elamusi kogu perele. Kaunis mereäärne piirkond loob ideaalse tausta nii sportlikeks tegevusteks kui ka meeldivaks päevaks väljas. Võistluspäev algab lastejooksuga ning pakub erinevaid distantsi valikuid, mis sobivad nii algajatele kui kogenud jooksjatele. Lisaks spordile on kavas ka tasuta kontsert ja mitmekesine programm, mis loob suurepärase atmosfääri kõigile osalejatele ja pealtvaatajatele.
course_highlights: Kaunis mereäärne Noblessneri piirkond
Vaated Noblessnerile ja Põhja-Tallinnale
Mitmekülgsed distantsid lastele ja täiskasvanutele
additional: Võistluspäev algab lastejooksuga kell 13:00. 2,5 km ja Stebby 5 km distantsid algavad kell 14:30 ning Neptunas 10 km distants kell 15:10. Ürituse keskuses on avatud programm kell 11:00 - 17:10. Kell 13:40 toimub Noblessneri keskväljakul tasuta kontsert artistilt INGER. Välitingimustes mereäärne maastik, pere-sõbralik, sisaldab jooksu ja kontserti, sügise sündmus

name: 44. Viking Window Paide-Türi rahvajooks
description: Viking Window Paide-Türi rahvajooks on traditsiooniline rahvaspordiüritus, mis toob kokku jooksusõbrad Järvamaalt ja kaugemalt. Rajal on mitmekesine maastik, mis pakub nii väljakutseid kui ka kauneid vaateid. Üritus on sobilik kõigile vanusegruppidele ning pakub lisaks põhirajale ka lastejookse ja muid aktiivseid tegevusi. Paide ja Türi vahelise raja läbimine on iga-aastane suursündmus, mis ühendab kogukonna ja spordihuvilised.
course_highlights: Paide ja Türi vaheline jooksurada
Mitmekesine maastik ja kaunid vaated
Sobib kõigile vanusegruppidele
additional: Rahvajooksu nädalavahetusel toimuvad lisaks põhirajale lastejooksud ja Paide Südame Sörk. Ürituse raames on korraldatud ka bussigraafikud Paide ja Türi vahel ning liikluskorralduse muudatused. Võistluskeskuse kaardid ja otsetulemused on kättesaadavad veebis. Võistluspäevadel toimuvad ka lastejooksud ja lõbusad jooksud, mis sobivad kogu perele ning kogukonnale.

name: 24. Jooks ümber Võhma
location: Võhma Kooli staadion, Võhma, Lääne-Virumaa, Estonia
description: 24. Jooks ümber Võhma on traditsiooniline 5 km jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Võhma linna tänavatel ja terviserajal. Rada on valdavalt kõva kattega ning tähistatud nooltega asfaldil, võistlejate ees sõidab jalgrattur. Võistlus on avatud kõigile 2020. aastal ja varem sündinutele ning sobib nii jooksjatele kui ka kõndijatele, sealhulgas kepikõndijatele, kes stardivad viimasest reast. Osalejatele on tagatud elektrooniline ajavõtt ja iga lõpetaja saab medali. Võistlus toimub Võhma Kooli staadionil, kus on ka start ja finiš.
course_highlights: 5 km rada Võhma linna tänavatel ja terviserajal
Valdavalt kõva kattega, tähistatud nooltega asfaldil
Võistlejate ees sõidab jalgrattur, rada on avatud liiklusele
additional: Registreerimine toimub internetis kuni 24. septembrini aadressil timesport.ee ning jooksupäeval Võhma kooli ees kell 10:00-11:40. Ajavõtt on elektrooniline kiibiga, mis kinnitatakse pahkluu piirkonda ja tuleb finišis tagastada. Tagastamata või kaotatud kiibi eest on trahv 70 €. Osalejatele jagatakse medaleid ja toimub auhindade loosimine. Võistlejad vastutavad oma tervisliku seisundi eest ise. Lapsed lubatakse rajale lapsevanema vastutusel. Võistluse raames on võimalik registreeruda nii internetis kui ka kohapeal, ning osalejad saavad auhinnad ja medalid. Rada hõlmab linna tänavaid ning asfalti, pakkudes meeldivat ja motiveerivat jooksukogemust. Üritus toimub 26. septembril 2026.

name: Björknässpelen
description: Björknässpelen is an athletics competition organized by Hellas Athletics Club in Nacka. The event includes multiple age groups from children to seniors and offers a fun and relaxed competitive environment. It is part of Hellas Athletics' broad event schedule and is held at Björknäs IP. It is a welcoming competition that promotes joy in athletics and community.
course_highlights: Youth and senior categories
Diverse athletics disciplines
Held in scenic Nacka and Björknäs IP
additional: The competition includes several age groups from children born in 2014 to seniors. Björknässpelen is held at Björknäs IP in Nacka. No specific start times or price information are provided on the available pages. Includes youth and senior classes, opportunities for medals and personal best performances, and registration via SportAdmin.

name: Garmin Półmaraton Gdańsk
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
organizer: Arena Gdańsk Operator Sp. z o.o.
description: The Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Gdańsk, with a course length of 21.0975 km. The start and finish are located at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The race is mass participation, divided into start zones based on declared results, and also offers the possibility to participate in 4-person relay teams. Organizers provide professional timing, medical security, refreshment stations, and water along the route. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as popularizes Gdańsk domestically and internationally.
course_highlights: Half marathon course of 21.0975 km in Gdańsk
Start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk
Division into start zones based on declared results
additional: Start and finish are located at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The start is divided into time zones according to the declared result (red, blue, green, yellow). Relays start from the blue zone. The race kit includes a waterproof bib with a chip, timing measurement, medical security, water at refreshment points, a finish line buffet, and a medal. The full race kit is guaranteed for payments made by August 30, 2026. The bib must be attached horizontally to the front of the shirt. Passing the bib to another person without the organizer's consent is prohibited. The event includes various distances, including the half marathon and 5 km, with a participant limit of up to 10,000. Registration is online, and fees can be paid via Przelewy24 or traditional bank transfer. There are also races for children and youth available.

name: Nocna Piątka 2026
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Night Five is a unique 5-kilometer race scheduled for September 26, 2026, in Gdańsk, taking place the day before the Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon. The start and finish are located on the illuminated surface of the Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk stadium, where participants will enjoy a spectacular show with laser displays, music, and light effects. The race route runs through the city, enhanced with fan zones featuring music and fire shows, creating a distinctive night atmosphere. This is a new edition of the well-known race accompanying the half marathon, moved to Saturday evening to provide runners and spectators with an exceptional experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the illuminated surface of Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk stadium
Route through the city with fire shows and fan zones with music and a DJ
Spectacular lighting with laser shows and energetic music
additional: The race takes place the day before the half marathon, start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk stadium, nighttime atmosphere with music, laser and fire shows, fan zones with DJ. Evening run with laser and pyrotechnic displays, start at 20:00, illuminated route, event accompanying Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon, participant limit not specified, attractions and visual effects at the highest level.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 41. Jooks ümber Porkuni järve
description: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari on traditsiooniline jooksu- ja kõnnisari, mis pakub mitmekesiseid distantsivalikuid erinevatele vanuseklassidele ja tasemetele. Sarja etapid toimuvad Lääne-Virumaa kaunites paikades, pakkudes jooksjatele nii võistluslikku pinget kui ka sportlikku elamust. Sarja jooksul on populaarsed nii põhijooksud kui ka noorte- ja lastejooksud, mis motiveerivad liikumist ja tervislikku eluviisi. Jooksusarja etapid on leidnud kindla koha jooksjate kalendris ja südames.
course_highlights: Mitmekesised distantsid alates lastejooksudest kuni põhijooksudeni
Rajad kulgevad Lääne-Virumaa kaunites looduskaunites paikades
Sarja jooksul vahelduvad jooksusuunad ja traditsioonilised etapid
additional: Sarjas on eraldi jooksud lastele ja noortele, kus osalemine ei ole ametlik võistlusdistants, kuid pakub väärtuslikku jooksuelamust. Sarja etapid toimuvad erinevates paikades Lääne-Virumaal, näiteks Kadrina Paisjärve ääres, Simuna-Laekvere jooks ja Kunda linna jooks. Osalejate arv on olnud suur, näiteks Kunda jooksul üle 200 sportlase. Sarja jooksul on ka tervisekõnnid ja mitmekülgsed vanuseklassid. Sündmus hõlmab erinevaid võistlusdistantsse nagu põhidistants, minijooks, tillujooks, lastejooks ja noortejooks, ning pakub võimalust osaleda ka käimisvõistlustel.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Metsajooks 2026
description: Sportland Kõrvemaa Metsajooks on 27. septembril 2026 toimuv maastikujooks, mis pakub osalejatele võimalust joosta läbi ürgse looduskaitseala kaunite radade. Võistlusel on distantsid 21 km, 10 km, 5 km ning noortejooks kuni 17-aastastele, lisaks tasuta lastejooksud. Rajad kulgevad 100% looduskaitsealal, pakkudes hingematvaid vaateid ja värsket loodust. Võistluskeskus on mugavalt Tallinna lähedal ning kogu pere saab nautida lisategevusi, lastehoidu, sauna ja kümblustünne. Kõik lõpetajad saavad uhke medali ja kingitused, võitjatele on auhinnad ning hooaja parimad ja meeskonnad saavad tunnustust.
course_highlights: 100% rada kulgeb imekaunil looduskaitsealal
Maastikujooks ürgses looduses, vahelduvad tõusud ja laskumised
Rajad sobivad nii algajatele kui kogenud jooksjatele
additional: Võistluskeskus avatud 10:00, lastejooksud alates 10:40, ühissoojendus 11:45. Pärast jooksu tasuta supp ja smuuti, avatud on saun ja kümblustünnid. Sportlandi pop-up pood võistluskeskuses. Võitjatele auhinnad, hooaja parimad ja meeskonnad tunnustatakse. Võimalus rentida privaatne Iglusaun tiigi kaldal. Lastehoid ja tegevused pere pisematele. Finiši sulgemine 15:30. Maastikujooks, metsarajad, pere- ja lastejooksud, registreerimine ja info SIIN, kaasaegne rajakogemus ja pereüritused

name: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet (Rosa Bandet-loppet)
description: The Pink Ribbon Run is part of the TCS Lidingöloppet weekend on Lidingö and offers 4 km or 10 km runs for Cancerfonden. The start times follow the Greensta and Koltorp schedules, and the courses are soft and scenic. From 2025, a new category for ages 9 - 15 in the 4 km race (FP-9-15) will be introduced. 100 SEK of the entry fee goes directly to Cancerfonden, and the Pink Ribbon Run@Home option is available as a home event. The Pink Ribbon Run is included in the Lidingöloppet weekend and is part of the Tjejklassikern and Kortklassikern.
course_highlights: 4 km and 10 km on soft courses in Lidingö's scenic terrain
100 SEK of the entry fee goes directly to Cancerfonden
New category FP-9-15 in 4 km from 2025 for younger runners
additional: The minimum age for Lilla Lidingöloppet is 7 - 15 years. Start times are announced with the Greensta and Koltorp start groups, and rules for warm-up and start pens are followed carefully. 100 SEK of the entry fee goes to Cancerfonden, and the Pink Ribbon Run is part of the Lidingöloppet weekend, Tjejklassikern, and Kortklassikern.

name: Bollnäs Trailrace 2025
location: Bollebergets Naturreservat, Bollnäs, Gävleborg County, Sweden
description: Bollnäs Trailrace is a trail race offering a unique nature experience in Bolleberget Nature Reserve and the area around Bolletjärn. The race features several distances suitable for all ages and levels, from children to seniors, with challenging hills and beautiful views. The main event is Trail 10, a 10 km race with a significant ascent over Stora Bolleberget. The event is organized by Rehns BK and has a long tradition since its start in 2013, with a restart in 2023 after a few years of hiatus.
course_highlights: Stora Bollebergsbacken with 105 m elevation over 720 m of running
Expansive views from Lilla Bolleberget and Bollebergstoppen
Hilly and varied forest trails in the nature reserve
additional: Distance options: Trail 10 (10 km), Trail 5 (5 km), Trail 2 (2 km for ages 11-15), Knattevarvet (750 m for ages 1-10, no timing), 65+ (5 km), Nordic walking 5 km (no timing). Results, start list, and trail maps are available on the website. The race is organized by Rehns BK. The event includes distances for all ages, from 1 to 65+, with a registration deadline of September 16, 2025. The event takes place in scenic surroundings with varied terrain.

name: Sicklaloppet
description: Sicklaloppet is an autumn running festival in Nacka welcoming runners of all ages and levels. The main race is a 10 km recreational run along beautiful lake shores in Sickla and Hammarby Sjöstad, starting and finishing at Sickla Köpkvarter. There is also a 5 km Energy Run and the Little Sicklaloppet for children up to 12 years old. The race offers a scenic and fast course with a lively atmosphere and lots of crowd support. Sicklaloppet is organized by Järla IF Orientering and is a big community event for the whole family.
course_highlights: The course runs along lake shores in Sickla and Hammarby Sjöstad
The surface consists of approximately 60% asphalt, 30% gravel, and 10% wooden bridge
Start and finish at Sickla Köpkvarter with beautiful nature and crowd support
additional: Number bib distribution takes place at the partner XLL Sickla Köpkvarter days before the race and on race day. The race site opens at 08:00 and offers services and food trucks. Warm-up occurs on-site before the start. Registration on race day is possible for an increased fee if the race is not fully booked. All finishers receive a medal. The start pen for the 10 km opens at 12:30. The maximum time for the 10 km is approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes; after that, a rope is drawn at Kyrkviken for safety reasons. Terrain: scenic course along lake shores, registration via partner XLL Sickla Köpkvarter, family-friendly event, includes children's race.

name: 13. Garmin Półmaraton Gdańsk Nocna Piątka
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
organizer: Akademicki Związek Sportowy COSA Oddział w Gdańsku
description: Garmin Half Marathon Gdańsk is an annual running celebration held in the heart of the Tricity area, which will take place in 2026 on September 26-27. The program includes a new event - Night Five, an evening 5 km run with light illuminations, fireworks, and cheering spectators. The main part of the event is the 13th edition of the half marathon on a distance of 21.0975 km, which traditionally starts and finishes at Polsat Plus Arena in Gdańsk. The route is fast and conducive to personal bests, and the atmosphere is exceptional thanks to supporter encouragement and beautiful cityscapes.
course_highlights: Half marathon route of 21.0975 km, fast and PB-friendly
Start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk - the most beautiful stadium in Poland
Night Five - evening 5 km run with light illuminations and fireworks
additional: Start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon start is divided into start zones based on declared results (red, blue, green, yellow). Relays start from the blue zone. The Night Five starts in the evening of September 26, 2026, after 8:00 PM with light illuminations and fireworks. Race packets are issued at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk on September 26-27, 2026. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 1:30 PM on the half marathon day. The event also includes children's races on various distances, warm-ups, award ceremonies, and pre-registration from October 7. Participants can expect attractive cash prizes and record bonuses.

name: Friday Night Run 2026
description: Friday Night Run on energiline ööjooks Tartu südalinnas, mis toimub 2. oktoobril Raekoja platsil. Distants on ligikaudu 4 km, mis kulgeb linnatänavatel ja pakub võimalust nautida sügisese linna atmosfääri koos sõpradega. Jooks ei ole võistlus, osalejad saavad valida ajavõtuga või ajavõtuta läbimise vahel. Üritust saadab muusika ja live kontsert, mis loob meeleoluka õhtuse atmosfääri.
course_highlights: Ligikaudu 4 km pikkune rada Tartu südalinnas
Rada kulgeb linnatänavatel ja pargiradadel
Üks vaheajavõtu punkt ajavõtuga distantsil
additional: Stardinumber peab olema kinnitatud rinnale ja nähtav kogu distantsi vältel. Ajavõtukiip on kinnitatud stardinumbri tagaküljele ja on ühekordse kasutusega. Raja läbimiseks on aega 45 minutit, finiš suletakse kell 21:45. Osavõtutasu sisaldab tähistatud rada, stardinumbrit, ajavõttu (kui on kiip), teenindust finišis ja vajadusel meditsiiniabi. Registreerimine toimub veebis kuni 2. oktoober kell 17:00 ja kohapeal kuni kell 20:30. Event includes registration online and on-site, with medals and T-shirts for participants, and group discounts available

name: TCS Lidingörullet & TCS Lidingöruset, TCS Lidingöfemman
location: Lidingö, Stockholm Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: TCS Lidingöloppet is the world's largest cross-country race and a beloved running challenge held on Lidingö since 1965. The race offers distances from 1.7 km for the youngest to the classic 30 km endurance test, all on scenic and hilly trails. Over 30,000 runners and a large audience gather during race weekend for a world-class running festival that also serves as a celebration of joy of movement and public health. TCS Lidingöloppet is part of En Svensk Klassiker and welcomes all runners regardless of level.
course_highlights: Hilly and soft terrain trails with both flat meadows and steep climbs
Scenic courses around Lidingö with varied surfaces such as gravel roads and trails
Unique medals with Carl Milles motifs for all finishers
additional: Bronze medal with a unique Carl Milles motif for all who complete the race. Possibility of a silver medal for fast times. PDF diploma included, paper diploma can be ordered. Energy services and relay packages offered via Enervit. Bib numbers and honors for diligent participants. Volunteer support and sports fair during race weekend. Free bus to Lidingövallen for participants in TCS Lidingöfemman. Several races during the weekend, including children and youth races, with options to participate in teams and receive medals and diplomas. The event takes place at the end of September 2026 and includes live broadcasts and audience support along the course.

name: Ekerumsloppet
description: Welcome to Ekerumsloppet, a fall cross-country race around Ekerum and Rällaskogen on Öland, organized by Högby IF athletics. The race offers 10 km for adults and approximately 1.3 km for youth, starting at 11:00 and 10:00 respectively, with start and finish at Ekerum Resort. Registration must be completed by September 26, 2026; late registration is available at the bib pickup from 09:00 on race day. The course runs on forest trails around Ekerum and Rällaskogen.
course_highlights: Cross-country trails in forest terrain around Ekerum and Rällaskogen
Start and finish at Ekerum Resort
Two distances: 10 km for adults and approximately 1.3 km for youth
additional: Cross-country race in forest terrain around Ekerum and Rällaskogen; Start and finish at Ekerum Resort; Registration deadline September 26, 2026; Late registration at bib pickup from 09:00 on race day

name: John Bauer Trail Run
distance_verbose: 18 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 2 km, 0.4 km
price_range: 18 km: 400–700 kr; 10 km: 320–600 kr; 5 km upplevelseloppet: 160–300 kr; 5 km Stortrollens lopp: 120 kr; 2 km Knattetrollens lopp: 120–250 kr; 400 m: ej angivet
description: John Bauer Trail Run is a challenging and hilly cross-country race held from IKHP cabin on Huskvarnaberget. The race is offered in several distances (18 km, 10 km, 5 km, and several children/youth classes) and takes place partly on trails and partly on unpaved terrain with significant elevation changes and technical sections. A special feature is Strutsabacken, where run times are measured and the Bergatrollet award is given for the fastest ascent. The event is family-friendly with catering and activities at the start/finish, as well as changing rooms and showers in the IKHP cabin.
course_highlights: Challenging, hilly terrain with both trail and unpaved sections
Strutsabacken (slalom slope) with separate ascent time and the Bergatrollet award
View over Vättern and technical downhill through Ulvadalen
additional: Registration can be done on race day between 9:00 and 11:00. Bibs with timing chips are to be collected at the IKHP cabin no later than 11:15 and must be worn visibly during the race; the chip does not need to be returned. There are water stations placed along the course (kilometer markers per distance), changing rooms and showers in the IKHP cabin, secure valuables storage at bib distribution, and catering at the start/finish. The organizer offers participants a "troll menu" after finishing (show bib). After the race, hamburgers are served; water stations are available along the course; changing rooms and showers; insurance Startklar available (175 SEK/year); maximum 500 participants; bibs must be collected by 11:00 at IKHP cabin.

name: Broloppet Motala
description: Broloppet Motala returns with a new-old course layout and starts and finishes in Stadsparken in central Motala. The race is organized by Motala AIF Friidrott and offers short recreational distances suitable for a wide range of participants - both 5 km and 10 km are available. The event is promoted as one of Sweden's most beautiful recreational races and welcomes recreational runners and runners of all levels to participate on October 3rd.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stadsparken in central Motala
New-old course layout through central parts of Motala
Shorter recreational distances (5 km and 10 km) suitable for casual runners
additional: Organizer: Motala AIF Friidrott. The event is described as "Sweden's most beautiful recreational race". The website encourages to mark October 3rd in the calendar and notes price levels until September 28th (next increase). Four distances: 10 km, 5 km, 1.5 km (youth), and 400 m (kids' race). Bibs can be collected at Team Sportia on October 2nd and 3rd. The award ceremony takes place in Stadsparken around 2:30 PM.

name: Förbifartspremiären
description: The bypass premiere is a one-time event where you can run or walk on the new E4, both above ground and through tunnel tubes, before the road opens to traffic. The race will be held on October 3, 2026, with start and finish at the new traffic junction Akalla and is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. There are race categories (approximately 12 km), recreational categories (choose approximately 4, 7, or 12 km), and walking categories (Herr Gårman, approximately 4 km). The event is highlighted as a unique "once in a lifetime" experience to be among the first to traverse the new road.
course_highlights: The course goes both above ground and through tunnel tubes on the new E4
Start and finish at the new traffic junction Akalla (Vandagatan)
