Recreational class has exits after approximately 4, 7, or 12 km so you can choose your distance during the race
additional: Registration opens February 5 at 12:00. The maximum race time is 1 hour 30 minutes; the competitive category starts around 09:00, the recreational categories have start times between 10:00 and 17:30, and Herr Gårman (walk) between 18:00 and 19:30. Customer service: Gustavslundsvägen 18, 167 51 Bromma, phone +46 8 545 66 440, opening hours Tuesday - Thursday 09:00 - 15:00 (lunch 12:00 - 13:00). Payment for individuals via card, Klarna invoice, or Swish; corporate invoices are only offered for groups of 20+ via special contact. Registration is binding and personal. Registration opens February 5 at 12:00; the first stage Hjulsta - Häggvik is planned to open at the end of 2026; the entire Stockholm Bypass will be completed in 2030; start places are sold through Marathongruppen; the race offers bib number, timing, finish line service, and medal; approximately 10,000 start places were sold in the first hour.

name: Taifspelen
location: Bredstorps IP, Tranås, Jönköping County, Sweden
description: Taifspelen is an athletics competition organized by Tranås AIF FIF at Bredstorps IP, also known as Siw Dahlgren Arena. The event is held on the last Sunday of September and is open to participants from 7 years old up to adults. It is often the last chance of the season to set a personal record, and the event attracts many participants, making it a popular and well-attended competition in the region.
course_highlights: The competition is held at Bredstorps IP, also called Siw Dahlgren Arena
Open to everyone from 7 years old to adults
Last chance of the season to set a personal record
additional: The timetable is published on easyrecord.se and is also available for download. The goal is to minimize conflicts between competitions, but some overlaps may occur. Veterans participate but there are limitations in veteran classes. The arena honors volunteer leaders through the unofficial name Siw Dahlgren Arena. The competition takes place at Bredstorps IP, focusing on creating an inclusive and inspiring competitive environment for all participants. It is an opportunity to challenge oneself and participate in a friendly athletics weekend.

name: Hostruset

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 700 m Barn 3-7 år 50 kr (80 kr efteranmälan)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 km Män, Kvinnor, PF19, Veteraner 60+ och Motion 150 kr (250 kr efteranmälan)

description: The Autumn Run is a fast-paced 5 km race in Örebro with start and finish at Björkhagaskolan. The race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association and is part of the Southern Svealands Running Series. There is also a 700 m children's race for ages 3 - 7. Information on the website is preliminary and will be updated for the 2026 event.
course_highlights: Fast 5 km course on bike paths around Varbergaskogen
Start and finish at Björkhagaskolan (changing rooms and showers available)
Measured course (measurement on 2024-09-08); timing with ankle transponder
additional: Late registration from September 29 (additional fee) can be made via the registration system and on race day (Swish only). Bibs are distributed on race day. Timing is done with a transponder on the ankle, which must be returned (lost transponder incurs a fee of 400 SEK). Parking options at the school are very limited; carpooling or parking at Karlslunds Sports Center is recommended. The race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association and is part of the Southern Svealands Running Series. Parking at the school is very limited; carpool or cycle to the area. Late registration increases the fee and Swish is used on race day. Registration is via anmalmig.nu; results are displayed online via Hug Timing.

name: /M.Pirksaare/Türi Tehisjärve jooks, liikumissari 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksud 11. etapp
description: Türi Tehisjärve jooks on osa 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksude sarjast, mis pakub mitmekesiseid jooksuvõimalusi erinevatele vanuseklassidele. Rada kulgeb ümber Rava tehisjärve, pakkudes vaheldusrikast pinnast liivast, mullast ja kruusast. Võistlusel autasustatakse parimaid jooksjaid ning see sobib nii harrastajatele kui ka noortele jooksusõpradele. Üritus toimub 7. oktoobril 2026 Rava järve ääres Järvamaal.
course_highlights: Jooksurada ümber Rava tehisjärve
Vahelduv pinnas: liiv, muld ja kruus
Rajale jäävad mitmed järvevaated
additional: Järvamaa Järvede jooksude sarjas arvestatakse jooksjaid erinevates vanuseklassides. Rajal on eraldi stardikoridorid ning jooksud sobivad nii mudilastele kui ka täiskasvanutele. Võistlusel autasustatakse parimaid mehi ja naisi, kes läbivad ühe järveringi kõige kiirema ajaga. Võistlus on osa Järvamaa Järvede jooksud sarjast, mis hõlmab mitmeid etappe ning toetab kogukonna ja tervisespordi edendamist.

name: 42. Munamäe–Võru maastikujooks-kõnd
location: SA Võru Spordikeskuse suusabaas Kubijal, Võru, Estonia
description: 42. Munamäe - Võru maastikujooks-kõnd on osa Võrumaa jooksu- ja kõnnisarjast, mis pakub mitmekesiseid distantsivalikuid nii jooksjatele kui ka kõndijatele. Põhidistants kulgeb maastikul ja asfaltteedel, pakkudes vaheldusrikast rada Võru piirkonnas. Sarjas on ka lühemad distantsid ning mudilaste jooksud, mis sobivad igas vanuses osalejatele. Võistlus toimub SA Võru Spordikeskuse suusabaasis Kubijal, mis on tuntud oma kauni looduse ja hea rajatingimuste poolest.
course_highlights: Põhidistants kulgeb maastikul ja asfaltteedel Võru piirkonnas
Mitmekesised distantsid: ca 5,9 km, minidistants 1,16 km ja mudilaste jooksud
Rada on osaliselt maastikuline, osaliselt asfaltkattega
additional: Võistluskeskus avatakse kell 11:00 Kubija Suusabaasis. Bussid väljuvad Kubijalt erinevatesse stardipaikadesse, näiteks Haanjasse ja Kasaritsasse. Sarjas on lisaks jooksule ka kõnd ja mudilaste jooksud. Rada on osaliselt asfalt- ja kruusateedel ning sisaldab ka pehmemat maad Haanja Puhke- ja Spordikeskuse territooriumil. Võistluse raames toimuvad ka väiksemad distantsid lastele ja algajatele, ning registreerimine ning kaardid on kättesaadavad korraldaja kodulehel. Üritus toetab tervislikke eluviise ja kogukonna aktiivset osalemist.

name: Mental Health Run
description: Mental Health Run is a charity race aiming to raise awareness of how important physical activity is for mental health. The race is organized by the association Mental Health Run and all proceeds go directly to psychiatric research. In Stockholm, the start and finish are at the Maritime Museum, and the course is an easy 5 km loop around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken. Everyone should be able to participate regardless of background or fitness level - the event also offers a virtual option.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Maritime Museum on Djurgården
Easy 5 km course around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken
Course on Djurgården with lake views and city environment
additional: There is a virtual version of the race (scheduled for October 10 - 18, 2026) and the event offers medals as an optional add-on during registration as well as the possibility to donate. Optional medals and donations are shipped within a month after the virtual race has ended. Information about bib numbers and pickup is published on the news pages (in previous years, bibs could be collected at Filmstaden Sergel). Medals as an optional add-on and the opportunity to donate to psychiatric research; medals are sent out within a month after the virtual race. The virtual race takes place via the Jogg app during the period October 10 - 18 with a special code, and results are displayed at the finish area. Timing is done with Racetimer; baggage drop, accessible toilets, and refreshments are available; Nordic walking and dogs are allowed to start further back.

name: Å-stadsloppet
price_range: 5 km: 150–300 kr; 10 km: 250–400 kr; 21,1 km: 300–450 kr; KidsRun: Gratis
description: Å-stadsloppet is a city race in Örebro that showcases the city's best features along the Svartån river. On October 10, 2026, distances of 21.1 km, 10 km, 5 km, and an Ullmax KidsRun for children are offered. The race is organized by KFUM Örebro Friidrott with start and services at Tybblelundshallen; information is updated continuously on the organizer's Facebook page. The race courses are measured and the event is conducted according to the rules of the Swedish Athletics Association.
course_highlights: Running along the beautiful Svartån
Passing through scenic Rynningeviken and Wadköping
The 5 km, 10 km, and 21.1 km courses are measured (measurer Bertil Sundin, 2024-09-22)
additional: Number bibs are distributed on race day at Tybblelundshallen (ID is not required and can be collected for multiple people). Timing is done with transponders attached to the foot/ankle and must be returned at the finish line or if the race is abandoned; lost transponders are charged at 400 SEK. Some participants receive a disposable chip on the bib that does not need to be returned. Changing rooms and valuables drop-off are available at Tybblelundshallen. Water stations, toilets, and medical services are located along the course; water and sports drinks are available at 10 km, 21.1 km, and at the finish. Parents are allowed to run with their children in the KidsRun free of charge. The half marathon requires participants to be at least 17 years old during the year; 5 km and 10 km have no age limit. Registration is done via anmalmig.nu; transponder-based timing and bib collection at Tybblelundshallen; water stations along the course; age limit of 17 years for the half marathon; 5 km and 10 km have no age restrictions.

name: Ultunamilen
description: The Ultuna Mile is a recreational race in Uppsala offering distances of 5 km and 10 km. According to the results list published for the race on October 10, 2026, the categories for men in the mentioned distances are visible. The race appears to be organized by Upsala Idrottsförening, with registration managed via SportAdmin. The date for the mentioned edition is October 10, 2026, and results are published in connection with the event.
course_highlights: Distances of 5 km and 10 km
Results published (men's categories) according to EasyRecord
Organized by Upsala Idrottsförening in Uppsala, registration via SportAdmin
additional: The results page shows October 10, 2026, as the date and the distances of 5 km and 10 km. Note that external pages (such as Stockholm-updates) require login for full information.

name: Tjurruset
description: Welcome to Tjurruset in Norra Djurgården – a fun and challenging cross-country race where the fighting spirit often matters more than a perfect running stride. The course offers forest trails, muddy passages, wet sections, and technical elements; choose between 5 or 10 km as an adult. For children, there is Kalvruset (approximately 3 km) and Lilla Kalvruset (approximately 700 m). The event is organized by Marathongruppen together with local athletics clubs and is open to both beginners and experienced participants.
course_highlights: The course in Norra Djurgården with forest trails, muddy passages, and wet sections
Choice between 5 km and 10 km for adults; Kalvruset approximately 3 km and Lilla Kalvruset approximately 700 m for children
Technical terrain with steep hills where shoes with good grip are recommended
additional: Practical information: warm showers in tents are available a few minutes walk from the finish line, as well as simple rinsing facilities immediately after finishing. There are clothing disposal stations for items that may not be taken home. Kalvruset has a medical first aid team on site, and all children receive a medal with the year. The organizer is Marathongruppen in collaboration with Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK; profits go back to sports. Group registration for companies; company tents and gathering areas; profits go back to sports.

name: Tjurruset (Haningen)
location: Rudans friluftsområde, Haninge, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Tjurruset is a challenging and fun cross-country race held in wild forest with natural obstacles in Rudan outdoor area in Haninge. The race offers distances of 5 and 10 kilometers where participants will experience muddy passages, trail paths, and challenging terrain. Tjurruset is known for its fighting spirit and is open to both veterans and beginners who do not fear dirt and muddy clothes. After the race, there are opportunities for showers and rinsing, and the event is organized by Marathongruppen with profits going back to sports.
course_highlights: Wild forest and natural obstacles
Muddy passages and challenging terrain
Trail paths in Rudan outdoor area, Haninge
additional: The bib number is sent home upon registration before September 2, otherwise it can be collected on site from 08:30. The bib number is personal and must be worn with a chip for timing. After the race, there are warm showers in tents and simpler rinsing facilities. There are clothing disposal stations for items that cannot be taken home. Public transport by commuter train to Handen station is recommended. Name changes for start places are possible for a fee until September 24. The race also includes a children's race and often co-organizations with other cross-country races, as well as information about registration, parking, and start times.

name: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ordinarie anmälan via formuläret på hemsidan stänger fredag 26 september klockan 23.59

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan till Lilla Yxbackenloppet by E2C är helt gratis

description: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C is a challenging race held at the classic Yxbacken outside Norrköping. The race consists of five laps, each including a tough ascent of 100 meters in elevation over 350 meters, followed by a downhill in the family slope. Participants can choose to run with or without timing, and pole use is allowed; however, pole users are not counted in the timed class. After the race, participants are offered food and drinks as well as free leg massages, and everyone receives a medal as proof of their achievement.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the foot of Pernilla Wiberg's home slope, Yxbacken
5 laps with 100 meters of elevation gain over 350 meters per lap
Downhill in the family slope between each ascent
additional: Number bibs can be collected at XXL on Friday, October 3rd between 14:00 and 18:00. Late registration is possible via the website until October 1st and on-site with Swish payment. Liquids are available at the start and finish areas. Manheims Säteri provides food and drinks after the race, Fenix Brewery offers non-alcoholic beer, and Finspångs Brunnsborrning supplies sports drinks. Free leg massages are offered before and after the race. Professional timing with chip on the bib. Toilets and staffed baggage drop-off are available at the competition area. The event takes place in October and includes challenging terrain with steep hills and multiple laps, making it a popular and demanding race for adventurous runners.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 7. Võsu Sügisjooks
description: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari on traditsiooniline jooksu- ja kõnnisari, mis pakub mitmekesiseid jooksuvõimalusi erinevatele vanuseklassidele ja tasemetele. Sarja etapid toimuvad Lääne-Virumaa piirkonnas, pakkudes jooksjatele kauneid maastikke ja meeldivat sportlikku kogemust. Võsu Sügisjooks on sarja 7. etapp, mis toimub Võsu Laine piirkonnas ning on osa pika traditsiooniga jooksusarjast. Sarja eesmärk on motiveerida inimesi aktiivselt liikuma ja nautima jooksu ning tervisesporti.
course_highlights: Mitmekesine maastik Lääne-Virumaa piirkonnas
Pika traditsiooniga jooksusarja osa
Rajad sobivad erinevatele vanuseklassidele ja tasemetele
additional: Sarjas on erinevad distantsid ja vanuseklassid, sh noortejooksud ja lastejooksud. Sarja etapid toimuvad erinevates paikades Lääne-Virumaal, kusjuures jooksude suund ja maastik võivad aastati varieeruda. Osalejatele on oluline registreeruda õigeaegselt, kuid täpsemad registreerumise ja hinnainfo detailid puuduvad. Võsu Sügisjooksu raames toimuvad ka teised jooksud ja tegevused, registreerimine toimub veebis ning osalejatele on võimalus saada autasustusi vanuseklasside kaupa.

name: 71. Viljandi Linnajooks
description: Viljandi Linnajooks on traditsiooniline kestvusjooks, mis toimub igal aastal oktoobrikuu teisel pühapäeval Viljandi linnas. Jooks kulgeb ümber Viljandi järve ning on üks Eesti vanimaid spordivõistlusi, kuhu koguneb jooksuparemik üle kogu riigi. Lisaks põhijooksule toimub mitmeid rahvaspordiüritusi, sealhulgas lastejooksud erinevatele vanusegruppidele. Viljandi Linnajooksu rada on 10,4 km pikkune ning üritus pakub sportlikku ja meeleolukat kogemust nii harrastajatele kui ka profisportlastele.
course_highlights: Jooks ümber Viljandi järve
Raja pikkus 10,4 km
Üks Eesti vanimaid kestvusjooksu traditsioone
additional: Lastejooksud vanusegruppidele 5 - 6, 7 - 8, 9 - 10 ja 11 - 12 aastat, tasuta ja ilma ajavõtuta. Rahvajooks 5 km kell 11.00. Autasustamine toimub kell 14.00. Registreerimine ja stardimaterjalide väljastamine Vabaduse platsil 9.00 - 11.30. Jooksutrassi sulgemine kell 14.30. Võistluspäev algab registreerimisega Vabaduse platsil kell 9:00 ning võistlused toimuvad kuni kella 14:30. Osalejatele antakse medaleid ning võistluse raames korraldatakse ka lastevõistlusi ja harrastajate jooksu.

name: Hässelbyloppet / Lilla Hässelbyloppet
description: Welcome to Hässelbyloppet on Sunday, October 11, 2026 - a fast and well-organized 10 km race through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta, and Vällingby in northwest Stockholm. The course is flat, precisely measured to 10,000 meters, and sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. On the same day, the Little Hässelbyloppet for children and youth is also held. All information about the course, start, registration, and practical details for runners can be found on the website.
course_highlights: Flat and fast 10 km course through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta, and Vällingby
Asphalt for most of the course; start on grass and finish on all-weather track
Two water stations along the course
additional: Race center is Hässelby Idrottsplats (Loviselundsvägen 100), the start takes place on a field 400 meters from the sports ground, and Hässelby Gård station is less than a kilometer away. The minimum age for the main race is 14 years (born in 2012 or earlier); children aged 5-13 can participate in Little Hässelbyloppet. The maximum allowed time is 2 hours. The course has been measured by an approved course measurer and sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association; the event is broadcast live as part of the adidas Adizero Running Tour, and pacers are available (approximately 37:30 - 60 minutes). Live streaming of the event is offered according to information from the organizer.

name: Night Trail Run (Sollentuna) — Hundtrail / 5 km & 10 km
description: Night Trail Run is a nighttime trail race focused on the experience and the magic of darkness. Dog trail is a special class where you can share the evening with your dog on 5 km or 10 km, and the courses are designed for a memorable evening in the forest. The event emphasizes safety in the dark - the courses are reflective marked and headlamps are mandatory. All proceeds go to youth sports in Attunda Orienteering Club.
course_highlights: Reflective marked courses
Free start time 18:00 - 19:30 (10 km until 19:00)
Two distances for dog handlers: 5 km and 10 km
additional: Free start time between 18:00 - 19:30 (10 km can start until 19:00). The courses are reflectively marked and headlamps are mandatory. The event is for runners who want to run together with their dog (5 and 10 km). Free start time between 18:00 - 19:30 (10 km until 19:00); courses with reflectors; headlamp required.

name: Hellasloppet
description: Hellasloppet is a family-friendly running event at Hellasgården in Nacka that invites runners of all ages and levels. The races go through the Hellas area past lakes and over hills on lovely running trails and roads, offering short courses for children as well as longer options for recreational runners. For the youngest participants, there is a relatively flat course, and the event is arranged as a pleasant day with music, refreshments, and award ceremonies. It is emphasized as a local and friendly family race with plenty of parking and cycling options.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Hellas area past lakes and over hills
Beautiful running trails and sections on roads - mixed terrain
Three-stage format: 400 m (MICA race), 1,400 m, and 5 km
additional: Location: Hellasgården, Ältavägen 101, Nacka; bus from Slussen is indicated as a transportation option. There is ample parking and bicycle parking at the start area. Award ceremonies are held continuously and the catering will be open. The MICA race (400 m) is part of Hellasloppet. Distances include 400 m, 1,400 m, 5 km, and 7.5 km, as well as a 1.5 km walking loop. Bus from Slussen to Hellasgården; plenty of parking around the start area and space to park bikes at the start; catering opens.

name: Växjö Marathon
description: Welcome to the 32nd edition of Växjö Marathon, presented by VLK. The race runs eight laps around Växjösjön on what the organizers call "Sweden's fastest course." The course is very flat (elevation change approx. 3 m) and mostly paved with about 300 meters of fine gravel; each lap is measured in August 2024. There is also a relay race and a children's race, and the course is marked with lead cyclists and flag marshals.
course_highlights: Eight laps around Växjösjön
Very flat course, elevation change approx. 3 m
Mostly asphalt with ~300 m fine gravel; marked with lead cyclists and flag marshals
additional: The course is not closed, which means runners share the paths with pedestrians and cyclists; motor traffic occurs at three points along the course. Each lap is measured (August 2024). There is an option to participate in a relay as a team, and the event also includes a children's race for 2026. The relay consists of four runners each running two laps; the course is open to pedestrians and cyclists and shares space with them as well as motor traffic at three locations.

name: Uppsala Marathon (inkl. DM i marathon)
price_range: Maraton: 825 kr; Halvmaraton: 625 kr; Stafett (4 deltagare): 1800 kr
description: Uppsala Marathon is an urban and nature marathon that runs through historic Uppsala with start and finish at Uppsala Castle. The race combines city pulse in central Uppsala with scenic views along Ekoln, Fyrisån, and the mounds in Gamla Uppsala. The event offers a marathon, half marathon, and relay for four-person teams, and also serves as the district championship (DM) in marathon. The race is spectator-friendly and targets both competitive runners and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Uppsala Castle; passes Carolina Rediviva and central shopping streets
The route goes along the shores of Ekoln and Fyrisån and out to the mounds in Gamla Uppsala
Flat, fast single-loop course consisting of half asphalt and half hard-packed gravel
additional: Start and finish at Uppsala Castle. The start area opens at 07:00; bib number pickup from October 1 to 16 at Löplabbet (Dragarbrunns Torg 4 - 6) and on race day October 17 from 07:30 (lasts 45 minutes before the start). Registration is accepted via RaceID and Epassi can be used as payment. Maximum participants: Marathon 1500, Half Marathon 2500, Marathon relay 150 teams. Anyone registering by September 15, 2026, will have their name on the bib. Age limit 17 years for marathon/half marathon (born 2009 or earlier). Award ceremony at the finish area at 13:00. Food and non-alcoholic drinks are available at the finish area; relay teams receive a finisher’s shirt and medal. Recommended to use public transport or bike (bus stops Slottsbacken or Blåsenhus, buses 2 and 7); parking is available within walking distance. DM medals in Marathon and Half Marathon; medal ceremony the Tuesday after the race; age limit 17 years for marathon/half marathon; Epassi payment, transfer via RaceID, start times, transportation and parking, baggage drop, changing/shower, insurance, and prizes; registration opens until October 12, 2026, with the possibility of closing earlier if maximum capacity is reached.

name: Jönköping 10K/5K
description: Jönköping 10K/5K is a pleasant race in central Jönköping suitable for both elite runners and enthusiastic amateurs. The races, starting at Lillsjöplan, take place on a completely flat and measured course, making it ideal for personal bests and seedings. Both 5 km (1 lap) and 10 km (2 laps) options are offered, and the organizers emphasize a good atmosphere with pacemakers for 40, 45, and 50 minutes on the 10K. Group registration offers a 10% discount when three runners sign up together, and there are options for group registration for larger parties.
course_highlights: Completely flat course in central Jönköping, starting at Lillsjöplan
5 km = 1 lap, 10 km = 2 laps
The course is measured by the Swedish Athletics Federation and seedings are based on it
additional: Start at Lillsjöplan. 5K run in one lap, 10K in two laps. Pacemakers with flags for 40, 45, and 50 minutes on the 10K. Register up to 5 runners at the same time via the regular registration; for more runners, group registration is available. Group registration (three people) offers a 10% discount and the chance to win prizes. No start certificates are sent out. The course and profile are presented on the map/course profile page. Date and start time: October 17, 2026, start at 11:00 at Lillsjöplan; 5K in one lap, 10K in two laps; refreshment stations with UMARA sports drinks and water; baggage drop-off at start/finish; proximity to parking garages; start list and pacer information; limited baggage drop-off and on-site start certificate pickup.

name: XC-race Linköping
description: Linköping XC Race is an annual cross-country race organized by Linköpings OK at Vidingsjön, Linköping. The race offers a marked 5 km trail in varied terrain, including forest paths and marshes, and is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive categories. Participants can choose between 5 km, 10 km for men and women, as well as a recreational class of 5 km, with the 10 km races run twice. The event is known for its challenging and muddy terrain, with start and finish at Vidingsjö Sports Center.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with forest paths and marshes
Distance options for both recreational and competitive runners
Start and finish at Vidingsjö Sports Center
additional: Muddy and challenging terrain, registration via website with payment by card or Swish on site, parking at Vidingsjön and LOK-gården.

name: Night Trail Run 30 km
description: Night Trail Run in October offers evening trail runs focusing on the experience of how light and darkness meet. You can choose 5 km, 10 km, or 30 km with start and finish at Väsby gård in Sollentuna. For the 30 km, you navigate with a downloadable GPS route and map, and the race has energy stations along the way. Welcome to register - all proceeds go to youth sports in Attunda Orienteering Club.
course_highlights: Night trail run in the glow of headlamps with course marked with reflectors
30 km run with GPS route and map, featuring two energy stations
The final part of the 30 km follows the same reflector-marked course as the 5/10 km
additional: For 5 km and 10 km, there is free start time within specified windows (18:00 - 19:30 for 5 km; 18:00 - 19:00 for 10 km). For the 30 km, you receive a GPS route and map in advance, the race has two energy stations and a maximum time of 4 hours 30 minutes; the last part follows the reflector course. Start and finish are at Väsby gård in Sollentuna, the organizer requests participants to finish by 20:30, and registration is open until one hour before each start. The 30 km starts at 16:00 on October 17, 2026. For 5 km, free start is between 18:00 - 19:30, and for 10 km between 18:00 - 19:00; the course follows the reflector course to the finish.

name: Stockholms Brantaste
description: Stockholms Brantaste is an intense uphill race in Hammarbybacken scheduled for October 17, 2026. The race is just over 3 - 3.5 km long with steep inclines and over 200 meters of elevation gain, suitable for both experienced runners and beginners looking to challenge themselves. The finish line is at the top of the hill with a beautiful view of the city. The children's races Brantaste Mini and Brantaste Minsta are also offered, but registration for these may be closed at certain times.
course_highlights: Approximately 3 - 3.5 km with over 200 meters of elevation
Up and down the steep slopes of Hammarbyhöjden; finish at the top with a view of the city
Intensive uphill focus (finish line services, water stations along the course)
additional: Start bibs are sent via email (usually about 2 weeks before the race or sooner if registering late). Number bib distribution takes place at the event area Hammarby Fabriksväg (details in the information text) and opens from 09:30 according to participant information. The bib contains a chip and should be worn unfolded at 45 - 90°; attach with safety pins (bring about 4) and write name/phone number and medical info on the back. The race includes timing, a medal, and water stations; in the children's races, water is available at the finish and medals are awarded. Registration for Brantaste Mini and Brantaste Minsta may be closed at certain times. Free uphill training sessions in Hammarbybacken are available before the race day.

name: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026
location: Rönninge, Salem Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan sker på plats och kostar 50 kr.

description: Rönninge Backyard Run is a lap race in Toredal where each lap is 6.706 meters, and the format is built around hourly starts: the first lap starts at 09:00, followed by a new start every full hour up to a total of 12 laps. Participants must complete a lap in under one hour to start the next; the one who completes the most laps (and is fastest on the last lap) wins in the women's and men's categories. The race suits both competitive runners and those who want to challenge their endurance on a technical but easy-to-run trail in the scenic Garnudden. A smaller MiniBackyard is offered for children/beginners with on-site registration and their own start time in the afternoon.
course_highlights: A lap length of 6.706 km with start/finish at Bubblan in Toredal
Surface approximately 80% asphalt and 20% gravel, partly along the promenade around Garnudden
Several longer inclines and a concluding downhill run as well as a flat asphalt stretch towards the finish
additional: Registration for Rönninge Backyard Run opens March 1, 2026. Rönninge 6h (June 6, 2026) starts at 10:00 and runs until 16:00; registration via RaceID (link on the page). MiniBackyard starts at 14:00, registration on site. Registration for the main race is personal and binding; cancellations must be made via info@lopklubb.se no later than October 1 with an administrative fee of 45 SEK. The race features hourly starts: lap 1 at 09:00, lap 2 at 10:00, etc.; the final start at 20:00. Laps are registered with a chip (in the 6-hour race). Coffee and snacks are served at 20:00 after the last lap. The race: 6706 meters per lap; up to 12 laps over twelve hours; first start at 09:00, last start at 20:00; surface approximately 80% asphalt/gravel; women's and men's categories. Mini Backyard is organized by KIF Toredal with a fee of 50 SEK on site.

name: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail
description: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail is a series of trail running events held on hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia with the event base at KJ Barłomino. The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km, and 11 km, providing a variety of challenges for trail runners. The race promotes the beauty of Kashubian landscapes and regional attractions, and participants can enjoy excellent refreshment stations along the route. The event is supported by the #ActiveVillage program and organized by the Pomerania Sports Association.
course_highlights: Hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia
Beautiful Kashubian landscapes
Excellent refreshment stations along the route
additional: The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km, 11 km, and a Junior Trail run up to 1 km. The races take place at KJ Barłomino. The event promotes regional trails and tourist attractions of Pomerania and is supported by the #ActiveVillage program. Supported by Coconaut, with routes of varying difficulty levels, an attractive base in Barłomino, and stunning views of Kashubia.

name: Pomerania Ultra-Trail®
description: Pomerania Ultra-Trail® is a series of trail running events held on hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia, based at KJ Barłomino. The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km, and 11 km, providing a variety of challenges for trail runners. The races promote the beauty of Kashubian landscapes and regional attractions, with well-prepared aid stations along the route. The event is supported by the #ActiveVillage program and organized by the Pomerania Sports Association.
course_highlights: Hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia
Beautiful Kashubian landscapes
Well-stocked aid stations along the route
additional: The event takes place at KJ Barłomino. There are 5 main distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km, 11 km, as well as a Junior run up to 1 km. The organizer is the Pomerania Sports Association. The event promotes long-distance trail running and Nordic Walking. It is supported by the #ActiveVillage program. The event features multiple distances, routes through beautiful Kashubian areas, support from #ActiveVillage, and a base at KJ Barłomino.

name: Täby Halvmarathon
description: Täby Half Marathon is an easy-to-run and fast half marathon in a scenic environment with start and finish at Näsby Castle. The course offers coastal views along Värtan’s shoreline, a scenic loop around Rönningesjön, and a finish back at the sea with a view towards Bogesundslandet. The race is measured and organized by Täby IS Athletics, and suits runners who want to end the season on a fast and beautiful course. In previous years, the race has been very popular with limited spots, so the organizer encourages early registration.
course_highlights: First approximately 5 km along Värtan’s shoreline with sea views
Scenic loop around Rönningesjön passing Ängsholmsbadet and Skavlötens outdoor recreation area
Approximately 125 meters of elevation; about 2/3 asphalt and 1/3 gravel
additional: Start and finish at Näsby Castle. Little Täby Marathon for children aged 5 - 11 years (1.2 km) with start times at 10:00 (born 2017 - 2020) and 10:15 (born 2014 - 2016). Sports drinks from partner Umara are served at water stations. The maximum time for the half marathon is 2 hours and 45 minutes. Bib number distribution: Stadium in Täby Centrum from Wednesday before the race and pickup at the start area from 09:00 to 10:45 on race day. The course has approximately 125 meters of elevation and consists of about 2/3 asphalt and 1/3 gravel; water stations along the course with Umara; previous capacity approximately 1500 participants.

name: Täljemilen
description: Enhörna IF presents Täljemilen - perhaps the fastest controlled measured 10K run this autumn at Geneta Sports Field in Södertälje. The course runs entirely on bicycle and pedestrian paths and is fully asphalted, making the race very fast and suitable for those aiming for a personal best. Water stations are available at 5 km and at the finish line. Instead of medals, the organizer donates a sum to the Children's Cancer Foundation for each registered runner; prizes are awarded to the top 3 in both women's and men's categories, and there will also be a raffle of approximately 20 prizes.
course_highlights: Controlled measured course (approved by a course measurer from the Swedish Athletics Federation)
100% asphalt on bicycle and pedestrian paths - very fast course
Water station at 5 km and at the finish line
additional: Changing rooms are available on site but the organizer recommends that participants come dressed. Late registration on the day of the race is possible if the race is not fully booked. The organizer forgoes medals and instead donates an amount to the Children's Cancer Foundation per registered runner. Prizes are awarded to the top 3 in both women's and men's categories, and approximately 20 prizes will be raffled among all participants. Names and images from the race day may be published on the club's website and social media. Contact information: Henrik Kvarnlöt 073-0400790 and Peter Ness 070-3791299. Last registration date is October 15; late registration on site if spots are available; water at 5 km and at the finish; no medal will be awarded this year; approximately 20 prizes will be raffled among all participants; contact details are provided in the event page text.

name: Påsksmällen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description:
Män och kvinnor öppen klass Landsväg 5 km 12:30 300:-
Män och kvinnor öppen klass Landsväg 10 km 12:30 300:-

description: Easter Run is a classic road and trail race organized by Enhörna IF in Södertälje. The race starts and ends at Enhörna Outdoor Recreation Area and offers several categories for children, youth, and adults. It is a well-established event with a long tradition, where participants can enjoy a varied and scenic course. The event is open to everyone and follows the competition rules of the Swedish Athletics Association.
course_highlights: Combination of road and trail running
Start and finish at Enhörna Outdoor Recreation Area (sports ground)
Multiple distances and categories for children, youth, and adults
additional: Late registration on site is possible up to 60 minutes before each start with an additional fee of 100 SEK for adult categories and 50 SEK for youth categories. Start times for youth categories are 11:00, 11:10, and 11:35, and for adult categories at 12:30. By registering, participants agree to the publication of their name and any photos on the website and social media. Road and trail running, different distances for children, youth, and adults, registration by April 4, late registration on site up to 60 minutes before the start.

name: XVII Półmaraton Ziemi Puckiej
location: Stadion Miejski w Pucku, Puck, Puck County, Poland
description: The 17th Puck Land Half Marathon is a well-known Pomeranian running event, returning in 2026 in a new edition under the banner of STONE TRI & RUN. The race takes place on a refreshed route in an autumn setting, making it an ideal end to the running season. The event features races over the half marathon distance and 5 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic walking march, all with individual start times. It is a perfect opportunity to actively spend time in the beautiful Kashubian landscapes and experience the sporting atmosphere of the Puck Triathlon Series.
course_highlights: Refreshed half marathon route through picturesque Kashubian landscapes
Autumn climate conducive to runners
Final event in the Puck Triathlon Series
additional: The event includes three competitions: a half marathon, a 5 km run, and a 5 km Nordic walking march, all with individual starts. Organizers ensure professional route preparation, excellent marking, and security. The event is part of the STONE TRI & RUN cycle, which promotes an active lifestyle and a family-friendly sporting atmosphere in Kashubia. The route is asphalt, with start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Puck, the finale of the Puck Triathlon Series. Registrations open from December 12, 2025, to October 12, 2026.

name: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C
location: Yxbackens slalombacke, Norrköpings kommun, Östergötland, Sweden
description: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C is a hill race held in Norrköping's own ski slope. The race is described as challenging - in 2024, five tough laps were completed in the hill - and it caters both to competitive runners and families through a separate children's race. E2C is the title partner, and the event combines competition, children's activities, and subsequent prize and photo ceremonies.
course_highlights: Run in Norrköping's ski slope (Yxbacken)
Consisted of five challenging laps in 2024
Children's race "Lilla Yxbackenloppet" introduced in 2024
additional: The 2024 race was held on October 19, and E2C was the title partner for the fourth year. The 2024 children's race had approximately 50 participating children who received medals at the finish line; the winners received wreaths at the award ceremony. Photographer Magnus Media took pictures published on the race's Facebook page. About 300 participants in the first edition; in 2023, the event was photographed by Magnus Andersson (Magnusmedia.nu); the children's race Lilla Yxbackenloppet by E2C was added in 2024.

name: Stockholm: ALL OUT
description: All Out Dubstep is a long-standing and influential club night in Stockholm that has shaped the city's club music scene for nearly two decades. With a unique mix of subbass, mutated garage, hip hop, electro, and techno, the residents create an atmosphere that spans from Kingston to London. The event also celebrates birthdays with a broad lineup of DJs and artists playing everything from dancehall to Afro and Samba. It is a party for everyone who loves club music and the vibrant energy of the dance floor.
course_highlights: Deep subbass and mutated garage as a foundation
Mix of hip hop, electro, and techno with influences from Kingston and London
Wide musical styles from dancehall to Afro and Samba
additional: Free entry between 15:00 and 18:00, then admission from 200 SEK. The event runs from 15:00 to 03:00 and is held at Capital Sound System in Kvarteret / Hus 7, Styckmästargatan 10, Stockholm. Music, club, dubstep, techno, hip hop, Afro, Samba, dancehall, preparty

name: Pärnu Rannajooks
description: Pärnu Rannajooks on Pärnu Kahe Silla Klubi hooaja ja kolmikürituse sarja lõpetav jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Pärnu Rannastaadionil. Võistlejatel on valida 5 ja 10 kilomeetri distantside vahel, mida saab läbida joostes või käies-kepikõndides. Rada kulgeb kaunis Pärnu rannapiirkonnas, pakkudes osalejatele nii loodusvaateid kui ka linnale iseloomulikke arhitektuurimälestisi, sealhulgas rannapromenaadi merevaatega. Üritus on sobilik nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele ning pakub meeldivat spordielamust.
course_highlights: 5 ja 10 km distantsid joostes või käies-kepikõndides
Rada kulgeb Pärnu rannapiirkonnas kaunite loodusvaadete ja arhitektuurimälestistega
Rannapromenaad merevaatega
additional: Distantsivalikus on 5 ja 10 kilomeetrit, mida saab läbida joostes või käies-kepikõndides. Võistlus on osa Pärnu Kahe Silla Klubi kolmikürituse sarjast. Lastejooksud ja virtuaaljooksu distantsid on samuti kavas. Sündmus hõlmab ka virtuaalseid jooksu ja lastejookse ning toimub Pärnu Rannastaadionil, pakkudes võimalust nautida sporti ja loodust üheskoos.

name: Sjögarpslunken 2026
description: Sjögarpslunken is a recurring running event that will celebrate its 50th anniversary in 2026 and is scheduled for Sunday, October 25, 2026. The event page indicates that the race has offered several distances (according to previous registration forms: 2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km, and 14 km) and that the organizer publishes invitations, race rules, start lists, maps, and results on the website. The website describes the course's beautiful scenery and a challenging 14 km profile. More information and details about the course and profile are available via links on the event page.
course_highlights: Beautiful course layout (linked on the event page)
Challenging 14 km course profile
Multiple distances - 2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km, and 14 km (according to previous registration forms)
additional: The race celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026. The website contains links to maps and course profiles as well as previous years' race rules, invitations, start lists, and preliminary results. Previous registration forms (2020) showed options for distance and preferred race day (October 23, 24, or 25). Content includes invitation, race rules, start lists, course map, results, and course profile; 14 km course. The race is traditionally held during the last weekend of October and will celebrate its 50th anniversary in 2026.

name: Sopot Półmaraton
description: Sopot Half Marathon is an annual race covering the half marathon distance, held in the picturesque seaside city of Sopot. Participants have the opportunity to run through charming parts of the city, with the finish line at ERGO Arena, providing a unique atmosphere and comfort. The event attracts runners from all over Poland, offering professional organization and attractive starting packages. It is an excellent opportunity to experience sports emotions in the Pearl of the Baltic and to receive a commemorative medal and T-shirt.
course_highlights: The route runs through the center of Sopot and seaside promenades
Finish line located at ERGO Arena
Picturesque views of the Baltic Sea and the characteristic Sopot pier
additional: The start package includes an official T-shirt and medal. The half marathon route is certified and runs through the center of Sopot and seaside promenades. The finish line is at ERGO Arena, ensuring comfortable conditions for competitors after the race. Start packages are available from February 10, 2026, with a participant limit of 3,500 people, discounts for Sopot Card holders, and the event is part of the Pomorze Half Marathons Crown cycle 2026-2030.

name: John Bauer Trail Run
location: Huskvarna, Jönköping Municipality, Jönköping County, Sweden
description: John Bauer Trail Run is a challenging and quite hilly cross-country race held in Huskvarna, near Lake Vättern. The race offers several distances for both adults and children, including 18 km, 10 km, 5 km, as well as children and youth classes. The courses go partly on trails and partly on unpaved terrain, with demanding hills such as Strutsabacken where the Bergatrollet title is awarded to the fastest runner uphill. The event is family-friendly with changing rooms, showers, catering, and security personnel along the course.
course_highlights: Challenging and quite hilly cross-country race with partly trail and unpaved terrain
Strutsabacken (slalom hill) as a challenging hill with the Bergatrollet race
Water stations with water, sports drinks, and bananas on longer distances
additional: Number bibs with chips are collected on race day no later than 11:15 and must be worn visibly on the front of the shirt. Timing is done with a chip and provides both total time and uphill time at Strutsabacken. Water stations are available at various distances with water, sports drinks, and bananas. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available in the IKHP cabin. Valuables can be left and picked up at the bib distribution. Security personnel and Red Cross medical staff are present. Children and youth classes start at 10:45, adult classes at 11:30, and the 400m toddler run has free start times between 10:00 and 12:00. Trail race with hilly terrain, on-site registration, medals for all participants, prizes for top finishers and Bergatrollet, safety measures including medical support.

name: Höstmilen
description: The Autumn Mile is a cross-country race in the Kolmård Forest outside Åby, north of Norrköping, taking place on November 1, 2026. The course runs on trails between Sörsjön and Lillsjön and offers scenic and challenging terrain for both competitors and recreational runners. The organizer is OK Kolmården, and there are three main course options: the classic 10.6 km, Höstfemman 5.2 km, as well as courses for children and youth.
course_highlights: Cross-country race on trails between Sörsjön and Lillsjön
Höstmilen 10.6 km (Sörsjön → Lillsjön) and Höstfemman 5.2 km (start/finish at Lillsjön)
Running in the scenic and hilly terrain of Kolmård Forest
additional: Registration closes on October 29 at 23:00 online; thereafter, registration is possible on October 31 from 11:00 to 14:00 at XXL and at the start location on November 1. For the classic Höstmilen, a bus departs from Jurslaskolan to Sörsjön. A race information packet with practical details will be published approximately one week before the race. The competition classes have only two prize categories (Men and Women) for the adult races. A complete list of registered participants is published on the 'Registered' page. The distances and race formats are 10.6 km, 5.2 km, and children’s races (1.4 or 2.0 km); team race, corporate race, and school race. The race info and registration can be found at hostmilen.nu.

name: TrailHunt Vooremäe 1000+
description: TrailHunt Vooremäe 1000+ on maastikujooks Vooremäe kaunite terviseradade ja metsade vahel Tartumaal. Võistlus tõstab esile väljakutseid, nagu 1000 tõusumeetrit ühe jooksu jooksul, pakkudes osalejatele võimalust testida oma võimeid ja nautida metsarajalt saadavat positiivset energiat. Võistluskeskus asub uue teenindushoone juures, kus on mugav pesemisvõimalus ja riiete vahetus. Rajal on mehitatud toitlustuspunkt ning ajavõtt toimub puutevaba SPORTIdent süsteemiga. Distantsid varieeruvad 14 km matkast kuni üle 42 km maratonini, kus maratonijooksjad läbivad täpselt kolm 14.1 km pikkust ringi.
course_highlights: 14.1 km pikkune ring, mis vastab Vooremäe suure ringi liikumissuunale
Üle 1000 tõusumeetri kogusumma maratonidistantsil
Mehitatud toitlustuspunkt rajal, mida läbitakse mitu korda
additional: Stardinumber leitav enne võistlust Seiklushundi kodulehe stardiprotokollist. Ajavõtt toimub puutevaba SPORTIdent (SI AIR) süsteemiga, kiip kinnitatakse randmele. Võistluskeskuses on võimalik pärast võistlust pesta ja riideid vahetada. Rajal on üks mehitatud toitlustuspunkt, kus pakutakse vett, coca-colat ja kerget näksimist. Kohapeal registreerimist ei toimu. Ümberregistreerimine ja muudatused ainult e-posti teel. Trailrun, mägine maastik, registreerimine Stebby kaudu, aid stations, finisher-medalid, autasustamine

name: Höstrusket
description: The Autumn Run is a trail and road race in Northern Djurgården, Stockholm, taking place on November 7, 2026. Choose between 10 km, half marathon (21.1 km), or marathon (42.195 km) with start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners and offers motivating pacers, well-stocked water stations, and a festive conclusion to the running season in the Royal National City Park. The event is organized by Marathongruppen in collaboration with local athletics clubs, and the proceeds go back to sports.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen in Northern Djurgården (about 800 m from Ropstens T‑station)
Measured courses mostly on asphalt with some gravel; 10 km: +103.9 m, marathon: total +439 m
Rich water stations and lap services as well as clear kilometer signs
additional: Start/finish at Fisksjöäng (about 800 m from Ropstens T‑station). Bib number distribution, pacer tents, food/coffee sales, drop-off of outerwear and toilets at the event area. Opportunity to change clothes and shower in a facility a few hundred meters away for a fee. Chip timing by RaceTimer; pacers offered for several finish times (list per distance). Max and cut-off times: 10 km 2:00, half marathon 2:30, marathon 5:30 (repetition at the last lap at 13:40). Age limits: 15 years for 10 km (13 years with guardian), 17 years for half marathon and marathon. Certain aids and vehicles (staves, inline skates, strollers, bicycles, handcycles, racing wheelchair) are not allowed; special conditions apply for escorts/wheelchairs. Proceeds go back to sports. Registration is open.

name: Iron Backbone Ultra
description: Iron Backbone Ultra is a trail adventure in Kristinehamn built around the Iron Trail, offering three distances (15 km, 30 km, and 50 km). The race takes place in varied and characterful terrain - deep forests, marshlands, small lakes, pastures, and older trails - where both mental toughness and running joy are tested. The start and finish are at Hultets outdoor recreation area, and the 15 km course partly runs outside the Iron Trail. The organizer Topp & Dröm welcomes both experienced trail runners and those trying trail running for the first time.
course_highlights: The course largely follows the Iron Trail through varied terrain (forests, marshlands, lakes, pastures, and older trails)
Start and finish at Hultets outdoor recreation area, Kristinehamn
The 15 km course partly runs outside the Iron Trail
additional: Three distances are offered: 15 km, 30 km, and 50 km; start and finish at Hultets outdoor recreation area; from October 1st, the number of spots is limited to ensure a specially designed medal for all participants; organizer is Topp & Dröm (contact person Lasse / phone 073-853 75 21) and there are sections for water stations and equipment on the information pages. Start times: 30 km and 50 km at 17:00; 15 km at 17:30. No mug at water stations; bring your own mug. Start and finish at Hultets outdoor recreation area, Kristinehamn. Registration fees are updated over time and from October 1st, the number of spots is limited to secure a specially designed medal for all participants.

name: Jätten Bule-löpet
location: Österbymo, Ydre kommun, Jönköping County, Sweden
description: The Jätten Bule Race is a traditional cross-country race organized by IFK Österbymo on the first weekend of November. The race celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2019 and attracts runners of all ages to the Ydre forests. The distances vary from KnatteBule for the youngest, 2.4 km for children aged 4-12, as well as 5 km and 10 km in running or walking through challenging terrain. The event is a folk festival in autumn attire and welcomes both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in hilly and challenging forest terrain
Distances from children's race to 10 km for adults
The race takes place in the Ydre forests around Bulevallen and Bulespåret
additional: Distances include KnatteBule for the youngest, 2.4 km for children aged 4-12, as well as 5 km and 10 km in running or walking. Bulevallen is the gathering place and IFK Österbymo, together with Ydre Municipality, is responsible for the electric light trail Bulespåret, a 2.4 km hilly course used in connection with the event. The race includes various distances, from children's races to adult races, and is held in a scenic environment in Ydre. Weather conditions in 2026 may affect the terrain, but the race is open to all runners and outdoor enthusiasts.

name: Gdyński Bieg Niepodległości
description: The Gdynia Independence Run is an annual running event organized in Gdynia, as part of the Gdynia Grand Prix 2026. The main race on a 10 km distance attracts runners of various ages, and there are also children's and youth races. The event has a sports-recreational character, and participants can expect professional organization and an atmosphere celebrating Polish independence. During the event, photos and video materials are taken for promotional purposes by the organizers.
course_highlights: Main race on a 10 km distance
Children's and youth races
Part of the Gdynia Grand Prix 2026
additional: During the event, photos and video materials will be taken for promotional purposes of events organized by GCS and the Gdynia City Municipality. Registration is open until October 28, 2026. Results, photo galleries, and partner information are available.

name: II Bieg Legionów Polskich
description: The Polish Legion Run II is a race commemorating the anniversary of Poland regaining independence, held on two distances: 5 km and 10 km. Starts take place in scenic seaside locations: Władysławowo, Rozewie, and Jastrzębia Góra. The organizer provides transportation from Jastrzębia Góra to the start locations and opens the race office the day before and on the race day. The race route is available online, allowing participants to familiarize themselves with the course before the start.
course_highlights: The race route passes through Władysławowo, Rozewie, and Jastrzębia Góra
10 km start from the Haller monument at Morska Street in Władysławowo
5 km start from the bust of Marshal Piłsudski at Garnizonowa Street in Rozewie
additional: Transportation from Jastrzębia Góra to the start locations is provided. The race office is open on November 10, 2025, from 14:30 to 15:30 at OSiR Władysławowo and on November 11, 2025, from 10:20 to 10:50 in Jastrzębia Góra. The race route is available online at https://www.traseo.pl/trasa/bieg-legionow-polskich. Registration is open from September 22 to November 5, 2025; the event takes place on moderately elevated routes, starting in Władysławowo and Rozewie.

name: Gränsö Trailrun
description: Gränsö Trailrun is a running event in the Gränsö nature reserve outside Västervik that offers technical and scenic trails, sea-facing rocky areas, and some of Sweden's finest oak groves around Gränsö Castle. You can choose between 8 km and 15 km on well-marked courses, or let children participate in the Gränsö Kids Trail (up to 12 years old). The race is open for both timed and untimed Fun Run and encourages a wonderful nature experience - feel free to combine it with a spa visit at Gränsö Castle. Welcome to experience Västervik's archipelago at its best.
course_highlights: Sea-facing rocky areas and Skanvik cliffs along the course
Trails through sparse pine forests and valuable oak groves; technically varied sections
15 km has a bonus loop at Ekholmen; 8 km and 15 km courses join at the energy station Kroken
additional: Event center opens at 09:00 at Gränsö Castle. Start times: Gränsö Kids Trail 10:15, 8 km at 11:00, 15 km at 11:15. First finish is expected around 11:35 and the finish line closes at 13:45. The courses are marked with hanging red/white ribbons and signs; parts of the course follow existing hiking trails. Terrain: mostly trail/hiking trail with sections of rocks, terrain, and short road segments. Energy stations: 8 km has one station, 15 km has two. All children receive a medal and energy after finishing. Registration is online and possible until one hour before start. 8 km and 15 km courses; online registration until one hour before start; energy and water stations along the course; timed or untimed Fun Run; start times: 11:00 (8 km) and 11:15 (15 km); first finish around 11:35; finish line closes at 13:45; spa options at Gränsö Castle.

name: Team Fillinge Ultras Terränglopp
location: Gummiverkstaden, Bankekind, Linköping Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
description: Team Fillinge Ultras Trail Race is a pleasant, local trail race organized by Team Fillinge Ultra. The race is approximately 10 km long and mainly consists of beautiful gravel roads and nice forest trails just outside Fillinge, south of Bankekind/Linköping. The event is held for the second year and has a relaxed, welcoming character for trail runners who want to enjoy nature. Gathering takes place at Gummiverkstaden (gathering at 10:40) and the start is at 11:00.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km
Mainly beautiful gravel roads and nice forest trails
Gathering and start at Gummiverkstaden south of Bankekind (near Fillinge/Linköping)
additional: Gathering for information at 10:40 at Gummiverkstaden; start at 11:00. The race is organized by Team Fillinge Ultra (contact: marcuslundin@gmail.com). Website operator/organizer partner: Trailrunning Sweden AB (info@trailrunningsweden.se). New course layout for 2025 and fully booked 100 starting places one week before the race; new walking prize “The Golden Toaster”; logistics information includes bus from Linköping to Åtvidaberg (stopping at Sandtorp) and parking at Gummiverkstaden (limited space, carpooling encouraged).

name: Hammarby Alpin Marathon
location: Vindskyddet i Barnbacken, Hammarbybacken, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Hammarby Alpin Marathon is a unique alpine marathon race in the middle of Stockholm, running up, over, and around Hammarbybacken. The race consists of 22 laps and is slightly longer than a standard marathon - a micro ultra which, according to the organizer, can also be called Sweden's probably slowest marathon. The course is technical and spectator-friendly with lap and finish at the wind shelter in the children's slope. The event is a festive Advent celebration organized by Stockholm Multisport Club.
course_highlights: 22 laps around Hammarbybacken (start/lap/finish at the wind shelter in the children's slope)
Start at the bottom of the slope (to the left of the lift when facing the top) and up over the "Trysil" section at the bridge
Technical sections: down along the machine road, around the chimney, through Indian Park, inside the allotment gardens, and along the bike path
additional: Organizer: Stockholm Multisport Club. Registration takes place at lap and finish (wind shelter in the children's slope). Nearest subway: Hammarbyhöjden. Starting situation: start at the bottom of the slope to the left of the lift. Registration is done via RaceID according to the registration page. Registration and finish at the wind shelter in the children's slope; bags can be left at the foot of the slope; rain cover provided; toilets behind the parking lot; the right of public access applies; results published after the race (top 10 fastest).

name: Garmin Ultra Race Gdansk
description: Garmin Ultra Race Gdańsk is a unique trail running event taking place on December 5, 2026, in the picturesque Trójmiejski Landscape Park. The route combines a seaside climate with varied mountainous terrain, offering runners challenging ascents, valleys, gorges, and ravines. It is an excellent opportunity to end the season in an atmosphere of sporting competition and contact with nature. The event is part of a nationwide mountain running series that promotes physical activity and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: The route runs through Trójmiejski Landscape Park with proximity to the sea
Varied terrain with dense forests, valleys, gorges, and ravines
Challenging elevation changes and natural ascents characteristic of trail running
additional: Start packages are issued on December 4-5, 2026, at the race office. Starts are staggered: a 6 km night run at 19:00 on December 4, and on December 5, races on distances of 101 km (05:00), 53 km (07:45), 27 km (10:30), 12 km (13:30), as well as Garmin Junior runs for children. The time limit for completing the distances ranges from 2 to 15 hours depending on the course length. Discounts are available when registering for more than one event in the series. The athlete card is available 5 days before the race after logging in at startlist.pl. Distances range from 12 km to 86 km, with time limits, qualification points for Ultra Trail du Mont Blanc, and accompanying races for children and youth.

name: 2026 Audi Vana-aasta jooksupäev
location: Rocca al Mare kool, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Audi Vana-aasta jooksupäev on traditsiooniline talvine jooksuüritus, mis toimub 19. detsembril 2026 Tallinnas Rocca al Mare kooli ees. Võistluskeskus ja start-finiš paiknevad mugavalt kooli juures ning kavas on kolm distantsi: maraton, teatemaraton ja 8,4 km jooks. Rajad kulgevad peamiselt kergliiklusteedel, olles hästi tähistatud ja turvalised, pakkudes sportlikku võimalust aasta lõpetamiseks. Osalejatele on tagatud meditsiiniline abi, ajavõtt, medalid ning soe tee joogipunktides ja finišis.
course_highlights: 8,4 km jooks kulgeb mööda kergliiklusteid, tähistatud ja suunajatega
Maraton koosneb 5 ringist, iga ring on 8,44 km pikkune asfaltkattega kergliiklustee
Teatemaraton koosneb 5 etapist, iga etapp on 8,44 km pikkune ring
additional: Maratonil ja teatemaratonil on osalejate piirangud vastavalt 100 maratoonarit ja 150 tiimi. Jooksul on osalejate piir 150 jooksjat. Stardinumbrite väljastamine toimub võistluspäeval Rocca al Mare kooli juures. Meditsiiniabi on stardi-finišipaigas. Autasustamine toimub peale jooksu või maratoni vastavalt. Rajal jooksmine autoteel on keelatud ja võib kaasa tuua diskvalifitseerimise. Rada asub linnamaastikul, registreerimine ja osavõtutasud on detailselt kirja pandud, üritus toimub iga-aastaselt ning on osa Eesti jooksukalendrist.

name: Sylvesterloppet Kalmar
description: The Sylvester Run in Kalmar is a local running classic organized by Högby IF Athletics and will be held on December 31, 2026. Basic information about the race can be found on the club's website. For officials and volunteers, the club's login system is used for registration.
course_highlights: Distances of 5 km and 10 km around Fredriksskans and Lindöfjärden
Medal and a specially designed hat for all registered participants
Walk class 5 km without timing and various class divisions
additional: Kalmar Sylvesterlopp is described as a running classic. Registration as an official/volunteer is done via the website's registration form (WordPress) and requires login: https://friidrott.hogbyif.se/wp-login.php?action=register Start times for different classes include P/F 5 - 13, 0.4 - 2.0 km, M/F 5 and 10 km, as well as Walk class 5 km without timing; late registration and payment options include card, Swish, or bank transfer.

name: EcoTrail Stockholm Winter
description: EcoTrail Stockholm Winter is a new winter adventure for runners who love nature even when the temperature drops. The race offers three distances on snowy trails in Northern Djurgården with start and finish at Stora Skuggan. All participants who finish will receive a unique winter medal and can enjoy a warming afterrun with hot drinks and snacks. The race suits both competitive runners and those who want to enjoy nature at a slower pace.
course_highlights: Rolling snowy trails in Northern Djurgården
Hydration stations at 6 km and 12 km distances at 4 km
Start and finish at Stora Skuggan with good transportation options
additional: Start and finish at Stora Skuggan, Northern Djurgården. Subway and bus from the city to the start. Hydration stations at 6 km and 12 km distances at 4 km. Warming afterrun with hot drinks and snacks after finishing. Unique medal for all finishers. Terrain, winter conditions, registration via EQ Timing, no cancellations, option to purchase refund protection.

name: Winter Run (Stockholm)
description: Winter Run Stockholm is a winter race that takes place on a unique 5 km course with start and running inside Skansen as well as a loop around Djurgården. The course is partly paved and partly gravel, with a clear elevation gain up to Bollnästorget and some smaller hills on Djurgården. The race encourages participants to compete in luminous and imaginative outfits, creating a festive and colorful atmosphere. The event is organized by the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and any surplus proceeds go back into sports.
course_highlights: 5 km course with 57% asphalt and 43% gravel
Just over 1 km running inside Skansen
Significant elevation gain up to Bollnästorget
additional: The course is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association and measured by an approved course measurer. In icy conditions, shoes suitable for winter conditions are recommended. Any surplus from the race goes back into sports. The event includes opportunities for children and families, with a festive winter atmosphere and entertainment along the course.

name: Ursvik Ultra
location: Ursvik, Stockholm Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
price_range: 550 kr för de olika distanserna, efteranmälan 650 kr
description: Ursvik Ultra is a traditional ultramarathon that always takes place on the third Saturday in March. The race offers three distances: 75 km, 45 km, and 15 km, all on a hilly and varied trail with a mix of illuminated tracks and paths. Participants will experience challenging terrain with gravel surfaces that can vary from dry to muddy or snow-covered depending on weather conditions. During the race, food and drinks are available at the lap point, and changing rooms and showers are available at the nearby Brotorpshallen. Ursvik Ultra is a perfect start to the ultrarunning season for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 15 km hilly trail with 320 meters of elevation gain
Mix of illuminated tracks, larger and smaller paths
Varying surfaces from dry and hard to muddy and snow-covered
additional: Start takes place at Ursvik trail center. Race packets can be collected from 2 hours before the start. The exchange area is located at the water and food station. Changing rooms and showers are available at Brotorpshallen. Late registration can be done on-site on race day for a fee of 650 SEK. The rope is pulled at 23:30; after that, no one can continue on the course but they can finish on the current lap. The nearest subway station is Hallonbergen, about a 1 km walk to the sports field. Bus 504 stops right outside Motionsgården. The race includes changing, showers, food and drinks, as well as mandatory equipment such as a headlamp and change of clothes. The race takes place on the third Saturday in March, with a transition area at the lap point and free parking for participants.

name: adidas Premiärmilen
description: adidas Premiärmilen is a 10 km race that kicks off the running season in Stockholm. The race takes place on a beautifully located course in Norra Djurgården with start and finish near the T-bane station Universitetet. Here, runners can test their form, seed themselves for the adidas Stockholm Marathon, and enjoy a well-organized competition with experienced pacemakers. The course is measured and offers a mix of asphalt, gravel, and ground plates with a total elevation gain of 117 meters.
course_highlights: 10 km course in Norra Djurgården with start and finish near Universitetet T-bana
Total elevation gain of 117 meters
Surface: asphalt (64.7%), gravel (29.8%), ground plates (5.3%), and wooden bridge (0.2%)
additional: Maximum time 2 hours from start. Seeding basis for adidas Stockholm Marathon. Prize money for the top three women and men in the first start group. Age limit 15 years. Walking poles, strollers, inline skates, roller skis, bicycles, handcycles, and racing wheelchairs are not allowed. Wheelchair participants can participate with a companion and free-wheel, starting in the last start group. The race runs on a mix of asphalt, gravel, and ground plates, with a preliminary start around 11:00 and a maximum time of two hours. Registration is open until March 28, 2026, and payment can be made via Swish or credit card.

name: Växjöloppet
description: Växjöloppet is a running festival taking place in Växjö, starting at Värendsgatan outside Strandbjörkshallen. The races include distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 21.1 km, with the longer distances offering a scenic course passing through Bokhultet Nature Reserve and ending with a shared stretch around Växjösjön. The finish line is at Lagunvallen, near the goal in Strandbjörket. For younger runners, there is also Lilla Växjöloppet with several shorter distances without timing. Växjöloppet is a day filled with joy of movement and community for the whole family.
course_highlights: Start on Värendsgatan outside Strandbjörkshallen
Scenic course through Bokhultet Nature Reserve with deciduous trees
Shared final stretch around Växjösjön with finish at Lagunvallen
additional: Water stations are available at 10 km (4 stations) and 21.1 km (8 stations). Lilla Växjöloppet offers shorter distances without timing for younger runners with bib, medal, and fruit or T-shirt and diploma depending on the distance. Registration can be made with a wellness allowance.

name: Västerås Marathon
description: Västerås Marathon is an energetic and community-oriented running event offering a flat and fast course in Västerås. The race starts in Vasaparken and features a counterclockwise route with some challenging sections, including a steep hill 400 meters from the start. Participants can enjoy water and sports drink stations as well as well-organized bib distribution and baggage drop-off. The event is characterized by running joy and a strong atmosphere, including the national anthem performed from a gondola lift at the start.
course_highlights: The course runs counterclockwise with a steep hill 400 meters from the start
Flat and fast course with some tricky sections, including a tunnel
Strategically placed toilets and hydration stations with water and sports drinks from Umara
additional: Start times: Marathon 9:00, Half Marathon 10:00, 10 km 13:00. Bib distribution and baggage drop-off open at 07:00 in the City Hall restaurant. The central station is 300 meters from the start and finish with good transportation connections. No showers or changing facilities are available. Pacers are used for speed reference with self-seeding in the start area. Medals are awarded to participants. Merchandise can be ordered on demand with shipping included. The race includes water and sports drinks, as well as the opportunity to purchase merchandise. The course passes several local landmarks and is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association.

name: Kanallöpet
location: Bergvallen, Borensberg, Motala Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna, Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is an annual running event offering both competitive and recreational categories with distances of half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km. The start takes place simultaneously at 13:00 from three different locations along national road 34 between Linköping and Motala, with the finish at the sports field Bergvallen in Borensberg. The race is organized by Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna, and Vreta SoMK, welcoming runners of various ages and levels. Buses transport participants from the finish line back to the start locations before the race. Late registration is possible at the start locations with an additional fee.
course_highlights: Shared start from Ljungsbro, Sjöbacka bridge, and Brunneby Musteri
Finish at the sports field Bergvallen in Borensberg
Bus transport from finish to start locations before the race
additional: Number bibs are collected at each start location before the start. Late registration takes place at the start locations between 11:30 and 12:30 with a 50% surcharge on the regular fee. Medals are handed out free of charge to participants up to 16 years old; others can purchase a medal at the finish. Refreshments are available at the finish line. The distance is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational participants, with membership required for the competitive category. Registration is via the web and Swish/bank transfer. The race has a long tradition and attracts around 360 participants annually.

name: SäterMaran inkl. DM i halvmaraton
description: SäterMaran is an annual running race in Säter that includes the district championship in the half marathon. The race offers several distances, including the half marathon and 10 km, and is welcoming for runners of various levels. The event is organized by Säters IF FIK and is characterized by a friendly atmosphere with a focus on running joy and local community.
course_highlights: Half marathon and 10 km distances
Low participation in the full marathon, focus on half and 10 km
Held in Säter with scenic surroundings
additional: Registration for the full marathon is closed due to low participation, but registration for the half marathon and 10 km is open as usual.

name: Påsksmällen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Män och kvinnor öppen klass Landsväg 5 km 12:30 300:-

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Män och kvinnor öppen klass Landsväg 10 km 12:30 300:-

description: Easter Run is a classic road and trail race organized by Enhörna IF with start and finish at Enhörna Outdoor Recreation Area. The race has a long tradition and offers several categories for both youth and adults. It is a welcoming competition where participants can enjoy varied terrain and a wonderful running experience in scenic surroundings. Registration is done in advance with the possibility of late registration on site for an additional fee.
course_highlights: Combination of road and trail
Start and finish at Enhörna Outdoor Recreation Area (sports field)
Several youth categories with shorter distances
additional: Late registration on site is possible up to 60 minutes before each start with an extra fee (100 SEK for adult categories, 50 SEK for youth categories). The Swedish Athletics Federation's competition rules apply. Participation is at your own risk. Names and possible photos may be published on the club's website and social media. The race includes several distances for children, youth, and adults, with registration until the day before the race and the possibility of late registration on site. Results and start lists are published on the club's website and social media.

name: Varvetmilen - Jönköping
description: The Varvetmilen Jönköping is a 10 km race that starts and finishes in Knektaparken. The course runs two clockwise laps around the scenic Rocksjön and offers a wonderful running experience. The results from Varvetmilen are used for seeding in Göteborgsvarvet, giving runners the chance to secure a better starting group. The race is organized by Göteborgsvarvet in collaboration with IKHP Huskvarna Idrottsklubb and is part of the Varvetmilen tour in Sweden.
course_highlights: Two laps around Rocksjön clockwise
Start and finish in scenic Knektaparken
Seeding for Göteborgsvarvet
additional: Number bib distribution and baggage storage take place on site in Knektaparken on race day. Simultaneously with Varvetmilen, the Minivarvet is held, a 210-meter race for children aged 0-6 years with medals for all participants. Registration for Minivarvet is on-site via Swish (80 SEK). The race starts in Knektaparken, runs two laps around Rocksjön, with number bib distribution the day before and on race day. Showers, changing rooms, luggage storage, and a simple café are available on site.

name: Vårruset Uppsala
location: Studenternas IP, Uppsala, Uppsala Municipality, Sweden
description: Vårruset Uppsala is a fun run for women offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km with start and finish at Studenternas IP. The race is characterized by joy of movement and community and welcomes participants regardless of training background or level of ambition. It is possible to register individually or in teams, where teams registered receive a picnic after crossing the finish line. Vårruset has a long tradition since 1989 and is an inclusive environment where women can feel safe and inspired to participate.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course
Start and finish at Studenternas IP, Ulleråkersvägen 6
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5 people
additional: Number bib distribution takes place May 3-5 at Intersport Boländerna. Picnic pickup is done with the team leader's bib number. The event area opens at 17:30 with sponsor booths and activities. There is an option to leave outerwear and shower at the arena. Water stations and toilets are available at the start and finish. The recommended age is 11 years for 2.5 km (in adult company from 7 years) and 13 years for 5 km (in adult company from 11 years). Registration is binding and can be done until race day, no later than 1 hour before start. The event offers optional timing, and all individual participants receive a medal, a finish bag, and a bib. The race is both fitness- and team-friendly and held in an inclusive atmosphere.

name: Ölands Kyrkstafett
price_range: 1600 kr långa banan, 1000 kr korta banan; efteranmälan 1900 kr och 1200 kr
