description: Öland's Parish Relay is a classic long-distance relay race held for the 47th time, offering a fantastic running experience on a spring-blooming Öland. The start and finish are in Färjestaden, and the race is available in two variants: a longer course with eleven legs totaling 67.5 km and a shorter course with six legs totaling 23.5 km. The race welcomes both dedicated runners and beginners, with legs suitable for all levels. Organizers Högby IF and Ölands idrottskrets aim to provide the best possible service with officials, a commentator, and individual timing.
course_highlights: Long course: 11 legs between 2.7 km and 8.5 km, total 67.5 km
Short course: 6 legs between 2.7 km and 5.4 km, total 23.5 km
Start and finish at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden
additional: Number bib pickup takes place on May 8th from 15:00 to 17:00 and on race day May 9th from 08:00 to 09:30 at Hamngrillen in Färjestaden. Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports hall 200 meters north of Ölands Köpstad. Wellness Studio hosts a group warm-up before the start. Officials are present on the course, at exchanges, as well as at the start and finish. Individual segment times, intermediate times, and team finish times are provided. The commentator follows the lead race from start to finish. Running on Öland, two course lengths, team categories, medals, grill plates, GPX files, changing/shower facilities, food/accommodation are offered.

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp
price_range: 325 kronor (ordinarie), 195 kronor (kyrkundan), gratis för barnloppet, tillkommer 50 kronor för efteranmälan
description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby City Run is a popular running event offering a delightful six-kilometer course through Mjölby with start and finish in the City Park. The course runs along the Black River and features both challenging uphill sections and smooth downhill segments, with almost entirely asphalt surface. In addition to the main race, there is also Kyrkundan, approximately 3 km, and a free children's race, Bostadsbolaget Little City Run. All participants crossing the finish line receive a medal as proof of their effort. The race is organized by Norrköping Running Club in collaboration with IK Akele and Mjölby Cycling Club.
course_highlights: 6 km course with start and finish in City Park, Mjölby
Runs along the Black River for most of the route, 99% asphalt
Includes challenging uphill sections and smooth downhill segments
additional: Number bibs can be collected at Intersport Mjölby on Friday, May 8 from 12:00 to 18:00 with a 25% discount coupon. Warm-up led by Fitness4You before the start. All finishers receive a medal. The children's race has four starts between 11:00 and 11:45 for ages up to 12 years. The main race starts at 13:00 and Kyrkundan at 13:10. Late registration is possible until May 8 with an additional fee of 50 SEK. Massage services are available at the start and finish areas. The race takes place in City Park, with options for corporate tents, registration via the website, bib pickup at Intersport Mjölby, and sponsorship opportunities.

name: Kungsholmen Runt
price_range: 100 kr rabatt för medlemmar, övriga priser ej specificerade
description: Kungsholmen Runt is a popular running race in Stockholm offering both half marathon and 10 km distances. The race takes place on flat courses around Kungsholmen, making it an excellent opportunity for those aiming for a personal best. The event is a festival with start and finish in Rålambshovsparken, welcoming runners of all ages and levels.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course around Kungsholmen
Start and finish in the scenic Rålambshovsparken
The race offers both half marathon and 10 km distances
additional: The race is a festival with flat courses suitable for personal bests. There is also a kids' race for children. Start and finish are at Rålambshovsparken. Information about bus traffic and road closures is available for participants. Terrain around Kungsholmen, registration via link, kids' race for children up to 13 years old.

name: Strandmilen
description: Strandmilen is a delightful spring race that takes place along the beautiful Lake Hulingen in Hultsfred. The race offers a fantastic natural experience and a wonderful atmosphere, making it perfect for both beginners and experienced runners. It is a welcoming event that invites participation in exercise and community in a scenic environment.
course_highlights: Running along Lake Hulingen
Fantastic natural environment
The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners
additional: The race is held at Knektavallen, Folkparksvägen 3 in Hultsfred. It is a family-friendly event focused on exercise and health. No specific information about price or registration fee is available on the website. The event includes a 10 km course and children's races, and is open to everyone, regardless of club membership. Registration details are available on the website.

name: Björnlunken 2026
description: Björnlunken is a cross-country race that welcomes all participants, from children and recreational runners to experienced runners and mountain bike cyclists. The race takes place in beautiful terrain along the pine-covered gravel ridge between Alberga and Kungsör, with trails and gravel roads offering moderate elevation changes and technical sections. The event is characterized by an open and welcoming atmosphere, created together by officials, spectators, and participants, and is organized voluntarily by Kungsörs Sports Club. Many return year after year while new participants try for the first time.
course_highlights: Cross-country running and cycling along pine-covered gravel ridge
Trails and gravel roads with moderate elevation changes
Technical sections in nature between Alberga and Kungsör
additional: Late registration opens on the Thursday the week before the race. Start lists for pre-registered participants are available. The race is organized voluntarily by Kungsörs Sports Club with a strong sense of community among participants, officials, and spectators.

name: Vårruset (Växjö)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Vill du ha det bästa priset? Du vinner på att anmäla dig tidigt!

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Se prisstegen nedan. Priset avser kostnad per person.

description: Vårruset in Växjö is a fun run for women offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km around the beautiful Växjösjön. The race is characterized by joy of movement and community and welcomes participants regardless of training background or level of ambition. It is possible to register individually or in teams, where teams registered receive a picnic after crossing the finish line. The event has a long tradition since 1989 and focuses on promoting women's health and creating an inclusive environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Controlled 5 km course around Växjösjön
Start and finish at Strandbjörket
Picnic after the finish line for teams of 5 people
additional: Number bib distribution takes place at Intersport at Grand Samarkand in the days before the race. The bib must be worn visibly throughout the race. There is an option to opt out of timing. The event area has water stations, toilets, a café, and a sponsor village with activities. The recommended age is 13 years for the 5 km and 11 years for the 2.5 km, younger with adult supervision. Teams consist of 5 people and a picnic is granted to teams after crossing the finish line. The race is open to everyone, and participants can register individually or in teams of five. The event also includes opportunities for HPV vaccination for women born between 1994 and 1999, which is offered free on-site during Vårruset in Växjö.

name: Kurts Marathon / Kurts 300:e maraton (Hultsfred) — inkl. halvmaraton & Backyard Ultra
description: Kurt's Marathon in Hultsfred is a personal and welcoming marathon and half marathon race held in celebration of Kurt Gustavsson's 80th birthday and his 300th marathon. The course is a 5-lap park road around Lake Hulingen, consisting of approximately 20% asphalt and is officially measured and sanctioned. The race offers two water stations with water, sports drinks, cola, and energy supplements. After the race, participants are invited to a gathering with food and socializing near the start and finish at Knektavallen.
course_highlights: 5-lap course around Lake Hulingen in Hultsfred
20% of the course is asphalt, the rest is park road
Two water stations with sports drinks, cola, and snacks
additional: Start and finish at the entrance of Knektavallen facing Lake Hulingen. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at Knektavallen. Bib numbers are distributed from 08:00. For runners expecting to take over 5 hours, the start time is 09:00. After the race, a gathering with food and socializing is offered around 14:30, approximately 1 km from the start. The race is part of a festive event to honor Kurt Gustavsson and is a unique opportunity for runners to participate in a private, but officially sanctioned competition.

name: Startmilen (Örebro)

price_tiers.distance: 10 km Tävling (Junior, Senior, Veteran M/K35-60) Motion

description: The Start Mile is a recreational race in Örebro suitable for all runners and marks the start of the outdoor season for many. The race offers distances of 1 km for children, 5 km for youth and veterans, and 10 km for competitive classes, with the 10 km also serving as the district championship for Southern Svealand. The start and finish are at Tybblelundshallen near Örebro University, and the course runs on streets in the Almby district. All participants receive a medal, and there are prize ceremonies for different classes.
course_highlights: Start and finish outside Tybblelundshallen near Örebro University
The course runs on streets in the Almby district
The 10 km class is the district championship (DM) for Southern Svealand and sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association
additional: Number bibs are distributed at Tybblelundshallen from approximately 10:30 on race day. Timing is done with a transponder loaned out at bib distribution and must be returned after finishing. Lost transponders are charged at 800 SEK. All classes except KnatteStarten have timing. Late registration is possible until 60 minutes before the start at Tybblelundshallen for an increased fee and subject to availability. Medals are awarded to all finishers. Prize ceremonies are held for the 5 km at 13:40 and the 10 km at 15:30.

name: ÜLEMISTE Grit 2027
organizer: Eesti Ööjooks - Night Run Estonia ja Liikumisharrastuse kompetentsikeskus

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Virtuaalne osalemine: 24€ (sisaldab medalit, tulemuse haldamise tasu ja saatmiskulu)

description: Ülemiste Grit on elamuslik kestvusjooksu sündmus, mis toimub Tallinna Ülemiste keskuse siseruumides. Osalejad saavad valida 1-, 2- või 3-tunnise väljakutse vahel, läbides 552 meetri pikkust ringi. Sündmus ei ole võistlus, vaid liikumisrõõm ja enese proovilepanek, kus saab joosta, jalutada või tempokõndida. Rajal on teeninduspunkt, kus pakutakse vett, mahla ja tahkeid toite ning finišis ootab medal ja kinkekott. Üritus on piiratud osalejate arvuga ja pakub unikaalset siserajaga kogemust.
course_highlights: Rada kulgeb Ülemiste keskuse II korrusel, pikkus 552 m ring
Siseruumides, plaaditud põrand, palju klaaspindu, nõuab ettevaatlikkust
Teeninduspunktis vesi, mahl, Coca-Cola ja tahked toidud (banaan, hapukurk, leib, lihatoode, šokolaad, apelsin)
additional: Stardimaterjalide väljastamine toimub 19:00-21:30 Ülemiste keskuse parkimismaja III korrusel. Pakihoid sündmuskeskuses maksab 2€. Medal ja kinkekott antakse peale finišit sündmuskeskusest. Peale finišit palutakse osalejatel jääda hetkeks finiši alasse ühispildi tegemiseks. Osalejad 2h distantsil palutakse stardialasse siseneda esimese korruse kaudu (Rimi juurest eskalaatoriga). Sündmus on välja müüdud, kohapeal registreerimist ei toimu. Virtuaaljooksu võimalus lõpeb 22.04.2027. Rajal on võimalik paigutada oma joogipudel nimega märgistatult. Sündmus on mitte-võistluslik, rõhutades koostööd ja turvalisust. Kohapeal registreerimist ei toimu, sündmus on välja müüdud; osalejad saavad kinkekotte; rajad on elamuslikud ja mitte rekordite püüdmiseks.

name: Skärholmsloppet
description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly fitness event in Stockholm featuring races for all ages, including Mini-race for the youngest children, the Little Skärholmsloppet for children in preschool class up to grade 6, a 5 km timed race for participants aged 13 and older, and a 1.6 km Fun Run for all ages. The race is organized by Löparakademin, a non-profit organization working with youth in immigrant neighborhoods for personal development through running. Throughout the day, there will be music and entertainment with DJs along the course, and all participants will receive a medal at the finish line. Skärholmsloppet is an inclusive and encouraging running experience that promotes movement and equal health.
course_highlights: 5 km timed race for ages 13 and up
Little Skärholmsloppet approximately 1.6 km for children in preschool to grade 6
Mini-race of 500 meters for children 0-6 years, with the opportunity to run together with parents
additional: Start and finish at Puckelbollplan. Start times: Mini-race at 10:30, Little Skärholmsloppet from 11:30 in different start groups by age, Fun Run 1.6 km starting at 12:25, 5 km race starting at 13:00. All participants receive a medal and energy at the finish. Registration is free and can be done until May 14 at 17:00, with late registration possible at bib distribution and on race day if spots are available. Music and DJs along the course for extra motivation. The race takes place at Puckelbollplan in Stockholm, with music and entertainment along the course, and all participants will receive a medal after finishing.

name: TEC 200 miles
description: TEC 200 miles is a challenging ultramarathon held in Tyresö, with start and turnaround at Alby Friluftsgård. The course is a 11.5 km loop offering hilly terrain, technical trails, and beautiful views of Lake Albysjön, Tyresta Nature Reserve, and Tyresö-Flaten. The race is part of the Tyresö Extreme Challenge, which offers several distances including Backyard Ultra, MiniUltra 46 km, 50 miles, and 100 miles. It is a race that combines tough challenges with a wonderful community and positive energy among runners and volunteers.
course_highlights: 11.5 km loop with start and finish at Alby Friluftsgård
Hilly gravel roads and technical trails with roots and stones
Spectacular views of Lake Albysjön, Tyresta Nature Reserve, and Tyresö-Flaten
additional: Start and turnaround are at Alby Friluftsgård in Tyresö. The course is marked with orange reflective ribbons spaced 20-70 meters apart. Runners pass a tent with a buffet and volunteers at the turnaround, but are advised not to stay too long. The race takes place all weekend with multiple distances, and the start time for 200 miles is at 10:00 on race day. The event is held in mid-April and may require endurance in difficult weather conditions, including icy or cold conditions early in the season.

name: Tjust Trail Run
location: Västervik, Västervik Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: Tjust Trail Run is a trail race organized by Tjust Bike & Running Club in Västervik. The race offers a challenging and sweaty competition on winding trails, over beautiful rocky outcrops, and through scenic Småland nature. Participants will experience the Småland forest in a unique way, running on technical and hilly trails. Welcome to a wonderful running experience in a picturesque environment with good atmosphere and dedicated volunteers.
course_highlights: Winding trails through Småland forest
Technical sections with elevation and rocks
Passage through forest tunnel and muddy holes
additional: Changes to the distance are possible until April 10 via email. Cut-off time for the longest distance (The Long Run) with lap at 11:45. Bib number must be clearly visible. Recommended equipment is trail running shoes and mobile phone. In case of interruption, contact volunteers or the phone number from the bib distribution. Transportation is arranged from water stations if needed.

name: Kalmar Backyard Ultra
location: Stensö/First Camp Stensö, Kalmar, Kalmar Municipality, Sweden
description: Kalmar Backyard Ultra is a unique ultramarathon run on a 6,706-meter loop starting at 10:00 AM. The race follows the original format where each lap must be completed within one hour to continue, and the next start occurs at each full hour. The winner is the one who completes one more lap than the others. The distance of 6,706 meters is chosen because 24 laps equal 100 miles, a dream goal for many ultrarunners, but everyone is welcome regardless of ambition level.
course_highlights: 6,706-meter loop
Start every full hour, race continues until one runner remains
24 laps equal 100 miles (161 km)
additional: The race is a Backyard Ultra in the original format. Runners who do not complete a lap within one hour must end the competition. The winner is the one who completes one more lap than the others. All levels are welcome. Registration as a volunteer requires login.

name: Varvetmilen Sollentuna
location: Strandvägen to Sollentunavallen, Sollentuna, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Varvetmilen Sollentuna is a 10 km race that challenges you to run your best mile in Sollentuna. The course runs through the town, south along Sköldvägen and Sollentunavägen, with a water station at 5 km. The final part of the course is beautifully situated along the water on Nils Göranssons promenade before finishing at Sollentunavallen. The results from Varvetmilen are seedings for Göteborgsvarvet 2026, giving you the opportunity to secure a better starting group.
course_highlights: The course runs through Sollentuna town, south along Sköldvägen and Sollentunavägen
Water station at 5 km
The final part of the course runs along the water on Nils Göranssons promenade
additional: Start and finish area at Sollentunavallen and Strandvägen near the water. Bib number distribution and baggage drop-off take place on site on race day. The mini race for children 0-6 years old is held simultaneously with a 210-meter race, registration on site (80 SEK via Swish). The race is an important seed race for Göteborgsvarvet and offers facilities such as bib number pickup and baggage drop-off.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Kevadjooks 2027
location: Sportland Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskus, Kõrvemaa, Estonia
description: Sportland Kõrvemaa Kevadjooks on kaunis kevadine jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub ürgse looduse keskel Kõrvemaa looduskaitsealal. Võistluskeskus asub mugavalt Tallinna lähedal Sportland Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskuses. Rajad on mitmekesised, pakkudes nii 16 km põhidistantsi kui ka 6 km jooksu ja noortejooksu. Lisaks on korraldatud tasuta lastejooksud ning kogu perele mõeldud tegevused ja lastehoid. Pärast jooksu ootab osalejaid soe supp, kuum saun ja kümblustünnid ning võimalus osaleda põneval aardejahil Anija mõisas.
course_highlights: 100% rada kulgeb looduskaitsealal
Mitmekesised distantsid: 16 km, 6 km ja noortejooks
Võistluskeskus mugavalt Tallinna lähedal
additional: Osalejatele on tasuta bussitransport Aegviidu rongijaamast võistluskeskusesse ja tagasi. Võistluskeskuses on lastehoid, pakihoid, Stebby heaoluala koos Fysiotikkeriga, Sportlandi pop-up pood jooksuvarustuse täiendamiseks. Lastele pakub Aegviidu RMK loodusteemalisi tegevusi, madalseikluspark, minipannkoogikohvik ning hobune ja poni sõidud (sularaha kaasa). Pärast jooksu on avatud kuum saun ja kümblustünnid. Kevadjooksul loosimine stiilse Trek linnaratta võitmiseks autasustamisel kell 14:00. Grupisoodustused: 10% soodustust vähemalt 5 osaleja registreerimisel, 20% vähemalt 10 osaleja registreerimisel. 50% soodustus seenioritele (60+) ja noortele (kuni 17) eelregistreerimisel, minimaalne lõpphind 15 €. Üritus toimub 25. aprillil 2027, pakkudes võimalust osaleda erinevatel distantsidel ning nautida looduses liikumist ja perega aega.

name: Vårruset (Stockholm)
description: Spring Ruset in Stockholm is a recreational race for women offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km in Norra Djurgården. The race is characterized by joy of movement and community and welcomes everyone regardless of training background or level of ambition. It is possible to register individually or in teams, with team registrants receiving a picnic after finishing. The event has a long tradition since 1989 and aims to promote women's health and create an inclusive environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course in Norra Djurgården
Start and finish at Frescatiängen near Stockholm University
The race takes place on gravel and forest trails in a scenic environment
additional: Number bibs are sent by mail upon registration before April 17, otherwise they can be picked up on site. Teams of five people receive a picnic after finishing. Changing rooms and showers are available at cost. The recommended age is 13 years for the 5 km and 11 years for the 2.5 km, younger with adult supervision. It is possible to opt out of timing during registration. The event area is easiest to reach on foot, by bike, or public transport. Parking is limited and not recommended. The event is part of Sweden's largest sports tour for girls and focuses on community and health.

name: Blodomloppet
location: Västra Marks IP, Karlskrona, Blekinge, Sweden
organizer: Blodcentralerna i Blekinge och KA 2 IF

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Laganmälan 5 och 10km (5 personer) 1750 kr tom 29 april

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Laganmälan 5 och 10km (5 personer) 2000 kr tom 13 maj

description: Blood Race in Karlskrona is a fitness event that highlights the vital importance of blood donation and promotes a healthy lifestyle. Participants can choose to walk, jog, or run over distances of 5 km or 10 km, and also participate in the children's race over 800 meters or in a special walking class over 5 km. The race is open to both individual participants and teams, and concludes with a communal picnic for all participants. The courses are officially measured and approved for competition, with designated routes for walkers to enable a joint finish. Blood Race is one of Sweden's largest health initiatives and attracts many participants each year.
course_highlights: Officially measured courses of 5 km and 10 km for running
Separate route for walkers over 5 km
Children's race over 800 meters
additional: The race offers individual and team registrations (up to 5 people per team). Team participants can compete in different distances. Discounts are available for blood donors and ICA members (40 SEK per person). Large registrations can be managed via an Excel template and customer portal in the registration system. Walkers are released first on their own route to facilitate a joint picnic after the race. There are changing facilities, toilets, water stations, medical services, and options for free transportation to and from the event. The race is officially measured and approved by the Swedish Athletics Association. Participants can run on-site or participate remotely between May 17 and September 7, 2027. The starter kit includes a shirt, medal, and bib number. The event offers discounts for blood donors and ICA members.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten is a relay race with start, exchange, and finish in Folkparken in Norrköping where teams of four participants each run an exciting four-kilometer stretch. The race offers a great team spirit with men's, women's, and mixed teams, with or without timing. The course is close to the competition center with motivational music along the route and audience support at exchanges and the finish. It is an evening filled with exercise, community, and joy, where children and youth can participate for free thanks to HSB.
course_highlights: Start, exchange, and finish in Folkparken in Norrköping
Each team member runs 4 km on an exciting course near the competition center
Motivational music along the route and audience support at exchanges and the finish
additional: Helhetshälsan offers leg massages both before the start and after the finish. All participants receive a medal sponsored by Azets. Performance prizes are awarded to the first team in each class, and nice prizes are raffled among all participating teams. ICA Smedby provides energy-rich products after the finish. The race is held in Folkparken, with the possibility of late registration on site, and participants can register via the website or on race day. Participants receive energy-rich products after the race.

name: Vårruset
description: Vårruset in Västerås is a recreational run for women offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km through central Västerås with start and finish at Lögastrand. The race is characterized by joy of movement and community and welcomes everyone regardless of training background or level of ambition. Registration can be done individually or as a team, where teams registered receive a picnic after crossing the finish line. The event is part of a long tradition since 1989 and aims to promote women's health and create an inclusive environment for exercise and socializing.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course through central Västerås
Start and finish at Lögastrand
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5 people
additional: Number bib distribution takes place at Intersport in the Livli shopping center Erikslund in the days before the race. There is supervised baggage drop-off, water stations, and toilets at the event area. Picnic pickup is done with the team leader's number bib. The recommended age is 13 years for the 5 km and 11 years for the 2.5 km, younger with adult supervision. It is possible to opt out of timing during registration. Training sessions are organized in several locations before the race. Participants receive a number bib, finish bag, and medal; teams of 5 people; open to runners, joggers, and walkers; registration via the web; the event is part of the national Vårruset series.

name: Blodomloppet Linköping
organizer: Blodcentralen i Östergötland och IK Akele samt Blodtappen i Östergötland
description: The Blood Race in Linköping is one of Sweden's largest sporting events focused on raising awareness of the vital need for blood donation. The race offers the opportunity to walk, jog, or run 5 or 10 kilometers and is open to both individual participants and teams. During the event, the blood bus will be on site for those who wish to become blood donors, and the race has a strong local connection with ambassadors and collaborations. It is a social and healthy activity that concludes with a communal picnic and contributes to youth activities through the proceeds.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances in Linköping
Opportunity to register as a blood donor on site via the blood bus
The race is organized for the twenty-second time with a local ambassador
additional: Youth teams (five team members born in 2009 or later) participate at half the registration fee if registered by April 30. Teams can be expanded to five participants at no cost until April 30. Participants registering by May 14 will receive free public transport within Östergötland for 6 hours on race day via SMS ticket. Late registration is possible at the bib distribution days before the race. Payment can be made via Swish, card, or e-invoice for companies. The race includes various distances for adults and children, with options to walk or run, as well as blood donation on site. The event is a large community celebration with music and social gathering.

name: Kolmården Vertical

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 kr per deltagare fram till den 19 april.

description: Kolmården Vertical is a challenging trail race of 5 km with 300 meters of elevation gain in beautiful and technical terrain at Hults Bruk in Kolmården. The course offers nice trails and technical sections where strong legs and quick feet are an advantage. The start is at the old football field, and the race includes steep climbs, singletrack, and scenic views over Ågelsjön. Welcome to participate in this somewhat classic race that provides a real challenge for trail enthusiasts.
course_highlights: 5 km with 300 meters of elevation in challenging terrain
Technical sections with singletrack and steep climbs
Beautiful view over Ågelsjön and passage by Eremiten's Jakob's Cave
additional: The start is at the old football field at Hults Bruk. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each class as well as raffle prizes. A ballpark is located 200 meters from the parking area. Cancellation and accident insurance are offered as add-ons. The course's technical sections include "Koklämman" with a rope for assistance uphill, and the race passes a cozy barbecue area under a large rock overhang. Trail running, technical sections, start at Hults Bruk, course description includes climbs and trail sections.

name: Skälbyloppet
location: Skälby loge, Kalmar kommun, Kalmar län, Sweden
description: Skälbyloppet is a family-friendly recreational race in Kalmar organized by Högby IF on April 25, 2026. The race offers two main distances, 4 km and 8 km (1 and 2 laps over the bridge), as well as youth categories from 600 meters to approximately 1.9 km. The course runs through the Skälby environment with gravel and park paths, as well as a short asphalt section, and fluids are available at the turnaround and finish. Medals are awarded to all finishers, and registration is conducted according to the schedule provided by the organizer.
course_highlights: 4 km and 8 km courses (1 and 2 laps over the bridge)
Youth distances from 600 m to 1.9 km
Easy-to-run gravel and forest paths with a short asphalt section
additional: Fluids are available at the turnaround on the long course and at the finish. Bib numbers are collected at Skälby lodge; start times are according to the schedule, and late registration is possible as per the organizer. The routes for 4 km and 8 km are standard (1 and 2 laps over the bridge). Presence on site is required for certain volunteer registrations according to RF standards. Bib numbers can be picked up at Skälby lodge on Friday, April 24, from 15:00 to 17:00, and on race day from 08:30; late registration is accepted at bib pickup no later than 1 hour before the start. Fluids are available at the turnaround on the long course and at the finish; medals are awarded to all who complete the race.

name: adidas Premiärhalvan
description: Adidas Premiärhalvan is a half marathon of 21.1 km held in Stockholm on April 25, 2026. The race starts at 11:00 AM and has a maximum time of three hours, with start and finish areas at Biskopsudden. The course runs around Southern Djurgården and passes through scenic natural areas near central Stockholm. The event is organized by Marathongruppen and is seen as a good preparation for the adidas Stockholm Marathon, while also welcoming all who want to experience springtime in a beautiful city environment. Registration is available at different price levels (495-745 SEK), and bib and start information are shared in advance; water stations and medical personnel are available along the course.
course_highlights: The course runs around Southern Djurgården with start and finish at Biskopsudden
Beautiful spring environment and scenic views near central Stockholm
Mixed surface with asphalt, gravel, and cobblestones along the course
additional: The race is a preparation for the adidas Stockholm Marathon and includes bib distribution in advance as well as start information. Water stations and medical personnel are available along the course. The maximum time is 3 hours and the age limit is 17 years. The deadline for reporting results for seeding is March 31. The course is a single lap of 21.1 km around Southern Djurgården (asphalt/gravel/cobblestones) and sports drinks from Enervit are offered along the course.

name: Munkastigen Trailrun
description: Munkastigen Trailrun is organized by Laxå OK and will take place on Saturday, April 25, 2026, starting in Olshammar. On the race page, there are maps, elevation profile, and a GPX file available for download to plan your run. Invitations and registration links are published during the current year in the menu on the club's page. Welcome to participate and access course information before the race.
course_highlights: Start in Olshammar
Maps (Map Part 1 and Map Part 2) and elevation profile available
GPX file available for download (Munkastigen_trailrun.gpx, thanks Jonas Brännmyr)
additional: Invitations and registration links are published during the current year in the menu on the page. Course information includes Map Part 1 and Part 2 as well as elevation profile. GPX file (Munkastigen_trailrun.gpx) is available for download. The race runs from Olshammar on the shores of Vättern to Laxå in Tiveden. Teams consist of 2 - 5 runners with relay points at any location along the course. SI-pins are recommended or can be rented. Start and finish: start at 11:00 in Olshammar, finish at Laxå OK's clubhouse.

description: Lidingöloppet Spring Mile is a spring race of 5 and 10 kilometers with start and finish at Lidingövallen. The course is called one of Stockholm's most beautiful mile routes and runs through winding forest roads, meadows, and along the archipelago coast, mostly on soft trails and sometimes hilly. The race serves as a qualifying event for TCS Lidingöloppet and is suitable for those wanting to check their fitness or secure a better starting group. Before and after the race, coffee and light food are available for purchase at the café at Lidingövallen.
course_highlights: Winding forest roads past meadows and along the archipelago coast
Mostly soft trails; hilly (10 km 127 m elevation, 5 km 52 m elevation)
Water station at 5 km and at the finish; course marked with red/white ribbons and km flags
additional: Number bib distribution from 09:30 on race day until 30 minutes before start. Late registration is available at Lidingövallen from 09:30 and no later than 60 minutes before start. Name and class changes can be made via Mina sidor for a fee (details and fees are on the website) or on-site for a higher fee. Free baggage drop-off is available; baggage storage costs 20 SEK (Swish 1235557608). Parking near Lidingövallen is limited (fee 40 SEK via Swish 1234575775); the organizer recommends public transport (metro to Ropsten + bus 204/211/212). Changing rooms, showers, and sauna are available indoors at Lidingövallen. Course surface: asphalt for the first 2.5 km, then gravel and trails; last 350 m on the running track. Distances are 5 km and 10 km; Kids' Spring Run for younger participants; water station at 5 km and water supplies at the finish; seeding for TCS Lidingöloppet.

name: VXO Ultrafest
location: Trummens södra strand, Växjö, Kronoberg County, Sweden
description: VXO Ultrafest is an ultrarunning and walking festival held in Växjö at the southern shore of Trummen on April 25-26, 2026. The event includes the Swedish Championships in 24-hour running and 100 km ultramarathon, as well as the Swedish Championship in walking with distances of a marathon for men and a half marathon for women. The race courses are flat and mainly consist of asphalt with some gravel sections, providing good conditions for fast and enjoyable races. Växjö Running Club welcomes both previous participants and new runners and walkers to this annual festive weekend.
course_highlights: Flat lap course for VXO24h approx. 820 meters, mostly asphalt with some gravel sections
The race course for VXO100k and Swedish walking championships (42 km and 21 km) runs around Lake Trummen, approx. 3.2 km per lap
The competition area is located on open grassy areas at the southern shore of Trummen with space for tents and lap counting
additional: Pre Race Dinner Friday 24/4. Lap counting takes place at the competition arena, which has space for organizers' and participants' tents. The event includes ultramarathon, walking competitions, and is held on a flat course with asphalt and gravel, providing good conditions for records and performances.

name: Vårmilen
organizer: IFK Lidingö Friidrott / Lidingöloppet Marknads AB
description: Lidingöloppet Vårmilen is a popular running challenge offering one of Stockholm's most beautiful mile courses. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km on winding forest paths, meadows, and along the archipelago coast. The course is mostly soft and hilly, making the race a gentle and scenic start to the running season. The race also serves as a qualifying event for TCS Lidingöloppet, providing an opportunity for a better starting group in the autumn's classic cross-country race. During the race, there are water stations with water and sports drinks, as well as entertainment along the course.
course_highlights: Winding forest paths and meadows
Running along the archipelago coast
Mostly soft trails with elevation
additional: Start and finish at Lidingövallen. Water and sports drink stations at 5 km and at the finish. Group warm-up before start. Bag drop-off available free of charge, valuables drop-off costs 20 SEK. Changing rooms with showers and sauna available. The course is marked with white ribbons and spray paint, with officials at difficult sections. It is recommended to travel by public transport or bicycle due to limited parking. Category and name changes can be made for a fee before and on race day. Cross-country course, hilly, start and finish at Lidingövallen, accessible by public transport and car, limited parking.

name: Bålsta Stadslopp
description: Welcome to Bålsta City Race, held on April 26, 2026 at Gröna Dalens IP in Bålsta. The race is known as a fast, spectator-friendly course where many have set personal bests - the course is organized by Bålsta IK and has grown every year since its start in 2019. The competition offers the Sparbanksloppet 5 km (possible one lap) and 10 km (two laps) with the finish inside the Gröna Dalens athletics track. The organizer emphasizes speed, joy, and a friendly event atmosphere for both elite and recreational runners.
course_highlights: 5 km loop that can be run once or twice (resulting in 5 km or 10 km total)
Approximately 99% asphalt; finish inside the athletics track at Gröna Dalens IP
Known as a fast course where many have achieved personal records and several course records are documented
additional: Number bib distribution takes place inside Gröna Dalens IP from 08:00. Late registration can be done digitally subject to availability until 1 hour before each start on race day. Start and finish are located at Gröna Dalens sports field (Badhusvägen); commuter train (line 43) to Bålsta station is about 850 meters walk from the venue. There are several parking options within 100 - 900 meters; Badhusvägen will be closed during the race day. There is clothing drop-off (instructions to attach the lower part of the bib to the bag), limited changing/shower facilities, and toilets near the venue. Sports drinks (Umara) and water are available at the turn-around for the 5 km race. A team competition for the 5 km (Sparbanksloppet) is introduced; the course is described as fast and PB-friendly.

description: Landsjön Runt is a road race in a scenic environment by Landsjön in Kaxholmen outside Huskvarna. We offer a family day with races for all ages - 12.5 km and 5.5 km for adults/youths as well as several children's classes including Vista FUN RUN. The race goes around the lake with start and finish at Vistavallen, and musicians and water stations along the course contribute to the atmosphere. The event encourages both individual registration and team competitions for four participants.
course_highlights: Road race in a scenic environment around Landsjön, start/finish at Vistavallen
Distances 12.5 km and 5.5 km along the lake; the course is run clockwise so the climbs come early
Music along the course and water stations for participants
additional: Parking at Vistavallen is available (recommendation to use public transport or park at Hunnerydsbadet); team competitions consist of four people all running the same distance and total time is recorded, teams receive a bag from Rudenstams Gårdsbutik; in case of a course record on 12.5 km, 5,000 SEK is awarded to the runner's club; payment is made via Swish to 123 429 98 22 and no automatic confirmation is sent - you are registered if you receive a six-digit number and have paid; IK Vista members participate free if registering by April 20 (the website also mentions April 19); registration closes on April 25 at 17:00 but registration on race day can be done at least one hour before if space permits. Registration closes April 25 at 17:00. Payment is via Swish. IK Vista members participate free if registering by April 20; specify IK Vista as club and do not pay. The start list is published one week before the race. The race includes water stations and music along the course; team registration is possible with combined finish/result.

name: Kvantumloppet (Kvantumloppet med Trail 7+17km)
description: Kvantumloppet is Huddinge AIS Athletics' running festival at Källbrinks IP, open to all levels with both shorter recreational runs and technical trail options. The event offers a kids' class, recreational runs of 3 and 5 km, as well as trail runs of 7 and 17 km, welcoming both casual runners and more experienced trail runners. The course mostly runs on smaller forest paths and features sections of technical terrain with stones, roots, and steep inclines, as well as several scenic parts. Prizes are awarded to the fastest woman and man in several categories, and all finishers receive a medal.
course_highlights: Mostly runs on smaller forest paths, partly very technical with stones, roots, and steep inclines
Several scenic sections along the course
17 km follows Gömmaren's black/white trails "SKATAN"
additional: Date and location: April 26 at Källbrinks IP (Gamla Stockholmsvägen 91, Huddinge). Start times: Kids' class 700 m at 11:00; Trail 17 km at 11:10; Recreational 3 and 5 km at 12:00; Trail 7 km at 12:00. Prizes: Trophy for the first woman and man to finish in the 3 km, 5 km, and Trail 7 km and 17 km; medals for all finishers. Large prize table from ICA Kvantum Kungens Kurva where bib numbers serve as raffle tickets; award ceremony around 13:00; practical prizes and medals for the kids' class immediately after finishing. Organizer: Huddinge AIS (contact: pelle@huddingeais.se, phone 0706758799). Registration by April 19, 2026; team discount for at least 5 participants; bibs are picked up on race day; results available at kvantumloppet.se

name: Orion Trail
location: Ådalen, Jämjö, Karlskrona kommun, Blekinge län, Sverige
description: Orion Trail takes place in Ådalen in Jämjö outside Karlskrona in Blekinge. The race follows nature-rich trails along the river and passes a waterfall as well as a sea of wood anemones, and can be completed as running or walking. The organizer OK Orion welcomes participants to a scenic terrain experience on April 26, 2026. The event focuses on an easy to moderately challenging course in a beautiful environment near Karlskrona.
course_highlights: Trails along Ådalen and the river with varied terrain
Waterfall along the course
Wood anemones in springtime natural environment
additional: Booking is done via the MittLopp link. Trail running on trails in Ådalen; Facebook event: https://fb.me/e/1TyHBrexxh

name: STHLM Trail Run
course_highlights: Beautiful forest trail through Northern Djurgården with natural terrain challenges
Two distances: 5 km and 10 km
Easily accessible by public transport (reachable from Ropsten; close to Stureplan by bike)
additional: Distances: 5 km (start 11:00, age limit 13 years, 11 years with guardian) and 10 km (start 12:00, age limit 15 years, 13 years with guardian). Event area: Fisksjöäng, Northern Djurgården. Medal, finish line service, bib with timing, and refreshments along the course. Registration is personal and can be done digitally up to 1 hour before the first start. Payment options: Swish, Visa/MasterCard, Klarna invoice. Start times: 5 km at 11:00 (age limit 13 years, 11 years with guardian) and 10 km at 12:00 (age limit 15 years, 13 years with guardian). Included: medal, finish line service, bib with timing, and refreshments along the course; registration is possible until 1 hour before the first start.

name: Växjöloppet
description: Welcome to Växjöloppet on May 1, 2026 - a running festival for the whole family with distances from children's races up to half marathon. The event offers 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km, and Little Växjöloppet for younger participants. Start and finish are at Strandbjörket with start on Värendsgatan outside Strandbjörkshallen; the course features both forest paths through the scenic Bokhultet and asphalt stretches around Växjösjön. The half marathon is run as two laps on essentially the same course, providing both variation and spectator-friendly finishes.
course_highlights: Start on Värendsgatan outside Strandbjörkshallen
Scenic course passing Bokhultet (mainly deciduous forest) and transitioning to forest trail after the first kilometer
The last approximately 3.5 km are asphalt around Växjösjön with a finish on Lagunvallen
additional: Distances: 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km, and several children's distances in Little Växjöloppet (no individual timing for children's races). The 21.1 km is completed as two laps (the first lap just over 11 km, the second 10 km). Hydration stations: at 10 km there are four stations (after 1 km, 3 km, 5.5 km, and 6.5 km); at 21.1 km there are opportunities for fluids eight times (e.g., 1, 3, 5.5, 6.5, 10, 13, 15.5, 16.5 km). Little Växjöloppet: participants in some children's races receive bib numbers, medals, and fruit; The Newspaper Run offers a T-shirt and diploma. It is possible to use a wellness allowance for registration (registration via mittlopp.se and receipt can be used against the employer's wellness benefit). Team competitions are available; start lists and participant information can be found on the official website. The distances are 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km, and Little Växjöloppet; hydration stations along the course (4 on 10 km; up to 8 on 21.1 km); Bokhultet station closes at 13:40 and tunnel/Växjösjön station closes at 14:00; finish closes at 14:30.

name: 45. Tartu Maastikumaraton
description: 45. Tartu Maastikumaraton on Tartumaa Tervisespordikeskuses toimuva jooksuvõistluse traditsiooniline sündmus, mis pakub osalejatele võimalust nautida maastikujooksu kaunist looduses. Üritus on osa Eesti liikumisharrastuse edendamise programmist ning sobib erineva tasemega jooksjatele, kes soovivad parandada oma füüsilist vormi ja vaimset heaolu. Maraton rõhutab liikumise tähtsust tervise ja hea enesetunde säilitamisel ning kutsub kõiki aktiivseid inimesi osalema. Korraldajaks on Liikumisharrastuse Kompetentsikeskus, kes toetab Eesti tervislikuma ja aktiivsema ühiskonna kujundamist.
course_highlights: Maastikujooks Tartumaa Tervisespordikeskuse kaunites metsamaastikes
Mitmekesine ja vaheldusrikas rada sobib erineva tasemega jooksjatele
Võimalus nautida loodust ja parandada vaimset ning füüsilist tervist
additional: Üritus toimub Tartumaa Tervisespordikeskuses ning pakub osalejatele registreerimisvõimalust ja stardinumbreid Tartus Turu 10 ning Aura keskuse parklas.

name: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra 2026
description: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra is a welcoming Backyard Ultra race held in Trekantsparken, Liljeholmen in Stockholm, organized by Run Raisers with proceeds for #Run4Diabetes. The race takes place on a 6.7 km loop around Trekanten and Vinterviken with mixed terrain and a new start every full hour; participants must complete the loop within 1 hour to start the next. The event offers an energy station, medal, goodie bag, and organizer support throughout the race. The start is at 14:00 on May 1, 2026.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop around Trekanten and Vinterviken (start/finish in Trekantsparken, near Liljeholmen metro station)
Mixed terrain: trails with wooden bridges, gravel roads, and paved walk/cycle paths
A steep uphill at Örnberget and illuminated trail along Vinterviken
additional: Registration opens August 1. Name changes can be made until April 17, 2026, for a fee of 150 SEK (done via info@runraisers.com with new participant details). Bib distribution takes place on Thursday, April 30. Race format: mass start every full hour; those who do not complete the loop within 1 hour are out. The registration fee includes an energy station, race photos, medal, and goodie bag; 20% of the fee goes to #Run4Diabetes. The race is a charity event supporting Run4Diabetes; 20% of the registration fee is donated to Run4Diabetes; includes aid station, medal, race photos, goodie bag, and prizes for winners.

name: Sevede Trail Run
description: Sevede Trail Run is a welcoming trail race in Mariannelund organized by Hässleby SOK. The race offers a challenging course mostly run on narrow trails in the beautiful Småland landscape - through dark, fairy-tale forests, along lakes, and over long cliffs with fast downhill sections. There are categories for men and women at 10 km and 26 km, as well as a children's race of about 1 km. Everyone is welcome to register until race day; the children's race is free and awards a medal at finish.
course_highlights: Mostly narrow trails in Småland landscape
Through dark, fairy-tale forests and along lakes
Long cliffs and fast downhill sections
additional: Registration opens at 08:00 at Slättvallen in Mariannelund. Registration is via email to sevedetrailrun@hotmail.com and payment is accepted via Swish (123-358 26 99). Late registration can be done on-site on race day. The children's race is about 1 km, all children run for free and receive a medal and a banana at the finish; a parent can accompany the child. Distance options: 26 km and 10 km; start window Saturday 10:00 - 16:00; contact: sevedetrailrun@hotmail.com; 2025 estimated number of participants approximately 45; 2024 women's course record at 26 km is 2:10:07 by Emelie Braf; children's race with many participants; results and photos are available.

name: Trosa Ultra Backyard 2026
description: Trosa Ultra Backyard is a Backyard Ultra on a light and fast lap course in central Trosa where each lap is 6.706 km and the race continues as long as participants can complete a lap within one hour. The start is on May 2, 2026 at 10:00 AM and the concept follows the Backyard format: those who complete a lap within an hour can start again until only one participant remains. The race is open to the public and family-friendly with Mini-TUB for children (start at 12:15 PM) and awards for the top three in men's and women's categories. The organizer offers sports drinks, fruit, sandwiches at the lap change, and has ongoing raffles during the race.
course_highlights: Lap of 6.706 km (large course)
Mostly follows the Trosaån and is very easy and flat (approximately <10 meters elevation gain)
Mini-TUB: approximately 700 m course for children (MiniTUB follows the large course 700 m before deviation)
additional: Start and finish at Västra hamnplan in Trosa; livestream on Facebook page Trosa Ultra Backyard; Mini-TUB sponsored by Camfil; team competition where the top three results count for each club (the club with the top three gets 20% discount next year); tent spaces outside the start area; limited motorhome spaces; no caravan spaces; food and energy support during the race (candy, sports drinks, fruit) and Selfie-Corner after the race; free silicone mug from Umara for all main race participants.

name: 3. Benno Viirandi nimeline rahvajooks

tiers.label: tier_1

description: 3. Benno Viirandi nimeline rahvajooks on perekeskne jooksu- ja kepikõnniüritus, mis toimub Mustla alevikus. Võistlus toimub 5 km pikkusel rajal, mis algab Soe küla Vambola bussijaama juurest ja lõpeb Tarvastu Gümnaasiumi staadionil. Ürituse eesmärk on austada legendaarse jooksumehe Benno Viirandi mälestust ning populariseerida jooksmist kui tervislikku ajaveetmise viisi. Lisaks põhijooksule toimuvad lastejooksud staadionil, mis on tasuta. Osalejatele on tagatud võistlusnumbrid ja võimalus registreeruda nii eelnevalt kui ka võistluspäeval kohapeal.
course_highlights: 5 km distants Soe küla Vambola bussijaama juurest Tarvastu Gümnaasiumi staadionile
Rajale pääseb ka kepikõndijad, kes osalevad põhidistantsil
Lastejooksud toimuvad staadionil pärast põhijooksu starti
additional: Osalejatele on korraldatud bussitransport stardikohta Tarvastu Gümnaasiumi staadioni juurest kell 17:50, vajadusel sõidab buss kaks korda. Võistluspäeval toimub registreerimine stardipaigas kell 17:30-18:15. Lastejooksudel osalemine on tasuta. Võistlejad saavad võistlusnumbrid kätte võistluspäeval enne starti. Osavõtutasu tasuda arvelduskontole, registreerimine kuni 27.05.2026, ohutus ja vastutus osalejate enda vastutusel

name: Kopli Liinide Jooks
description:
Rada algab Kopli Liinide promenaadilt. Teekond jätkub läbi Kopli Käsepargi, seejärel mööda mereäärt.

Raja esimene pool kulgeb mööda mereäärt, pakkudes kauneid vaateid Kopli lahele.

Rada läbib ka Paljassaare hoiuala, mis on kaunis looduskaitseala ja tuntud linnuvaatluse koht. Seejärel liigume läbi Tallinna Vesi territooriumi, kus on võimalik näha, kuidas toimub vee puhastamine, enne kui naaseme tagasi promenaadile.

name: Sõeru Kevadjooks
description:
Sõeru Kevadjooks on pühendatud ajaloolisele Sõeru silmaallikale, mis asub Vanamõisa
multifunktsionaalsel tervise- ja õpperajal. Jooksu eesmärgiks on jooksuharrastuse
propageerimine, võistlusvõimaluse pakkumine ja ka võitjate selgitamine erinevatel
distantsidel. Oluline on ka tutvustada piirkonda, pakkuda värskes õhus sportlikku vaba aja
veetmise võimalust kogu perele ning propageerida sportlikke eluviise.
additional:
Registreerimine ja stardid toimuvad Vanamõisa vabaõhukeskuses (Vabaõhukeskuse tee 20), Harjumaa, Saue vald, Vanamõisa küla. Stardimaterjalide väljastamine toimub 12. mail kell 17:00-20:00
Vanamõisa karavanpargi kohvikus (Vabaõhukeskuse tee 18). 13. mail toimub stardimaterjalide väljastamine ja võistlejate registreerimine alates kell 15:00 Vanamõisa vabaõhukeskuse palksaalis. Numbrite väljastamine lõpeb kell 17:15 ja lastejooksudele kell 16:30.

Lastejooksud algavad kell 17:00
Põhijooksu start kell 18:00
Noortejooksu start kell 18:10
Kõik stardid antakse Vanamõisa vabaõhukeskusest. Samas kohas on ka finiš.
